raw.description:
Description

We're looking for a sharp, experienced Backend Engineer to join our global Experience Edge team, in a fully remote role. This team owns where the company platform meets the real world: the integrations customers work in every day, the reporting they act on, and the data behind both.

You'll own features end to end, from concept to production. You'll also hear from customers first-hand, since our engineers join customer and pre-sales calls, and what comes up there shapes what we build next.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Own our third-party integrations end to end, from design and build through shipping and keeping them reliable at enterprise scale
  • Build the platform's reporting layer and the data model behind it, on high-volume, cloud-based infrastructure (MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Kubernetes)
  • Lead cross-team features, bringing engineers from Security and other groups along with you
  • Get into any part of the system, understand it quickly, and solve the production challenges that matter most to our customers
  • Work side by side with Product on RFEs, helping turn customer needs into the right technical solution
  • Talk to customers directly as part of our Customer Focus Group, from pre-sales conversations to live escalations, and become a truly customer-centric engineer

Requirements

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years of hands-on backend development experience
  • Strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript (must-have)
  • Solid grounding in modern data infrastructure such as MongoDB, Redis and ClickHouse
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of features, from design through production, with production-grade code
  • Comfortable getting into large, unfamiliar codebases and making them your own
  • Excellent English, and enjoy being in front of customers
  • A collaborative mindset, and a habit of leading by example
  • AI-first: early adopter of AI technologies, using AI to improve developer experience and system performance

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in cybersecurity, DevOps or developer-facing products
  • Kubernetes in production
  • A track record of influencing and aligning engineers across teams

At Kodiak Solutions, we’re dedicated to transforming the healthcare industry through cutting-edge, technology-driven solutions. We specialize in healthcare finance, unclaimed property, risk management, and revenue cycle management, helping healthcare organizations streamline complex financial operations. Our mission is to simplify and optimize processes, so healthcare providers can focus on delivering excellent patient care.

Powered by our innovative platform, we offer cloud-based systems, automated workflows, and advanced data management tools designed to address the unique challenges in healthcare. Whether it's improving revenue cycle efficiency, navigating unclaimed property issues, or mitigating risk, our platform delivers real-time, actionable insights to drive better outcomes.

The Implementation Senior Associate has the responsibility of partnering with healthcare customers to solve complex data and technology challenges, guide successful implementations, and help customers achieve stronger financial and operational outcomes. This role combines analytical problem-solving, consultative customer engagement, and project ownership to manage multiple implementations while identifying opportunities to make delivery more efficient, consistent, and effective.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities may include the following. Other duties may also be assigned.

  • Execute assigned implementation activities across multiple concurrent Customer projects, ensuring timely and accurate deliverables
  • Work with Customers and internal teams to collect, validate, and reconcile data needed for successful implementations

  • Proactively manage assigned deliverables, monitor progress, identify and mitigate risks early, and communicate project status to stakeholders
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and leverage technology, automation, and AI to improve implementation efficiency, consistency, and quality

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 2+ years of experience in functional consulting, solution implementation, data analysis, or healthcare operations
  • Experience with data management, validation, reconciliation, integration, and analysis, including large datasets
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, SQL, or similar data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of healthcare finance, accounting, revenue cycle, or patient accounting operations preferred
  • Experience with healthcare technology implementations, including EHR or patient accounting platforms such as Epic or Oracle Health (Cerner) preferred
  • Ability to investigate complex data or implementation issues, recommend solutions, and manage multiple concurrent projects
  • Familiarity with AI, automation, or emerging technologies used to improve implementation processes
  • Ability to travel up to 20%, as needed

Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.

Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.

At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.

We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.

Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast

Job Description:

About the Role 

The Technical Success Manager (TSM) is a high-impact customer-facing role for someone who enjoys combining technical depth, customer advocacy, and commercial awareness to help customers get lasting value from cybersecurity technology.

 

In this role, you will partner with security, IT, and technical stakeholders to turn deployment into meaningful adoption, helping customers embed the platform into daily security operations, reduce risk, and achieve measurable outcomes. 

You will work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, and Renewals, bringing a clear technical view of customer health, adoption progress, risks, and renewal readiness. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Build trusted relationships with customer security and IT teams, understanding their priorities, workflows, and success outcomes. 
  • Create practical technical success plans that help customers adopt the platform, reduce risk, and realise measurable value. 
  • Identify high-value use cases that make the platform part of everyday security operations. 
  • Use product usage, engagement, and health indicators to spot adoption gaps, underutilisation, and retention risks early. 
  • Guide customers through the transition from deployment to active use, accelerating Time-to-Value and reducing handover friction. 
  • Lead mitigation planning for technical blockers, integration challenges, operational gaps, and customer health risks. 
  • Bring clear technical health insights into renewal readiness, QBRs, growth discussions, and account strategy. 
  • Surface technical opportunities that support expansion, upsell, and cross-sell activity in partnership with the Account Executive. 
  • Champion the voice of technical users by ensuring product feedback, risks, and success requirements are visible internally. 

 

What Success Looks Like 

  • Customers are healthier, more engaged, and prepared for renewal and expansion. 
  • Technical risks are identified early and managed before they affect confidence or outcomes. 
  • Customers reach value faster after deployment or major use case activation. 
  • You are recognised by customers and account teams as a trusted, practical technical advisor.

 About You 

  • You have 5+ years' experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as Customer Success Manager, Technical Success Manager, Technical Account Manager, Technical Consultant, Product Specialist, or similar. 
  • You understand enterprise cybersecurity, networking, cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments. 
  • You know how to drive adoption, retention, technical value realisation, and customer health improvement. 
  • You can translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for customers and internal teams. 
  • You are confident engaging with security engineers, SOC analysts, system administrators, technical leaders, and executives. 
  • You bring strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
  • Experience with security operations, SOC workflows, threat detection, or incident response use cases is desirable. 
  • Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia, and proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Familiarity with customer success platforms, health scoring, adoption analytics, and renewal governance is advantageous. 

 

Why This Role Matters 

This is an opportunity to sit at the centre of customer value, technical strategy, and retention, helping customers turn powerful cybersecurity technology into sustained operational impact. 

As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability.

Junior Network Security Integration Engineer

Program: Army Global Unified Network (AGUN)
Location: Remote | Up to 10% Travel, *Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes, if an offer letter is extended to you.
Clearance Required: Active DoD Secret
Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship Required


Help Secure and Modernize the U.S. Army's Global Network!

Leidos is seeking a motivated Junior Network Security Integration Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

This is an exciting opportunity to build your network security engineering skills while helping modernize and protect the Army's global enterprise network.

In this remote role, you'll focus on firewall integration, secure network connectivity, security policy configuration, and network modernization. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and cybersecurity professionals to integrate modern security technologies into the Army's enterprise network.

We're looking for someone with hands-on firewall experience, strong networking fundamentals, and the ability to configure, integrate, and troubleshoot enterprise security solutions.


.What You'll Do

  • Support the engineering and integration of site-specific firewalls and network security solutions.
  • Perform network device discovery, validate management connectivity, and identify migration dependencies.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), preferably Palo Alto Networks.
  • Assist with firewall security policies, access control lists (ACLs), NAT, security zones, and network segmentation.
  • Review legacy firewall configurations and help integrate security policies into modernized network environments.
  • Support Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and secure remote access solutions.
  • Troubleshoot firewall policy conflicts, VPN connectivity, routing, and network security issues.
  • Analyze network traffic, firewall logs, and security events to identify and resolve technical problems.
  • Assist with network security migration planning, implementation, testing, and post-migration validation.
  • Perform firewall software upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Work with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with DoD security requirements and STIGs.
  • Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, and network hardening activities.
  • Develop site integration plans, test configurations, network diagrams, security policy documentation, and migration validation records.
  • Participate in technical reviews, readiness assessments, and security validation activities.
  • Coordinate with engineering and operations teams to ensure successful integration and operational handoff.
  • Work independently on assigned technical tasks while collaborating with senior engineers on complex issues.

What We're Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related field with 2–4 years of relevant experience, or approximately 3 years of relevant experience without a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (such as Security+) and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise firewall configuration, integration, management, and troubleshooting, preferably Palo Alto Networks.
  • Knowledge of firewall security policies, ACLs, NAT, security zones, and network segmentation.
  • Experience supporting network security integrations, firewall migrations, or enterprise network modernization.
  • Understanding of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IPSec, VPNs, and Layer 2/Layer 3 routing.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and secure remote access technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting firewall policy conflicts, network connectivity, and security performance issues.
  • Familiarity with Palo Alto Panorama, Cisco management platforms, or similar tools.
  • Experience with firewall patching, upgrades, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Knowledge of DoD STIGs, network security hardening, and cybersecurity compliance.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, firewall configuration records, and network security diagrams.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with geographically dispersed engineering teams.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts when needed for migration activities.
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Army, DISA, or other DoD enterprise networks.
  • Palo Alto Networks security certification (such as PCNSE or a current equivalent), CCNA, or CCNP.
  • Experience with large-scale firewall migrations, security policy conversions, and enterprise network transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, and GlobalProtect.
  • Experience with Cisco Secure Firewall, Juniper SRX, or other enterprise firewall platforms.
  • Experience with ZTNA solutions such as AppGate.
  • Knowledge of SD-WAN, MPLS, and enterprise network segmentation.
  • Experience with firewall rule optimization and security configuration validation.
  • Familiarity with virtualized firewalls, cloud security, and hybrid networks.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.
  • Experience with Python scripting for network security automation.
  • Experience using Wireshark, tcpdump, or similar troubleshooting tools.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management, RMF, and security compliance processes.
  • Experience supporting large, geographically dispersed enterprise networks.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to develop your network security expertise while supporting a mission that directly impacts the U.S. Army's global communications.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, gain exposure to advanced firewall and network security technologies, and contribute to modernizing critical military infrastructure.

If you're a cleared Network Security Engineer with hands-on firewall experience who wants to grow your skills and support a mission that matters, we'd like to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help secure the future of the Army's global network. Apply today!

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Security teams are not short on tools. They are short on time, alignment, and the ability to actually close exposure. That's why most breaches could have been prevented with a tool that was already in use.

Nagomi was built to change that.

We are the first Agentic Exposure Ops Platform, designed to prevent the preventable breach by turning fragmented signals into coordinated action. Our agents investigate risk, drive remediation, and verify that issues stay closed, continuously, without adding overhead.

This is not another dashboard. It is a new way for security to operate.

Recognized by Gartner® as a Cool Vendor in ASCA, Nagomi is helping organizations move from reactive workflows to continuous execution, replacing manual effort with systems that actually move the work forward.

We are building something category-defining. The kind of shift people point back to later and say, "that changed how this works."

The Role

We are looking for a Product Marketing Lead who wants to define a category, not just describe a product.

Exposure management, CTEM and AI-driven remediation are colliding into a single market, and the company that explains it best will define it. You will take a deep, technical platform and turn it into a story CISOs repeat in board meetings, practitioners trust, and our sellers win with.

This role is right for someone who has done product marketing inside a security company, can hold their own with a detection engineer, and would rather write the battlecard themselves than brief someone else to.

  • A track record of building positioning from scratch and launching products that moved pipeline
  • Hands-on experience running competitive programs and win/loss analysis
  • Writing that makes complex ideas simple, for a CISO in one slide and an engineer in one paragraph
  • Daily use of AI tools in your own research, writing and enablement work

What Sets You Apart

  • You create clarity, not more messaging
  • You go deep on the product, not just the pitch
  • You do the work yourself, not route it through agencies
  • You measure success in deals won, not assets shipped

Position: Director, Centralized Experience

Compensation: Pursuant to state regulations, the salary range is $132,100-$155,000 plus bonus potential. ​Eligible to participate in the company benefits plan. We offer health, vision, dental, and pet insurance. We offer a 401(k) retirement plan, student loan assistance, licensing and continuing education reimbursement, parental leave, and housing allowances or gifts.

Summary

The Director of Centralized Experience is a transformative leader responsible for shaping, scaling and elevating Cardinal’s centralized operations platform. This role oversees the centralized teams responsible for driving prospect conversion and resident satisfaction driven by our AI platform and service specialists, self guided tour innovation to ensure we are meeting the prospect where they’re at, and centralized revenue management operations and workﬂow.

The core role of this position is to seamlessly integrate our centralized platform (human specialists partnered with our AI powered proptech) with onsite teams, have metrics in place to easily show the value to our clients and evolve the perception of centralized operations from a separate team to a high touch, value add revenue generating engine.

Responsibilities

Prospect Journey & Resident Experience

  • Lead, unify, and scale our Centralized Services ecosystem, managing multi-tier teams across Customer Sales Specialists (CSS), Customer Experience Manager and Resident Service Specialists (RSS) and Revenue Management.

  • Ensure Customer Service Managers are upholding CSS’ to CWOL standards and creating memorable experiences for prospects and RSS are supporting onsite teams by eﬀectively managing Resident requests

  • Align centralized operations with Leasing and Marketing strategies to establish a seamless, end-to-end prospect and resident lifecycle model across student housing and conventional portfolios.

  • Develop, monitor, and manage team against goals and KPIs that roll up to Cardinal OKRs (ex: response latency, lead-to-lease conversion, ﬁrst-contact resolution, resident retention, AI automation handle rate, and customer satisfaction scores).

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Innovation

  • Partner with the leadership team to ensure organizational alignment, optimized processes, and scalable growth.

  • Conduct regular reviews with internal stakeholders to conﬁrm our centralized platform is meeting expectations and demonstrating value. Conﬁrm there is

  • clarity and deﬁnition around how the additional time onsite teams have is being used that increases prospect and resident experiences

  • Identify key metrics that resonate with Operations, Leasing & Marketing and Clients and ensure reports showcase these results for regular review

Centralized Platform Growth, Alignment and Scalability

  • Serve as the operational subject matter expert (SME) in technology being used to power our centralized platform. Be forward thinking and innovative about how Cardinal can leverage AI powered technology platforms and proprietary resident service apps.

  • Collaborate directly with Data and Innovation and third-party technology partners to design workﬂows and touchpoints between automation and humans to enhance interactions for both leasing and resident experiences.

  • Oversee the operational deployment, change management, and user adoption of new AI tools across centralized teams and onsite property management staﬀ.

  • Establish feedback loops with Operations (Portfolio Managers and Onsite Teams), Leasing & Marketing Teams, and Residents to identify software bugs, capability gaps, and opportunities to enhance features and functionality.

Team Leadership and Centralized Enablement

  • Oversee the daily strategy and quality assurance of the centralized Contact Center and Resident Service Specialist team, ensuring high-touch, eﬃcient support for leasing questions, resident requests, account maintenance, and app support.

  • Be integral to the rollout and adoption of a Cardinal Resident App to improve resident satisfaction, streamline maintenance workﬂows, and optimize on-site operational eﬃciency.

  • Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation matrices, and training protocols for resident service operations and AI-assisted support channels.

  • Represent Cardinal Group as a thought leader at industry conferences, panels, and technology roundtables, highlighting innovations in student housing operations, central management, and proptech integration.

Client Implementation & Support

  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert to client and potential clients, demonstrating the value, operational eﬃciency, and measurable ROI of Cardinal’s centralized platform and the power of thoughtful Human + AI touchpoints with prospects and residents.

  • Lead the operational onboarding and technology integration process for new properties joining the centralized service platform, ensuring zero downtime and high stakeholder satisfaction.

raw.description:
Tax Client Services Manager

Location:Remote

Schedule:Full-Time, minimum 40 hours per week

Compensation: $70,000–$80,000 base salary, plus incentives for upsells and referrals. Total annual earnings of up to $100,000 are possible, with anything above base salary coming solely from incentives; incentive earnings are not guaranteed.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Tax Client Services Manager to own the ongoing relationship with our tax clients. This role is for someone who already knows tax and knows how to talk about it. You’ll use your tax experience to understand each client’s situation, explain it to them clearly, and spot opportunities where our additional services can genuinely help.

This is a relationship-first, revenue-aware role: you’ll be the client’s advocate internally and our most trusted voice externally, with a direct hand in retention and growth. Success is measured by proactive outreach, client satisfaction, issue resolution, and revenue growth through upsells (that truly benefit the client) and referrals.

Why you’ll love this role:

This is not a big corporate job where you own 5% of the outcome, sit through endless meetings, and wait years for someone to give you more responsibility.

We’re a small, fast-growing firm. That means real ownership and a real opportunity to grow with us.

We work hard. We move fast. We have fun. And we’re building something big.

If you want to become ridiculously good at what you do, take ownership of your work, and help build something you’re proud of…keep reading.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned book of tax clients, building long-term, trust-based relationships beyond tax season.

  • Proactively reach out to clients on a regular cadence (not just when issues arise) to check in, review their tax situation, stay ahead of changing needs, and make sure they’re having a great experience.

  • Translate tax topics into clear, plain-language explanations so clients understand where they stand and what comes next.

  • Identify and surface upsell opportunities (additional services, planning engagements, expanded scope) based on a genuine understanding of each client’s tax and financial picture.

  • Resolve client issues and concerns quickly, coordinating with internal tax preparers, accountants, and specialists as needed.

  • Track and report on client health, satisfaction, and engagement, flagging at-risk accounts before they churn.

  • Collect and relay client feedback internally to help improve service delivery and identify new service opportunities.

  • Maintain accurate records of client interactions, outreach, and outcomes in the CRM.

  • Partner with the sales team on renewals, cross-sells, and new service introductions.

  • Onboard new clients and make sure they’re set up for success.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • Tax experience: 2+ years of hands-on tax experience, such as tax preparation, tax resolution, or client services at a CPA, EA, or tax firm. This is required.

  • Excellent communication: Clear, confident written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain tax concepts simply and build rapport quickly with clients.

  • 2+ years in a client-facing, relationship-management, or account management role.

  • A consultative approach: able to identify client needs and translate them into service recommendations without being pushy.

  • Highly organized and self-directed; comfortable managing a portfolio of client relationships simultaneously.

  • Comfortable working toward KPIs and revenue targets tied to compensation.

  • Experience with CRM tools and basic reporting.

Nice-to-have:

  • Enrolled Agent (EA) credential, or actively pursuing EA certification.

Benefits:

  • Health insurance

  • Health savings account

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Retirement savings program (401k)

  • Working with a high-energy founder

  • Gaining knowledge and education on tax law

Our Vision & Values:

Vision:

To make valuable tax and accounting education and services available to everyone.

Non-Negotiable Values:

1) Fun Tax Energy (FTE)

  • Bring Positive Energy – Approach your work with focus and enthusiasm knowing that your energy is contagious.

  • Operational Excellence – Do great work because we care about being the best. We take pride in the details, raise the standard, and treat excellence as part of the job.

2) Speed Drives Results

  • End of Day Mentality – Move with urgency. We do not let work sit when it can be finished, advanced, clarified, or unblocked today.

  • Grow Through Action – Pursue learning, skill-building, and progress by doing. Ask questions to learn not just what to do, but why it matters.

3) Own the Outcome

  • Resourceful Problem-Solving – We do not stop at the first obstacle. We ask better questions, find the right resources, and keep moving until the problem is solved.

  • Fierce Independence – Follow through on what you say you will do and take responsibility for outcomes under your control.

  • Communicate Early and Clearly – We share status, raise issues early, and make sure the next step is clear before confusion becomes a problem.

Summary

The Director of Centralized Experience is a transformative leader responsible for shaping, scaling and elevating Cardinal’s centralized operations platform. This role oversees the centralized teams responsible for driving prospect conversion and resident satisfaction driven by our AI platform and service specialists, self guided tour innovation to ensure we are meeting the prospect where they’re at, and centralized revenue management operations and workﬂow.

The core role of this position is to seamlessly integrate our centralized platform (human specialists partnered with our AI powered proptech) with onsite teams, have metrics in place to easily show the value to our clients and evolve the perception of centralized operations from a separate team to a high touch, value add revenue generating engine.

Responsibilities

Prospect Journey & Resident Experience

  • Lead, unify, and scale our Centralized Services ecosystem, managing multi-tier teams across Customer Sales Specialists (CSS), Customer Experience Manager and Resident Service Specialists (RSS) and Revenue Management.

  • Ensure Customer Service Managers are upholding CSS’ to CWOL standards and creating memorable experiences for prospects and RSS are supporting onsite teams by eﬀectively managing Resident requests

  • Align centralized operations with Leasing and Marketing strategies to establish a seamless, end-to-end prospect and resident lifecycle model across student housing and conventional portfolios.

  • Develop, monitor, and manage team against goals and KPIs that roll up to Cardinal OKRs (ex: response latency, lead-to-lease conversion, ﬁrst-contact resolution, resident retention, AI automation handle rate, and customer satisfaction scores).

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Innovation

  • Partner with the leadership team to ensure organizational alignment, optimized processes, and scalable growth.

  • Conduct regular reviews with internal stakeholders to conﬁrm our centralized platform is meeting expectations and demonstrating value. Conﬁrm there is

  • clarity and deﬁnition around how the additional time onsite teams have is being used that increases prospect and resident experiences

  • Identify key metrics that resonate with Operations, Leasing & Marketing and Clients and ensure reports showcase these results for regular review

Centralized Platform Growth, Alignment and Scalability

  • Serve as the operational subject matter expert (SME) in technology being used to power our centralized platform. Be forward thinking and innovative about how Cardinal can leverage AI powered technology platforms and proprietary resident service apps.

  • Collaborate directly with Data and Innovation and third-party technology partners to design workﬂows and touchpoints between automation and humans to enhance interactions for both leasing and resident experiences.

  • Oversee the operational deployment, change management, and user adoption of new AI tools across centralized teams and onsite property management staﬀ.

  • Establish feedback loops with Operations (Portfolio Managers and Onsite Teams), Leasing & Marketing Teams, and Residents to identify software bugs, capability gaps, and opportunities to enhance features and functionality.

Team Leadership and Centralized Enablement

  • Oversee the daily strategy and quality assurance of the centralized Contact Center and Resident Service Specialist team, ensuring high-touch, eﬃcient support for leasing questions, resident requests, account maintenance, and app support.

  • Be integral to the rollout and adoption of a Cardinal Resident App to improve resident satisfaction, streamline maintenance workﬂows, and optimize on-site operational eﬃciency.

  • Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation matrices, and training protocols for resident service operations and AI-assisted support channels.

  • Represent Cardinal Group as a thought leader at industry conferences, panels, and technology roundtables, highlighting innovations in student housing operations, central management, and proptech integration.

Client Implementation & Support

  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert to client and potential clients, demonstrating the value, operational eﬃciency, and measurable ROI of Cardinal’s centralized platform and the power of thoughtful Human + AI touchpoints with prospects and residents.

raw.description:
Tax Client Services Manager

Location:Remote

Schedule:Full-Time, minimum 40 hours per week

Compensation: $70,000–$80,000 base salary, plus incentives for upsells and referrals. Total annual earnings of up to $100,000 are possible, with anything above base salary coming solely from incentives; incentive earnings are not guaranteed.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Tax Client Services Manager to own the ongoing relationship with our tax clients. This role is for someone who already knows tax and knows how to talk about it. You’ll use your tax experience to understand each client’s situation, explain it to them clearly, and spot opportunities where our additional services can genuinely help.

This is a relationship-first, revenue-aware role: you’ll be the client’s advocate internally and our most trusted voice externally, with a direct hand in retention and growth. Success is measured by proactive outreach, client satisfaction, issue resolution, and revenue growth through upsells (that truly benefit the client) and referrals.

Why you’ll love this role:

This is not a big corporate job where you own 5% of the outcome, sit through endless meetings, and wait years for someone to give you more responsibility.

We’re a small, fast-growing firm. That means real ownership and a real opportunity to grow with us.

We work hard. We move fast. We have fun. And we’re building something big.

If you want to become ridiculously good at what you do, take ownership of your work, and help build something you’re proud of…keep reading.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned book of tax clients, building long-term, trust-based relationships beyond tax season.

  • Proactively reach out to clients on a regular cadence (not just when issues arise) to check in, review their tax situation, stay ahead of changing needs, and make sure they’re having a great experience.

  • Translate tax topics into clear, plain-language explanations so clients understand where they stand and what comes next.

  • Identify and surface upsell opportunities (additional services, planning engagements, expanded scope) based on a genuine understanding of each client’s tax and financial picture.

  • Resolve client issues and concerns quickly, coordinating with internal tax preparers, accountants, and specialists as needed.

  • Track and report on client health, satisfaction, and engagement, flagging at-risk accounts before they churn.

  • Collect and relay client feedback internally to help improve service delivery and identify new service opportunities.

  • Maintain accurate records of client interactions, outreach, and outcomes in the CRM.

  • Partner with the sales team on renewals, cross-sells, and new service introductions.

  • Onboard new clients and make sure they’re set up for success.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • Tax experience: 2+ years of hands-on tax experience, such as tax preparation, tax resolution, or client services at a CPA, EA, or tax firm. This is required.

  • Excellent communication: Clear, confident written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain tax concepts simply and build rapport quickly with clients.

  • 2+ years in a client-facing, relationship-management, or account management role.

  • A consultative approach: able to identify client needs and translate them into service recommendations without being pushy.

  • Highly organized and self-directed; comfortable managing a portfolio of client relationships simultaneously.

  • Comfortable working toward KPIs and revenue targets tied to compensation.

  • Experience with CRM tools and basic reporting.

Nice-to-have:

  • Enrolled Agent (EA) credential, or actively pursuing EA certification.

Benefits:

  • Health insurance

  • Health savings account

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Retirement savings program (401k)

  • Working with a high-energy founder

  • Gaining knowledge and education on tax law

Our Vision & Values:

Vision:

To make valuable tax and accounting education and services available to everyone.

Non-Negotiable Values:

1) Fun Tax Energy (FTE)

  • Bring Positive Energy – Approach your work with focus and enthusiasm knowing that your energy is contagious.

  • Operational Excellence – Do great work because we care about being the best. We take pride in the details, raise the standard, and treat excellence as part of the job.

2) Speed Drives Results

  • End of Day Mentality – Move with urgency. We do not let work sit when it can be finished, advanced, clarified, or unblocked today.

  • Grow Through Action – Pursue learning, skill-building, and progress by doing. Ask questions to learn not just what to do, but why it matters.

3) Own the Outcome

  • Resourceful Problem-Solving – We do not stop at the first obstacle. We ask better questions, find the right resources, and keep moving until the problem is solved.

  • Fierce Independence – Follow through on what you say you will do and take responsibility for outcomes under your control.

  • Communicate Early and Clearly – We share status, raise issues early, and make sure the next step is clear before confusion becomes a problem.

Make a difference from home while supporting patients and providers nationwide.

We are seeking experienced Registered Nurses (RNs) to join our growing 24-hour medical call center as a Remote Triage Nurse.   • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Guided by experienced statisticians, the intern will contribute to one or more projects focused on addressing key client inquiries and developing automated analytical solutions to support operational objectives. About CEO Lawyer

CEO Lawyer is one of the fastest-growing personal injury law firms in the United States, built on a mission of helping injured people understand and protect their rights. As our litigation team continues to grow, we are looking for exceptional legal professionals who want more than just another job.

This is an opportunity to join a firm that is scaling nationally, investing heavily in its people, technology, and operations, and building something truly special.

If you're a seasoned litigation paralegal looking for a place where your work is valued, your voice is heard, and your contributions directly impact case outcomes, we want to hear from you.

Why Top Litigation Paralegals Choose CEO Lawyer

At many firms, paralegals are treated as support staff.

At CEO Lawyer, our litigation paralegals are critical members of the legal team. You'll work alongside experienced attorneys, take ownership of complex litigation matters, and play a direct role in helping clients obtain life-changing results.

You'll join a firm that:

  • Continues to experience rapid nationwide growth
  • Invests in technology and operational excellence
  • Offers long-term career advancement opportunities
  • Provides direct access to leadership and decision-makers
  • Values accountability, autonomy, and initiative
  • Encourages professional growth and continued development
  • Maintains a fully remote, modern work environment

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Personal Injury Litigation Paralegal to support our Texas litigation practice.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys taking ownership of their work, and can confidently manage litigation matters from filing through trial preparation.

The ideal candidate does more than meet deadlines. They anticipate issues, solve problems, keep cases moving forward, and become a trusted partner to the attorneys they support.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Managing personal injury litigation cases from filing through trial preparation
  • Drafting pleadings, petitions, motions, discovery requests, and discovery responses
  • Monitoring case progression and ensuring all litigation deadlines are met
  • Coordinating service of process and monitoring completion
  • Scheduling depositions, hearings, mediations, and court appearances
  • Organizing and maintaining litigation files and evidence
  • Reviewing medical records, billing records, and supporting documentation
  • Managing non-party discovery and subpoena requests
  • Communicating regularly with clients and providing case status updates
  • Coordinating with opposing counsel, courts, experts, vendors, and medical providers
  • Assisting attorneys with case strategy implementation
  • Preparing exhibits, hearing materials, mediation packages, and trial binders
  • Supporting trial preparation and courtroom readiness efforts

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of Personal Injury Litigation experience
  • Proven litigation experience in Texas
  • Strong drafting and legal writing skills
  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple active litigation matters simultaneously
  • Excellent communication and client-service skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with eFileTexas and electronic court filing procedures
  • Strong working knowledge of Texas Rules of Civil Procedure
  • Experience managing Texas personal injury discovery, including requests for disclosure, requests for production, interrogatories, subpoenas, and deposition coordination
  • Experience reviewing, organizing, and summarizing medical records and billing records
  • Experience coordinating with medical providers, expert witnesses, court reporters, and insurance carriers
  • Experience handling lien and subrogation documentation
  • Experience preparing mediation materials, exhibits, and settlement-related documentation
  • Trial preparation experience, including exhibit organization and trial binders
  • Experience working in a fully digital, paperless law firm environment
  • Litigation experience in additional jurisdictions is a plus

Who Thrives Here

The strongest candidates are:

  • Proactive and self-motivated
  • Comfortable taking ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage competing priorities without missing deadlines
  • Solutions-oriented and resourceful
  • Passionate about helping clients through difficult situations
  • Driven to perform at a high level and grow with a rapidly expanding organization

Join a Firm That's Going Places

We're building more than a law firm. We're building the future of personal injury law.

If you're an experienced litigation paralegal who wants to be part of an ambitious team, make a meaningful impact, and grow alongside one of the fastest-growing personal injury firms in the country, we'd love to speak with you.

Desirable Experience

raw.description:
NationsBenefits is recognized as one of the fastest-growing companies in America and a Healthcare Fintech provider of supplemental benefits, flex cards, and member engagement solutions. We partner with managed care organizations to provide innovative healthcare solutions that drive growth, improve outcomes, reduce costs, and bring value to their members.

Through our comprehensive suite of innovative supplemental benefits, fintech payment platforms, and member engagement solutions, we help health plans deliver high-quality benefits to their members that address the social determinants of health and improve member health outcomes and satisfaction.

Our compliance-focused infrastructure, proprietary technology systems, and premier service delivery model allow our health plan partners to deliver high-quality, value-based care to millions of members.

We offer a fulfilling work environment that attracts top talent and encourages all associates to contribute to delivering premier service to internal and external customers alike. Our goal is to transform the healthcare industry for the better! We provide career advancement opportunities from within the organization across multiple locations in the US, South America, and India.

Role:

Serves as the primary point of contact for dental providers and network partners, resolving escalated issues related to claims, credentialing, authorizations, payments, and plan-specific benefit questions. Acts as the bridge between providers and internal operations, claims, and client services teams to resolve issues quickly and prevent repeat problems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own escalated provider issues from intake through resolution, including tracking, follow-up, and root cause documentation
  • Respond to provider inquiries on claims, eligibility, benefits, fee schedules, and payment disputes within defined turnaround standards
  • Coordinate with claims, credentialing, contracting, and client services teams to resolve cross-functional issues
  • Support leased network partners and direct-contracted providers, including onboarding and orientation to NationsDental processes
  • Identify trends in provider complaints and recommend process or training fixes
  • Maintain an escalation log and report on volume, categories, aging, and resolution times
  • Educate provider offices on plan-specific benefits, authorization requirements, and billing guidelines
  • Support compliance requirements, including provider complaint handling, directory accuracy, and health plan client oversight requests
  • Participate in provider outreach, webinars, and office visits as needed

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or higher in business administration, healthcare administration, or a related field preferred.
  • 1 to 3 years in provider relations, provider services, or dental or health plan operations
  • Working knowledge of dental claims, CDT codes, and provider contracting concepts
  • Familiarity with Medicare Advantage or Medicaid managed care requirements preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to de-escalate frustrated providers
  • Comfort managing multiple open issues and following up until they are closed
  • Proficiency with CRM or ticketing tools and Excel
  • Experience working with DSOs, group practices, or specialty provider organizations

preferred

  • Comfort presenting to provider offices and practice leadership in webinars and office visits

Success Measures:

  • Escalation resolution within standard turnaround times

•Provider satisfaction

•Reduction in repeat issues by category

  • Accuracy and completeness of escalation documentation

Why Join NationsBenefits?

This is an opportunity to be part of an organization experiencing rapid growth and innovation within the Medicare Advantage industry. As a Provider Services Specialist, you won't simply close tickets—you'll strengthen provider relationships, resolve issues at the root, and help shape the future of ancillary healthcare benefits.

Join us in our mission to become the premier ancillary benefits partner for Medicare Advantage plans while improving access to quality dental care for millions of members.

About This Role

We are seeking an ambitious and results-oriented Associate Sales Director to join our Retail Merchandising Analytics team. In this individual contributor role, you will drive new revenue growth, expand existing client relationships, and position NIQ's Retail Merchandising Analytics solutions while identifying opportunities across the broader NIQ portfolio, including collaboration programs, measurement, retail media intelligence, and emerging commerce solutions.

You will leverage a consultative sales approach to acquire new clients, grow existing accounts, and advance complex sales opportunities. Working in close partnership with Account Owners, Product Area Experts, Implementation teams, and Customer Success teams, you will help clients realize value from NIQ's solutions while contributing to sustained revenue growth.

You will also serve as a key source of client and market feedback, helping shape future product enhancements and go-to-market initiatives.

Responsibilities

Pipeline Management

  • Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline through disciplined prospecting, opportunity management, and consistent pipeline hygiene.
  • Deliver timely and accurate sales forecasts while maintaining appropriate pipeline coverage to support quota attainment.
  • Manage opportunities through all stages of the sales cycle, from qualification through close.

Client Acquisition

  • Identify and engage prospective clients through targeted prospecting, networking, referrals, and lead generation activities.
  • Develop and execute land-and-expand strategies that establish relationships and create opportunities for solution growth.
  • Generate new business opportunities within assigned markets and target accounts.

Account Growth and Relationship Management

  • Partner with account teams to strengthen client relationships and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Support client retention and growth efforts by aligning solutions with business priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop trusted relationships with client stakeholders across merchandising, pricing, category management, and strategy functions.

Consultative Selling and Solution Development

  • Utilize a consultative sales methodology to uncover client needs, understand business challenges, and align solutions to desired outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Product Area Experts to develop solution recommendations, proposals, and business cases.
  • Drive opportunities through the sales process while ensuring a strong focus on client value realization.

Solution and Platform Selling

  • Position NIQ's Retail Merchandising Analytics solutions, including pricing, assortment, merchandising, space planning, and related analytics offerings.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce complementary NIQ solutions where they can provide additional value to clients.
  • Participate in value-based selling conversations that connect analytics investments to business performance and growth.
  • Support pilot programs, proof-of-concepts, and multi-solution opportunities in partnership with sales and product stakeholders.

Sales Presentations and Demonstrations

  • Prepare and deliver tailored presentations that communicate solution value and differentiation.
  • Partner with Product Area Experts and Sales Engineers to conduct product demonstrations and client workshops.
  • Support proposal development and client business reviews.

Negotiation and Deal Management

  • Manage commercial discussions and contract negotiations with guidance from sales leadership as needed.
  • Help structure client agreements that align business objectives with profitable growth.
  • Advance opportunities efficiently through procurement and contracting processes.

Market Intelligence

  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and developments within retail analytics, merchandising, and adjacent solution areas.
  • Apply market insights to strengthen client conversations and sales strategies.
  • Share customer feedback and competitive intelligence with internal stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with account teams, Product Area Experts, Customer Success, and implementation teams throughout the sales cycle.
  • Contribute client and market insights that support product development and go-to-market efforts.
  • Collaborate effectively within a matrixed organization to deliver positive client outcomes.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field.
  • 7-10 years of consultative sales experience, preferably selling data, analytics, SaaS, or retail technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated success achieving or exceeding revenue targets and managing opportunities through complex sales cycles.
  • Experience selling merchandising, pricing, assortment, category management, space planning, retail analytics, or related solutions preferred.
  • Experience with data, measurement, analytics, or SaaS platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with retail media, commerce media, AI-enabled retail solutions, or connected commerce ecosystems is a plus.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Effective negotiation and deal management capabilities.
  • Strong organizational skills with a disciplined approach to pipeline management and forecasting.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating across cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for client meetings, industry events, and conferences.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate will achieve the following within the first 12-18 months:

  • Consistently achieve or exceed quarterly and annual sales goals.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline with strong qualification discipline and forecast accuracy.
  • Secure new client wins and establish a foundation for long-term account growth.
  • Expand revenue within existing accounts through strategic upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Develop opportunities that introduce clients to multiple NIQ solutions, supporting broader platform adoption.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in managing complex sales cycles from prospecting through contract execution.
  • Build expertise in Retail Merchandising Analytics and adjacent solution areas, including retail media and commerce innovation.
  • Establish strong working relationships with account teams, Product Area Experts, Customer Success, and implementation partners.
  • Deliver a high-quality client experience that supports retention, growth, and long-term value creation.

US Benefits

  • Comprehensive healthcare plan (medical, Rx, dental, and vision).
  • Flexible spending accounts and a Health Savings Account (including company contributions).
  • Life and AD&D insurance.
  • 401(k) retirement plan including company matching contributions.
  • Disability insurance.
  • Tuition Reimbursement.
  • Discretionary paid time off program and 11 paid holidays.
  • Flexible working environment
  • Volunteer time off
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

raw.description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

Position summary

Nava is at the forefront of reimagining how our government serves its people, and we’re looking for a Program Manager to lead the delivery and client engagement efforts on a group of strategic contracts.

At Nava, members of the Program leadership team are responsible for client trust and relationships, team clarity and health, staffing, contract management / profit & loss, and organic growth. Details are in the What You'll Do section below.

Nava's Program Managers have 5+ years of experience overseeing delivery outcomes and client relationships for a set of small- to medium-sized projects to create positive delivery environments.

What you'll do

  • Exceed the expectations of our government partners by cultivating strong, trusting relationships and maintaining high situational awareness at the agency level
  • Proactively detect risks and work collaboratively with the delivery team and program stakeholders to effectively resolve them (issues can span delivery, process, culture, expectation setting, staffing, contract milestones, finances)
  • Engage our clients on a continuing basis to ensure their needs are met or exceeded, understand their vision, collaboratively solve issues, and communicate our progress transparently
  • Maintain awareness of the broader project landscape and potential for new opportunities and risks and grow your portfolio accordingly with surge contract line item numbers (CLINs), option years, and negotiations with prime contractors
  • Collaborate across projects and across the organization to proactively anticipate and solve problems across delivery
  • Support the creation of delivery environments built on mutual trust between government partners and our team
  • Scale efforts through a team of project managers and other functional delivery leads
  • Manage all the contracts and finances on within your portfolio in coordination with the finance team and coordinate necessary contract modifications
  • Set and uphold standards for delivery excellence and client service
  • Apply Nava's policies and guidance at the program level (E.g. utilization guidance)
  • Participate in developing on and delivering company objectives and key results

Required skills

  • Experience with Custom Software or Cloud infrastructure programs/projects
  • Experience working with or for government agencies
  • Experience with growing agile development teams and the challenges of managing a project at scale
  • Ability to demonstrate experience leading projects with significant complexity, including managing milestones, dependencies, and integrations with significant risk, uncertainty or scale
  • Experience using agile frameworks like scrum, kanban, or SAFe and familiarity with agile development practices such as continuous integration and continuous delivery
  • You are an empathetic communicator and relationship builder – you take a service-oriented approach to supporting the program team and our clients
  • Adaptable problem solving and ability to deal with multi-dimensional challenges involving many organizations, processes, cultures, and technologies
  • You are highly organized and care deeply about building and growing a sustainable, culture-conscious business
  • A strategic approach to delivery planning and contract management over the medium-term and long-term
  • An iterative approach to execution that emphasizes rapid team progress.
  • Ability to maintain broader situational awareness beyond the immediate team
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Occasional travel

Desired skills

  • Program Management experience within a government space
  • Experience launching new production systems with high public visibility
  • Experience with long term, complex, and ambiguous IT modernization efforts.
  • Experience with using common project management tools like Jira and Confluence
  • Project management in a government context
  • Track record of introducing and expanding agile transformation and pursuing best practices in project management with clients and stakeholders
  • Experience managing projects that provide production operations and support alongside ongoing product/feature development
Compensation
$138,600—$154,000 USD

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States
Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future
May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs
Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost
Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge
Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO
Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus
Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home
Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools
Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)
Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest
401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan
Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities
Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs
Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses
Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills
Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs
Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team
Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable
Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states:
Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin
*If you are not living in one of the states listed above, unfortunately, you will not be considered for a position at this time.

Stay in touch

Sign up for our newsletter to find out about career opportunities, new partnerships, and news from the broader civic tech community.
Please contact the recruiting team at if you would like to request any form of reasonable accommodation during the application or interviewing process.
We participate in E-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. This role requires you to work from the contiguous United States.

raw.description:
QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What you'll do:

Job Overview

The Director of Commodities Procurement will lead lumber and wood products sourcing strategy, manage supplier relationships, and support operating companies with market insight, purchasing guidance, and supply continuity. This role requires strong commodity market expertise, disciplined negotiation, and the ability to deliver quality products at competitive costs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Marketing Analysis & Forecasting: Monitor lumber futures, cash markets, and economic trends to anticipate supply, demand, and pricing shifts.
  • Strategic Procurement: Source dimension lumber, engineered wood, OSB, plywood, and specialty products to meet cost, margin, and service objectives.
  • Vendor Relations & Negotiations: Negotiate pricing, delivery, payment terms, and volume programs with mills, brokers, and secondary suppliers.
  • Inventory Management: Partner with operating companies to balance inventory, improve turns, reduce carrying costs, and prevent stockouts.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Advise operating company procurement teams on market changes, sourcing opportunities, availability, and anticipated price movement.
  • Performance Tracking: Monitor supplier performance, order fulfillment, and product quality or warranty issues.
  • Distribution Strategy: Identify reload center opportunities to support volume purchasing and efficient redistribution to local operating companies.

.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 8-10+ years of experience in procurement, commodity trading, or category management, with a focus on lumber and building materials.
  • Strong understanding of lumber manufacturing, grades, species, and the building materials supply chain.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build vendor relationships and advise internal teams.
  • Strong quantitative skills and the ability to interpret market data to support profitable purchasing decisions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration required; supply chain or forestry training preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and LBM industry ERP systems.

What you'll earn

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
  • Paid training and certifications
  • Legal assistance and identity protection
  • Pet insurance
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)

QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

Product Owner (Sr Stf) - Product Lifecycle Enablement

The Product Lifecycle Enablement organization is responsible for Enterprise PLM capabilities and processes, Engineering data strategy and implementation, and establishing common ontology & interfaces that enable 1LMX Digital Thread and embedded Al solutions.​

What You Will Be Doing:

In this role, you will be accountable for one or multiple projects within this portfolio. Primary responsibilities include the following:

  • Manage engineering technical, cost and schedule performance
  • Coordinate the planning, organizing, control, integration and completion of projects within area of assigned responsibility
  • Collaborating with all levels of personnel within the team, other functional departments, and Business Area subject matter experts
  • Assist product managers and leadership with monitoring and evaluating project progress and problem solving, including developing and assisting in managing detailed project plans, timelines, and technical content
  • Support other duties as assigned by product manager including execution of program management duties

Further Information About This Opportunity:
This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to program requirements.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience leading systems engineering, project management, or technical-leadership functions.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of product lifecycle management processes, including bill of material generation, process planning, CAD, and configuration management.
  • Experience with Dassault 3DX, PTC Windchill, and/or Siemens Teamcenter
  • Demonstrated knowledge of model-based engineering and system architecture
  • Experience supporting enterprise software implementation or digital transformation
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience.
  • US Citizenship is required ude to program requirements

Desired Skills

  • Demonstrated success in implementing process improvements
  • Familiarity with a wide variety of engineering tools and processes
  • Demonstrated ability to work across organization boundaries to leverage best practices and share assets
  • Proficiency with Agile and DevSecOps tools and management principles.
  • Ability to multi-task and work independently, as well as work collaboratively with teams, some of which may be geographically distributed.
  • Initiative and ability to quickly acquire knowledge.

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $116100.00 - $215700.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.

Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. raw.description:
Position Summary

The Value-Based Care Account Manager is an externally facing role in CVAUSA's Value-Based Care division that manages partnerships under total cost of care, sub-capitation cardiology, bundled payment, and pay-for-performance (P4P) arrangements. This role builds strong partner relationships, drives strategic alignment, participates in Joint Operating Committees, and ensures every contractual obligation and performance metric is met so both CVAUSA and its partners realize the value of the agreement.
  • Location: Remote; preference for Eastern time zone; 25% travel
  • Direct reports: None; works closely with the Value-based care team, Clinical Operations, Medical Economics, Data & Analytics, and Finance

About CVAUSA

AtCardiovascular Associates of America (CVAUSA), we believe the total cost of cardiovascular care is too high. The best way to find and remove avoidable cost is to equip cardiovascular physicians with new care models and new financial incentives through risk-based contracts.

CVAUSA's value-based care division supports partner practices in transforming care models to improve quality, achieve the triple aim, and implement risk-based contracting. We are passionate about expanding access to evidence-based chronic disease care and building durable payment models that reward clinicians for delivering the right care, in the right place, at the right time.

Key Responsibilities

Partner and payer relationship management
  • Serve as the liaison between the payer/health plan or health system, the CVAUSA value-based care team, and the practice in value-based care arrangements.
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key partner stakeholders.
  • Understand partner needs and priorities and identify opportunities for innovation and collaboration.
  • Work with payers to identify, communicate, and resolve data discrepancies.
  • Identify and surface to key team stakeholders’ additional business opportunities in partner relationships.
Operational oversight
  • Collaborate with the CVAUSA value-based care team on program operations and ongoing client relationships.
  • Ownership of Joint Operating Committee (JOC) meetings to align goals, performance, and issue resolution; collaborate for JOC materials with Medical Economics, Data & Analytics, Operations, and Leadership.
  • Monitor contract performance and identify risks and improvement opportunities; partner with value-based care team on metric outlier management.
  • Track quality, utilization, and total-cost-of-care results against each contract's targets, including shared savings and downside-risk terms.
  • Track and manage quality performance throughout the contract year to validate payer reconciliation data.
Strategic alignment
  • Understand the financial, clinical, and operational drivers of risk-bearing cardiology agreements.
  • Work with analytics, medical economics, clinical operations, and finance teams to track outcomes, support decisions, and drive partner satisfaction.
  • Proactively pursue opportunities to optimize performance under existing agreements.
  • Understand partner objectives that may shape future contract renewals.
Reporting and communication
  • Prepare and present performance updates, recommendations, and action plans to internal leadership and external partners.
  • Ensure timely, transparent communication of risks, challenges, and achievements.
  • Engage a broad spectrum of healthcare stakeholders, communicating at both the strategic and the tactical level.

Qualifications

Required
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, healthcare management, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare account management, provider relations, or a related field, with experience in value-based care.
  • Value-based care experience with Medicare Advantage plans.
  • Proven ability to manage complex partnerships and drive outcomes in risk-bearing arrangements (total cost of care, sub-capitation, bundled payments).
  • Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and build consensus among diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills; able to manage multiple priorities at once.
  • Ability to operate effectively within health plan environments and adapt to the different structures, requirements, and terms of each plan and contract.
  • Familiarity with specialty value-based care clinical operations and financial modeling.
  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint; comfortable working from BI dashboards.
Preferred
  • Experience in cardiology or another specialty-focused value-based care model.
  • Experience with athenahealth or other ambulatory EHRs and with care management or remote patient monitoring platforms.
  • Prior work at an MSO, ACO, risk-bearing provider group, or health plan.
  • Project management certification (PMP, Lean/Six Sigma) or equivalent experience running cross-functional implementations.

Core Competencies

  • Relationship management: Earns trust with health plan, payer, and contract counterparts — and with practice partners — while staying calm and constructive in escalations
  • Analytical fluency: Reads claims and quality data accurately, spots trends early, and turns numbers into a short list of actions
  • Clinical and financial literacy: Understands cardiovascular care pathways well enough to connect clinical workflow changes to cost and quality outcomes
  • Execution: Runs multiple contracts and workstreams at once, keeps commitments, and closes the loop on every action item
  • Communication: Presents clearly to audiences ranging from front-desk staff to C-suite executives
  • Problem solving: Identifies root causes behind missed targets and brings practical fixes rather than reports of the problem
  • Adaptability: Operates well in a fast-growing organization where processes are still being built

Working Conditions and Compensation

  • Work setting: Fully remote, with a preference for candidates in the Eastern time zone.
  • Travel: 25%, including visits to partner organizations and in-person meetings.
  • Schedule: Full-time, standard business hours with occasional early or late meetings to accommodate partner and clinical schedules.
  • Compensation: Competitive base salary plus an annual performance bonus tied to contract outcomes.
  • Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k) with company match; paid time off and holidays; professional development support.
Fully remote, with a preference for candidates in the Eastern time zone.
