raw.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

Join a collaborative development team working on a SCADA system used by dispatchers around the clock to balance a power perimeter across Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands. The platform is being expanded to cover a wider geographical area and to integrate additional smaller, flexible assets.

The team develops tools for the real-time control of power plants, the integration of flexibility assets and compliance with European grid codes in support of the energy transition. These tools are used to:

  • Monitor production assets and the available capacity of power plants.
  • Exchange information between TSOs and the real-time SCADA system, or Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition system.
  • Calculate real-time setpoints for power plants based on the production plan, real-time acquisition and other inputs such as FCR, aFRR and mFRR, helping to keep the power perimeter in balance.

FCR stands for Frequency Containment Reserve, aFRR for Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve and mFRR for Manual Frequency Restoration Reserve. Similar balancing mechanisms are used in other countries.

As part of the development team, you will:

  • Develop and maintain the Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA X SYS600 platform, including custom logic and algorithms for real-time automated decision-making.
  • Write and maintain back-end logic in SCIL, the native language of the SCADA platform.
  • Design and develop clear, responsive web interfaces for dispatchers using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript or TypeScript within the MicroSCADA framework.
  • Work with Git and contribute to the further development of the SCADA landscape through ongoing projects.
  • Apply architectural design and software craftsmanship principles such as SOLID, DRY, KISS and YAGNI to create scalable, clean, maintainable and resilient code.
  • Collaborate in an Agile environment with analysts, dispatchers and technical teams.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to reduce repetitive work, generate tests, document code and understand unfamiliar parts of the code base, including during incident investigations. You remain responsible for the design and quality of the resulting work.
  • After a full onboarding, take part in a shared, compensated on-call rotation that is mostly remote, helping to ensure system availability and grid stability. Critical incidents are handled with support from the team.

Previous SCIL knowledge is not required. You will receive training and coaching from the team, and the skills you develop can be applied beyond this specific platform.

📝 Your profile

  • You have relevant experience in an industrial OT environment.
  • You are fluent in spoken and written English. This is essential for the role.
  • You care about building reliable software and systems.

💼 Offer

You will be part of a growing Belgian SME where initiative and personal development are encouraged. We will provide you with an enjoyable work environment with fun colleagues. We will work out a career plan with you, with attention and a budget for extra education/certification. You can count on an attractive salary, supplemented with extra-legal benefits, including a company car.

(Freelance is also possible)

$65,000–$80,000 base plus commission; total compensation in the $115-135,000 range for the right candidate

Location: Remote, United States (nationwide territory)

The Opportunity

If you already sell waterproofing or building envelope products and have the relationships to prove it, this role pays you to use them.

A manufacturer of peel-and-stick membranes, expansion and swelling tapes, and related waterproofing materials is adding a Technical Sales Manager focused on new business. This is a hunter role. You'll find, open, and grow accounts across a nationwide territory, and your earnings move with the business you bring in.

You can live anywhere in the U.S. if you already know the products and the market. Experienced hires typically need only occasional visits to the company's Rochester headquarters.

You won't just be pushing a catalog. The company manufactures its own products and can produce other materials, including coated nonwovens. When a large customer needs a complete program, you'll be the person who puts it together.

Why This Opportunity Is Worth a Look

  • Commission tied to what you produce. The plan pairs a base salary with a performance-based commission, so your results show up directly in your pay.
  • Location flexibility. The territory is nationwide, and an experienced seller can be based anywhere in the country.
  • Direct line to the decision-maker. You'll report to, and work closely with, the sales leader who is hiring for this role.
  • Manufacturer-level backing. You'll sell for the company that makes the products, which can produce materials beyond its standard line.
  • Broad application range. Foundations, building facades, windows and doors, pillars, bridges, and tunnels give you both commercial building and infrastructure work to pursue.

What Your Week Looks Like

  • Prospecting and opening new accounts across a national territory, with significant travel
  • Meeting with contractors, distributors, specifiers, and manufacturers about waterproofing and building envelope applications
  • Presenting peel-and-stick membranes, expansion tapes, and swelling tapes for below-grade, facade, fenestration, and infrastructure uses
  • Building complete offerings for larger customers, including product selection, marketing, packaging, and labeling
  • Working closely with your manager to move opportunities from first conversation to production orders
  • Developing a pipeline you own and expanding it over time

What We're Looking For

  • A proven track record of generating your own leads and closing new business
  • Technical sales experience in construction waterproofing, building envelope, sealants, membranes, or adhesive tapes
  • Working knowledge of peel-and-stick, expansion, or swelling tape products and how they're used in foundations, facades, windows and doors, or civil structures
  • Established relationships in the industry, ideally with an existing book of business
  • Comfort managing larger, multi-part customer programs as well as straightforward product sales
  • Willingness to travel substantially nationwide

Candidates who are new to these products will need time on-site with the company to learn the line. Remote candidates should already have strong product and industry knowledge.

Why Candidates Say Yes

This role gives an experienced technical seller three things: a nationwide territory, a manufacturer behind the product, and a commission plan where business you bring in raises your pay. If you've built strong relationships in waterproofing or building envelope and want your next role to pay you for them, it's worth a conversation.

Ready to Explore?

If you're an experienced technical salesperson who brings in your own business, we'd like to talk with you about the details.

Great Bay Staffing represents candidates with complete confidentiality. Your resume will never be shared with a client without your knowledge and approval.

raw.title: Enterprise Knowledge Modeler
raw.excerpt: Summary/ObjectiveQellus is looking for a curious, thoughtful problem-solver who enjoys giving ideas structure and helping a team turn them into something useful and lasting.
raw.description:
Summary/Objective
Qellus is looking for a curious, thoughtful problem-solver who enjoys giving ideas structure and helping a team turn them into something useful and lasting. As part of an innovative Agile product team, you will bring a natural inclination for organization, quality and follow-through to the development of new solutions and methods.
You will be part of a product team that designs, builds and maintains Qellus’s knowledge core: a governed, connected foundation of business process and information models, reference architecture, shared definitions and relationships. It connects how a business works, the capabilities it needs, and the enterprise systems that support it. You will help keep this knowledge coherent, trustworthy and reusable. Your work will include creating and maintaining these models, investigating gaps and inconsistencies, and applying standards that help the foundation evolve sustainably. You will also contribute to the solutions and methods built on it.
You will work collaboratively with architectural and technical colleagues, contribute your own observations and ideas, and progressively take ownership as your understanding grows. Mentorship and practical experience will support your development in our models, methods and tools.

What Success Looks LikeEarly success means helping turn a defined enterprise process into a standard, reusable, and governed product that the team can use to work more efficiently and generate customer value more quickly. It is important that the product be built on foundational standards so that the product can be scaled to other areas without each new process starting from scratch. As the foundation grows, those practices help the team reuse, sustain and scale its solutions and methods.
Over time, you’ll take increasing ownership of the core and agreed aspects of the work built on it. Your judgment, investigation and follow-through make established work less dependent on repeated direction. Colleagues can rely on you to protect quality, improve how the work is done and help innovations become dependable, reusable practices that create value.

The role is fully internally focused for a minimum of six months. Architectural direction and specialist support will guide work as its scope develops.

Essential Functions

  • Build out and maintain the core’s connected models and reference architecture within the team's established metamodel and architectural direction, investigating definitions and relationships so the foundation remains coherent and reusable.
  • Investigate proposed reference architecture, definitions, relationships and gaps, applying enterprise architecture principles and established frameworks alongside evidence to make sound recommendations and improvements.
  • Collaborate on solutions and methods that apply the core, helping turn approved backlog items into repeatable practices that deliver value.
  • Apply and improve governance and quality practices so the team can innovate on a trustworthy foundation.
  • Use AI-assisted workflows thoughtfully, combining exploration with careful judgment about the quality and usefulness of their outputs.
  • Help colleagues understand and use the foundation, share learning and follow improvements through to practical adoption.

Skills, Education and Experience

Required Skills, Education, and Experience
  • Skills
    • Purposeful curiosity. You enjoy exploring unfamiliar subjects, ask why things work as they do, and investigate relationships and consequences before settling on an answer.
    • A natural instinct for structure. You see patterns, clarify definitions and recognize when something does not fit. You understand how standards and frameworks help good ideas become dependable, reusable practices.
    • Creativity with practical judgment. You see possibilities and suggest better approaches while considering their implications. You know when to investigate further, involve another perspective or move a useful piece of work forward.
    • Discipline and completion. You organize your work, pay attention to meaningful detail, document decisions and follow through. You find satisfaction in making an improvement last as well as getting it started.
    • Ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, including investigating problems, seeking help when needed and staying involved through resolution.
    • Humble confidence. You question assumptions respectfully, explain your reasoning, acknowledge uncertainty and learn from others. You can contribute a concern before you have a complete solution.
    • Collaborative energy. You share knowledge, welcome different expertise and help the team succeed. You connect the quality of your work to its usefulness for colleagues and, ultimately, customers.
  • Education
    • Bachelor's degree in MIS, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience
    • 3-5+ years of experience in the fields of data science, architecture or data process
    • Demonstrated ability to create and maintain simple business process and information models within established standards.
    • Relevant professional experience working with structured information, business processes, models, quality or governance. We are interested in examples of how you applied standards thoughtfully, investigated an inconsistency, improved a practice or made information more useful to others.
    • Demonstrated ability to reason about relationships and downstream effects, communicate findings clearly and use everyday digital tools carefully.
    • Experience maintaining or improving an existing framework can demonstrate this foundation.
    • We will support your learning of our tools and specific metamodel along with the domain and workflow knowledge needed for the role.
Preferred Skills, Education and Experience
  • Experience with enterprise systems or information management systems, such as SAP or OpenText; enterprise architecture tools such as Signavio or LeanIX; or work involving structured models, process relationships and AI-assisted knowledge workflows can be helpful.
  • Exposure to process modeling with BPMN or to frameworks such as APQC or TOGAF.
  • Prior experience with these platforms or frameworks is helpful rather than required; curiosity about learning and applying them is important.
What we ValueAt Qellus, how you work matters as much as what you deliver. We're looking for someone who reflects our core values day to day:
  • Own The Outcome - Do what it takes to get it done. Own our commitments.
  • Focus on Customer Success - Earn the role of trusted advisor, committed to continuous improvement and tangible results for our Customers.
  • Problem Solver - Actively focus our skills and experience to creatively seek out effective solutions. View challenges as opportunities to innovate and improve.
  • Humbly Confident - Self-assured and modest. Always prepared and ready to make a difference, without arrogance.
  • The Qellus Principle - Work together as a collective team, sharing our unique talents to create something truly amazing. We push each other to be our best and achieve things that wouldn't be possible alone.

AI Disclaimer

We understand that candidates may use AI and other tools to prepare application materials. Candidates should be prepared to discuss and substantiate the experience, skills, technical knowledge, and accomplishments represented in their application. Our selection process may include position-specific questions, technical discussions, practical exercises, and other assessments to evaluate demonstrated capabilities. Misrepresentation of qualifications, experience, or individual contributions may result in disqualification from consideration.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Performance Bonus
  • Long-term Incentive Plan (LTIP)
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays + floating holidays
  • Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • Personal Leave
  • Applicable state leaves
  • Short- and long-term Disability
  • Company-paid life insurance and AD&D
  • Employee-paid supplement life insurance
  • Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) program
  • Professional growth and development
  • Client referral incentive

raw.excerpt: Turnitin is seeking a forward-thinking global HR executive to lead People Operations and its continued transformation.
raw.description:
Turnitin is seeking a forward-thinking global HR executive to lead People Operations and its continued transformation. Reporting to the Chief People Experience Officer, this role oversees Global People Shared Services, Benefits, HR Systems and Analytics, and Employee Relations operations, including our external ER partnership. The role will also lead the planned integration of global Payroll operations from Finance.

We are looking for a leader who can design organizations, build capability and create leverage through effective structures, systems, technology and people. This includes challenging legacy ways of working, testing hypotheses, making fact-based investment decisions and using AI and automation to simplify work and improve productivity.

Our environment is global, remote-first and evolving. Success requires someone who can lead through ambiguity, constructively challenge assumptions, make decisions with imperfect information and translate complex problems into practical solutions.

This leader must bring deep operational expertise, sound employee relations judgment, proven HR technology transformation experience and the ability to develop a strong leadership bench. The expectation is not simply to maintain operations, but to build a more scalable, resilient and accountable People Experience function. This leader will also serve as a trusted adviser to the CPXO and senior leadership, bringing independent judgment, sound business acumen and practical solutions to complex operational, organizational and employee matters. They will anticipate risks, offer constructive challenge and help translate business priorities into effective People practices.

What You Will Do

Global People Shared Services & Operational Excellence

  • Lead global People Shared Services across employee lifecycle operations, onboarding, offboarding, leaves, immigration coordination and employee support.
  • Lead the design and continuous improvement of the People Shared Services (PSS) delivery model, establishing clear ownership, decision rights, escalation protocols and accountability within PSS, while partnering with PBPs, COEs and external providers to ensure effective handoffs, coordination and service delivery.
  • Evaluate organizational structure, staffing, spans of control and work allocation to improve service effectiveness, productivity and management capacity.
  • Build scalable operations through standardization, self-service, documented procedures, cross-training and succession coverage.
  • Establish performance measures that identify service gaps, recurring issues, operational risk and opportunities to redirect work to more effective delivery channels.

Employee Relations, Governance & Risk

  • Lead the global Employee Relations operating model, including governance, quality and performance of external ER partners.
  • Bring strong judgment and practical expertise to complex employee matters, including investigations, performance, restructuring, separations and employment risk.
  • Establish clear decision rights, case ownership, service standards and escalation protocols in partnership with Legal and People Business Partners.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness and economics of the ER delivery model, building internal expertise and alternatives to external providers where appropriate.
  • Anticipate emerging employee risks and operational vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate intervention before matters escalate unnecessarily.
  • Establish effective ER case management, tracking and reporting, including case volumes, themes, resolution timelines, outcomes and recurring risks to inform continuous improvement.
  • Strengthen the operational management of employee separations and HR offboarding, ensuring clear ownership, timely coordination, consistent documentation and effective partnership across PSS, PBPs, Legal and external providers.

HR Technology, AI & Digital Transformation

  • Lead HRIS modernization, including strategy, selection, implementation, integration, adoption and ongoing optimization.
  • Reimagine the People service model using AI, automation and integrated systems to reduce administrative work, improve self-service and create capacity for higher-value activities.
  • Expand AI-enabled employee and manager support, knowledge management, case routing, workflow automation and workforce analytics.
  • Establish reliable People data, reporting and governance, including appropriate security, privacy and responsible AI controls.
  • Develop fact-based business cases, test hypotheses through pilots and measure productivity, adoption, service improvements and return on investment.
  • Challenge technology investments that automate inefficient processes without first addressing underlying organizational or workflow issues.

Global Benefits & Payroll Transformation

  • Lead global Benefits operations, including administration, enrollment, vendor performance, financial stewardship and employee experience.
  • Design and implement an integration plan for global Payroll operations from Finance, including organizational structure, resourcing, systems, controls and transition readiness.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal and IT to strengthen Payroll governance, compliance, accuracy and integration with People systems.
  • Evaluate opportunities to standardize, simplify and automate Benefits and Payroll processes while protecting service continuity and financial controls.
  • Build sustainable functional leadership and operational coverage across both areas.

People Leadership, Organizational Design & Enterprise Partnership

  • Assess capabilities and capacity against future operating requirements, making evidence-based recommendations to build, buy, automate, or redesign work.
  • Lead effectively in a Remote-First environment, establishing strong operating rhythms, communication, collaboration and accountability across countries and time zones.
  • Partner with the CPXO, PXLT, Finance, Legal and IT on business-critical decisions, operational risks and transformation priorities.
  • Bring forward well-supported recommendations, welcome constructive challenge and adapt plans when new evidence warrants a different approach.
  • Maintain operational performance while implementing organizational change, balancing speed, employee experience, risk and financial discipline.
  • 15+ years of progressive global HR leadership experience, including senior accountability for HR Operations, Shared Services or organizational transformation.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required. Advanced degree or relevant HR or Employment Legal qualification / JD preferred.
  • Strong understanding of global Benefits, Payroll operations, HR compliance and employee lifecycle services.
  • Trusted advisor to C-suite (including Chief People Experience Officer) and senior business leaders, demonstrating strong business acumen and balancing of business objectives and priorities.
  • Demonstrated organizational design expertise, including restructuring teams, developing management capacity, establishing decision rights and improving spans of control and operational leverage.
  • Deep Employee Relations expertise, with sound judgment in complex matters, employment risk, external provider oversight and development of internal ER capability.
  • Proven leadership of significant HRIS implementations or transformations, including systems integration, process redesign, automation and adoption.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI, automation or intelligent technologies to improve employee self-service, knowledge management, case management, workflow execution, analytics or operational productivity.
  • Strong financial and analytical acumen, including building fact-based business cases, testing assumptions, evaluating service delivery alternatives and demonstrating measurable returns.
  • Proven ability to build strong leadership teams, develop successors, address capability gaps and reduce operational dependency on individual employees or external providers.
  • Experience leading global, multidisciplinary teams in Remote-First, distributed or complex matrixed environments.
  • Demonstrated resilience through organizational change, competing priorities and constructive challenge, with the ability to maintain delivery while improving how work gets done.
  • Strong executive communication, sound judgment and the ability to influence stakeholders while remaining open to alternative perspectives.

The expected annual base salary range for this position is: $245,402/year to $283,445/year. This position is bonus eligible / commission-based.

Actual compensation will be provided in writing at the time of offer, if extended, and is determined by work location and a range of other relevant factors, including but not limited to: experience, skills, degrees, licensures, certifications, and other job-related factors. Internal equity, market and organizational factors are also considered.

Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

Network Security Vulnerability Remediation Engineer – Mid-Level


Program: Army Global Unified Network (AGUN)
Location: Remote | Up to 10% Travel, *Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes, if an offer letter is extended to you.
Clearance Required: Active Secret
Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship Required


Help Protect the U.S. Army's Global Network!

Leidos is seeking an experienced Mid-Level Network Security Vulnerability Remediation Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

This is an exciting opportunity to help secure and modernize the Army's global network infrastructure, protecting critical military communications and supporting mission readiness worldwide.

In this remote role, you'll focus on identifying, analyzing, and remediating firewall vulnerabilities across a complex enterprise network. You'll work closely with network engineers, cybersecurity professionals, and mission partners to implement security patches, configuration updates, and risk mitigation solutions.

We're looking for a hands-on Network Security Engineer with strong firewall experience, preferably Palo Alto, who can develop, test, and implement vulnerability fixes while maintaining network security and performance.


What You'll Do

  • Analyze and remediate firewall vulnerabilities and cybersecurity risks across enterprise network environments.
  • Evaluate vulnerability findings, vendor security advisories, software updates, and patches.
  • Develop, test, and implement firewall security patches, configuration changes, and mitigation solutions.
  • Execute approved firewall changes and vendor updates through established ASI and change-management processes.
  • Configure and maintain firewall security policies, access control lists (ACLs), NAT, security zones, and network segmentation.
  • Troubleshoot firewall connectivity, policy conflicts, performance issues, and security-related incidents.
  • Perform firewall upgrades, patching, configuration management, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Collaborate with Information Assurance teams and the AGUN Cybersecurity Service Provider (CSSP) to address security risks and maintain compliance.
  • Implement and validate DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and network security hardening requirements.
  • Support vulnerability assessments, remediation planning, and corrective-action activities.
  • Develop vulnerability assessments, patch/upgrade analyses, mitigation configurations, testing results, and production release plans.
  • Document remediation activities, ASI execution results, configuration changes, and ticket closure evidence.
  • Maintain firewall configuration records, network diagrams, and technical procedures.
  • Work independently on assigned engineering tasks while collaborating with senior engineers on complex technical issues.

What We're Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related field with 4–8 years of relevant experience, or approximately 8–12 years of experience without a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (such as Security+) and an approved Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise firewall configuration, management, troubleshooting, patching, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Experience with Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), preferably Palo Alto Networks.
  • Strong understanding of firewall security policies, ACLs, NAT, security zones, and network segmentation.
  • Experience supporting firewall migrations, security policy changes, or enterprise network modernization.
  • Knowledge of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, IPSec, VPNs, and Layer 2/Layer 3 routing.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and secure remote access technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting firewall policy conflicts, network connectivity, and security performance issues.
  • Familiarity with Palo Alto Panorama, Cisco management platforms, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience implementing DoD STIGs, network security hardening, and cybersecurity compliance requirements.
  • Experience developing technical documentation, firewall configuration records, and network security diagrams.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with geographically dispersed technical teams.
  • Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts when needed.
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Army, DISA, or other DoD enterprise networks.
  • Palo Alto Networks security certification (such as PCNSE or a current equivalent), CCNA, or CCNP.
  • Experience with large-scale firewall migrations and security policy conversions.
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, and GlobalProtect.
  • Experience with Cisco Secure Firewall, Juniper SRX, or other enterprise firewall platforms.
  • Experience with ZTNA solutions such as AppGate.
  • Knowledge of SD-WAN, MPLS, and enterprise network segmentation.
  • Experience with firewall rule optimization and security configuration validation.
  • Familiarity with virtualized firewalls, cloud security, and hybrid networks.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.
  • Experience with Python scripting for network security automation.
  • Experience using Wireshark, tcpdump, or similar troubleshooting tools.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management, RMF, and security compliance processes.
  • Experience supporting large, geographically dispersed enterprise networks.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to apply your network engineering and cybersecurity expertise to a mission that directly supports the U.S. Army's global operations.

You'll collaborate with experienced network engineers and cybersecurity professionals, solve complex security challenges, and help protect critical military infrastructure.

If you're a cleared Network Security Engineer with hands-on firewall vulnerability remediation, patching, and security hardening experience, we'd like to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help secure the Army's global network. Apply today!

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Staff Product Management, horizon 2 innovation on Twilio’s Emerging Technology and Innovation.

About the job

At Twilio, our team is dedicated to identifying, exploring, and developing disruptive new products and platforms that anticipate what the world will need three to five years ahead. We unite world-class product, engineering, design, and research talent to transform ambitious concepts into market-defining realities. As Principal Product Manager for Horizon 2, you’ll be instrumental in shaping our Horizon 2 impact and accelerating our company’s growth.

We are seeking a visionary and entrepreneurial leader passionate about finding white space opportunity and being able to shape the “approach to unlock”. In this role, you will focus on Horizon 2 growth opportunities- identifying, sizing, and helping unlock untapped markets, verticals, and use cases. Your mandate is to look across current and nascent product lines, competitive landscape, and geographies to actively scout these whitespace opportunities for growth.

Your success is measured by your ability to identify growth opportunities and plays against it.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Define Horizon 2 strategy and sales plays: Deeply understand our product portfolio and current market dynamics to identify opportunities for growth in the next 1-3 years including the sales play
  • Vision & Foresight: Provide market and technology intelligence, connecting external trends, customer “weak signals,” and internal capabilities to identify transformational product opportunities
  • Market Research: Gather market intelligence, analyze usage patterns, and synthesize insights from early testing to inform ongoing product direction
  • Ecosystem research: ability to understand the partner ecosystem to identify the right partners and ecosystem players to work with to unlock opportunity
  • Inorganic opportunity identification: identify opportunities for growth via inorganic paths that could accelerate product expansion and near term growth
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong partnerships across R&D, go-to-market, and corporate strategy functions
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate strategic vision, product rationale, and outcomes to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  • Strong analytical, conceptual, and user research skills; data-driven but comfortable with ambiguity and hypothesis-driven decision making

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity, identifying opportunity in uncertainty, and learning from failure as well as success
  • Strategic influence and executive communication skills; able to “sell the future,” align diverse stakeholders, and champion big, unconventional ideas
  • Passion for inclusion, equity, and building a world-class innovation culture
  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Desired:

  • Experience working with AI ML technology and customer engagement platforms
  • Experience working in trust, security, or fraud prevention

Location

This role will be remote and based in the United States.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until Feb 1, 2027 but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

.

raw.description:
Customer Implementation Manager

This role sits at the intersection of project management, healthcare operations, customer success, and deployment execution. Implementation Managers are responsible not only for getting Canopy installed, but for ensuring each customer is operationally ready, clinically prepared, technically stable, and demonstrating healthy early adoption before transitioning into long-term Customer Success.

You will serve as the primary customer lead during implementation, managing multiple workstreams across large health systems and coordinating stakeholders spanning Clinical Operations, Security, IT, HR, Communications, Training, Facilities, and executive leadership.

Before services begin, you will own the path to readiness: defining the implementation plan, driving customer deliverables, assessing workflows, helping determine the right program design, coordinating site walkthroughs and installations, and ensuring technical and operational dependencies are completed.

After go-live, your responsibility continues through stabilization. You will use customer sentiment, adoption data, system stability, and infrastructure health to determine whether the program is operating as designed and intervene when it is not. The Implementation Manager remains accountable until the customer meets defined stabilization criteria and is ready for a structured handoff to Customer Success.

Success in this role means delivering more than an on-time implementation. It means launching a healthy, adopted, sustainable program that customers trust and that creates the foundation for long-term value and expansion.

About Canopy

Canopy is committed to creating safer and more supportive environments for those on the front lines of care. Our mission is to help hospitals ensure that healthcare workers feel safe, appreciated, and empowered every day to deliver the highest quality of care.

We develop and deploy critical safety technology, including our wearable duress system and Real-Time Location System (RTLS) portfolio, delivered as a comprehensive service to enterprise healthcare systems across the United States.

Join our collaborative, mission-focused team and use your implementation expertise to make a real difference in the lives of those who care for others.

Key Responsibilities

Own the customer from kickoff through stabilization

  • Be the primary customer lead from kickoff through stabilization. Build confidence and trust with our partners and our team.
  • Run multiple complex healthcare implementations at once, with clear ownership of commitments, dependencies, risks, decisions and next steps.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with customer project leads, clinical leaders, security teams, IT partners, executives and other stakeholders.

Plan and drive implementation readiness

  • Create, coordinate and execute project plans using Canopy's implementation playbook and best practices.
  • Set clear expectations with customers and internal teams on responsibilities, timelines, readiness requirements and success criteria.
  • Assess current workflows and help decide the right program design for each site.
  • Partner with clinical and security leaders to design alert and response workflows that fit how each unit actually works.
  • Partner with clinical leaders to build unit-level adoption plans and train clinical champions before go-live.

Lead complex healthcare deployments

  • Own every phase of the implementation: kickoff, technical configuration, installation, clinician training and go-live.
  • Coordinate site walkthroughs, hardware orders and delivery, and device installations with Canopy teams and the customer's IT, Security, Clinical, Facilities, HR, Communications/Training and executive stakeholders.
  • Hold both Canopy and customer workstreams accountable for progress toward the agreed services start or go-live date.
  • Identify and manage project risks and issues, build contingency plans, and escalate at the first sign of risk.

Protect implementation quality

  • Treat implementation quality gates as real decision points. Make sure gate requirements are met and documented, and recommend holding a phase or go-live when readiness criteria aren't met. At Canopy, a quality implementation beats a fast one.

Own post-go-live stabilization

  • Spot unhealthy trends early and use the Canopy stabilization playbook to step in. That can mean workflow changes, more training, re-engaging champions, fixing infrastructure, escalating technical issues, or bringing in leadership.

  • On a regular cadence, report health, risks, adoption metrics, time-to-value and ROI milestones to customer leadership and Canopy stakeholders, with clear next steps.

Great companies need great teams to propel their operations. Join the group that solves business challenges and enhances the way we work and grow. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values your contributions and puts a premium on work flexibility, learning, and career development.

Summary

As an Advisor Business Analyst - Claims Configuration (QNXT) at Gainwell, you will provide senior functional and technical expertise for Medicaid claims configuration within a Maintenance & Operations environment. You will translate client requirements, Medicaid policy, operational needs, and claims-processing outcomes into scalable QNXT configuration solutions while leading a team of Configuration Business Analysts.

This role requires deep hands-on QNXT configuration expertise, advanced SQL and relational database knowledge, and the ability to independently investigate complex claims issues, identify root cause, determine corrective solutions, and clearly communicate recommendations to clients, vendors, and internal cross-functional teams.

Your role in our mission

Claims Configuration Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and provide day-to-day technical direction to a team of Claims Configuration Business Analysts.
  • Serve as the senior configuration subject matter expert and trusted advisor for assigned CEF Claims M&O accounts.
  • Review configuration analysis, solution designs, implementation plans, and validation results for quality, accuracy, and downstream impact.
  • Establish consistent configuration practices, documentation standards, peer-review controls, and knowledge-transfer processes.

Client and Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Interact directly with clients, vendors, and internal business, product, development, testing, operations, finance, provider, member, and encounter teams.
  • Lead requirements discussions, configuration reviews, issue-resolution sessions, defect triage, solution walkthroughs, and operational governance discussions.
  • Translate complex technical findings into clear business impacts, options, risks, and recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.
  • Own assigned issues and enhancements from intake and analysis through implementation, validation, communication, and closure.

Configuration Analysis and Solution Design

  • Configure and support QNXT claims solutions across contracts, benefits, fee schedules, payment methodologies, capitation, business rules, claims adjudication logic, X12 transaction data requirements, and CARC/RARC processing.
  • Translate Medicaid policy, contractual requirements, and operational needs into configuration specifications, business rules, design artifacts, and acceptance criteria.
  • Assess the full impact of proposed changes across claims adjudication, pricing, benefits, provider reimbursement, encounters, remittance, financial processing, reporting, and downstream integrations.
  • Determine whether an issue is caused by configuration, data, policy interpretation, user processing, interface behavior, product functionality, or another upstream or downstream dependency.

Data Analysis, Root Cause Analysis, and Production Support

  • Write and execute complex SQL queries to analyze claims, claim lines, provider affiliations, contracts, benefits, pricing, member eligibility, edits, accumulators, encounters, and financial data.
  • Use relational database schemas and data relationships to trace system behavior and validate claims-processing outcomes.
  • Perform claim-level and population-level root cause analysis for denials, pends, unexpected edits, underpayments, overpayments, duplicate conditions, encounter rejections, and other processing anomalies.
  • Quantify impacted claims and populations, document evidence, compare expected and actual results, and recommend sustainable corrective actions.
  • Support production incidents, client inquiries, audit requests, configuration defects, data fixes, and ad hoc reporting needs.
  • Validate configuration changes through targeted data analysis, claims testing, regression review, and post-implementation monitoring.

What we're looking for

Top 3 Required Skills:

  • 9+ years of hands-on, highly proficient QNXT configuration experience, with demonstrated depth in contracts, benefits, fee schedules and multiple payment methodologies, capitation, rules, successful data points for X12 transactions, and CARC/RARC processing.
  • Thorough understanding of relational database concepts, healthcare data models, schemas, keys, and data relationships.
  • Demonstrated competency writing complex SQL queries for claims analysis, validation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and reporting.

Additional preferred skills:

  • Strong knowledge of Medicaid claims processing, claims adjudication, provider reimbursement, benefit administration, edits, pricing, and encounter processing.
  • Experience analyzing X12 healthcare transactions, including 837 and 835 transaction data and associated remittance adjustment reason codes.
  • Proven ability to independently analyze complex claim scenarios, identify root cause, assess impact, and develop actionable business and configuration solutions.
  • Experience leading or mentoring Configuration Business Analysts and reviewing technical or functional work products.
  • Strong client-facing communication, facilitation, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience working within SDLC, Agile delivery, testing, release management, and production-support environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience supporting Medicaid claims configuration in a multi-account CEF Maintenance & Operations environment.
  • Deep expertise in provider contracts, fee schedules, alternative payment methodologies, capitation, benefits, edits, and claims rules.
  • Experience with operational monitoring, trend analysis, claims inventory analysis, first-pass outcomes, denials, and reprocessing impacts.
  • Knowledge of CMS guidance, state Medicaid policy, MITA, encounter processing, financial reconciliation, and compliance considerations.
  • Experience with IT service management and work-tracking tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to balance client priorities, production risk, operational urgency, and long-term configuration sustainability.

What you should expect in this role

  • Fully remote options from most U.S. locations and territories.
  • Video cameras must be used during all interviews and during the initial week of orientation.
  • Work may include production support, priority issue resolution, scheduled releases, and coordination across multiple client and internal teams.
  • This job description may be refined to align with approved requisition, job profile, location, compensation, and Talent Acquisition requirements.
  • Photo will be taken during screening for verification in all steps of the recruitment process.
  • This posting is intended for pipelining. This is a developing position therefore the job description is subject to change.

Please ensure you join all screenings, interviews and meetings from a quiet location with a stable internet connection.

Video is required for screenings and interviews, so please test your camera and microphone in advance.

Do not use AI tools, virtual backgrounds/filters, or visual enhancements during the interview.

The pay range for this position is $86,800 - $124,000 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Put your passion to work at Gainwell. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. All salaried, full-time candidates are eligible for our generous, flexible vacation policy, a 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, and educational assistance. We also have a variety of leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

We believe nothing is impossible when you bring together people who care deeply about making healthcare work better for everyone. Build your career with Gainwell, an industry leader.   • Act as the first point of contact for Managed Services connectivity, troubleshooting, production issues across assigned environments and escalating high complexity challenges as appropriate.

Confirm CAB review and required change(s) with the change owner, track approvals before work proceeds and confirm completion afterward.

Requirements:

  • 1-3+ years of experience in technical support, cloud operations or systems administration. Hands-on projects, coursework or internships may be considered in level of experience.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or similar and/or equivalent working experience.
  • Strong continuous learning mindset for technical knowledge specifically Azure, AWS and Smile applications.
  • Fundamental knowledge of operating systems, networking, storage and access controls.
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts and hands-on experience troubleshooting connectivity issues.
  • Demonstrated experience understanding and executing runbooks, collecting diagnostic evidence with ability to identify when to escalate complex issues.
  • Exposure to Azure or AWS services and troubleshooting network-layer dependencies (DNS, firewall, private endpoints), including but not limited to, lab and/or academic project experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to be both self-driven and partner effectively across technical and non-technical cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to convey technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience gathering technical requirements, following change-management procedures and maintaining accurate project and support records.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles, with practical exposure to Terraform preferred.
  • Basic understanding of Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD tooling, preferred.
  • Experience reviewing logs and alerts using monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor, Amazon CloudWatch or Elastic/Kibana, preferred.
  • Demonstrated scripting skills in Bash, Python or PowerShell, preferred.
  • Associate Azure or AWS certification or in progress, preferred.

Dein Start imCommercial Excellence & Activation TeamESN & More! 

Als (Senior) Media & Shopper Activation Manager Drogerie (gn) bringst Du unsere Marken dort zum Leuchten, wo Shopper sich inspirieren lassen: in der Drogerie in Deutschland und Österreich. Du planst und setzt Aktivierungs- und Retail-Media-Maßnahmen bei unseren Drogeriepartnern um und sorgst für eine starke, hochwertige Markenpräsenz am POS, offline wie online, vom Display bis zur Onsite-Kampagne. Dabei arbeitest Du nach gemeinsamen Standards (z. B. Perfect Store, Aktivierungs-Toolkit) und entwickelst diese mit Deinen Learnings aus dem Drogeriekanal aktiv weiter.

Du hast Lust, ESN und More Nutrition – und künftig weitere Marken der Gruppe – in der Drogerie voranzutreiben? Dann melde Dich bei uns und werde Teil des Teams.

Deine Mission bei uns

  • Du entwickelst kundenspezifische POS-Kampagnen, Aktivierungen und Kooperationen für Drogerie-Shopper und setzt sie um
  • Du verantwortest den Roll-out von Displays, Zweitplatzierungen, POSM und Möbelkonzepten in Drogeriemärkten in Deutschland und Österreich, inklusive Timings und Umsetzungskontrolle in der Fläche
  • Du planst und steuerst Retail-Media-Kampagnen (Onsite, Offsite, In-Store) in enger Abstimmung mit den Media-Netzwerken unserer Drogeriepartner
  • Du befähigst KAM und Außendienst mit klaren Briefings und steuerst Design-Assets, Content, Agenturen, Display-Partner und weitere Dienstleister
  • Du misst Aktivierungen und Retail Media anhand definierter KPIs, optimierst auf Wirkung und Wirtschaftlichkeit und bringst Best Practices ins Shopper-Marketing-Playbook ein
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Brand, KAM, Außendienst, Category Management und RGM zusammen und übernimmst Teilbudgetverantwortung

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise in Marketing, Medien oder Wirtschaft
  • Du hast 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Trade- oder Shopper Marketing, in Retail Media oder Brand Activation, idealerweise im Drogeriekanal und/oder mit Premium-, Beauty- oder Luxusmarken
  • Du steuerst Projekte, Stakeholder und externe Partner souverän
  • Du arbeitest datenbasiert und sicher mit KPIs, Reporting-Tools und MS Office
  • Du bist hands-on, strukturiert und hast ein gutes Auge fürs Detail
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch und bist bereit, gelegentlich zu reisen, vor allem nach Hamburg, wo der Großteil des Teams sitzt

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.600 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich. Mit Standorten in Deutschland (Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen und Elsdorf) sowie internationalen Büros in London, Amsterdam und Zug (Schweiz) bietet TQG vielfältige Karrieremöglichkeiten in Bereichen wie Technologie, Produktentwicklung, Vertrieb, Marketing und Logistik.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN & More
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Zuschüsse zu Mobilität & Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Workation-Optionen und mehr

Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von TQG zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.

Über uns

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.

Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Identität – bei uns zählt, wer du bist und was du einbringst. Werde Teil unseres Teams und wachse mit uns.

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale.

Who We Are

At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist.

As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next.

Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader.

If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here.

Your Challenge

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will:

  • Collaborate with engineering teams at Seedtag to set direction and build platforms that enhance customer experience, while providing necessary operational support.

  • Contribute to the professional growth and performance optimization of the Platform Engineering (SRE) team by offering helpful feedback and guidance.

  • Foster and cultivate trust within the SRE team, empowering them to implement solid engineering practices and principles.

  • Ensure reliability, security and compliance of Seedtag's cloud foundations, aligned with the Google Cloud Architecture Framework and NIST/ISO controls (logging, vulnerability and secrets management, hardening, backup and restore).

  • Design, build and operate the internal developer platform (GKE, networking, IAM, CI/CD, GitOps) so product teams can ship autonomously under a "you build it, you run it" model.

  • Share knowledge, review peers' work and raise the bar on engineering practices in the team.

  • Take part in the Platform on-call rotation, lead incident response and write blameless postmortems, turning recurring issues into automation and lasting fixes.

  • Partner with engineering teams to understand their needs and communicate roadmap, trade-offs and progress transparently.

  • Operate and evolve our streaming and data infrastructure (Redpanda and self-hosted databases), including migrations, upgrades and the discontinuation of legacy components.

  • Own the observability stack (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, alerting, PagerDuty), tackling scalability problems such as high-cardinality metrics, and define SLIs/SLOs and a service maturity model with engineering teams.

  • Drive cost efficiency (FinOps): capacity planning, node and instance right-sizing, quota management and cost anomaly detection.

  • Reduce toil and enable self-service: replace tickets with tools, golden paths and reusable CI/CD workflows, and keep documentation and runbooks fresh.

  • Apply AI to platform operations: build and operate agents and automations (e.g. cost anomaly detection, PR review, incident triage), define MCP integrations, and contribute to AI governance with Security.

Our Core Values

Outcome over Output
We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code.

Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must
Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast.

We Are All Scouts
We take ownership and leave things better than we found them.

We Are Data-Driven
Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results.

Tech Stack

Our stack includes:

  • Languages & Automation: Python, Go

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, Terraform Cloud

  • CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

  • Observability: VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, PagerDuty

  • Streaming & Data: Redpanda, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis

  • Security & Networking: IAM, VPC, Cloudflare, secrets management

  • AI & Automation: LLM-based agents, MCP integrations

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Technical Experience: Minimum of 4 years of experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform/Cloud Engineering roles, preferably in large-scale, high-traffic product companies, with proven technical proficiency and the ability to engage in deep technical conversations with the team.

  • Collaboration and Prioritization: Service-oriented mindset: understands stakeholders' problems, communicates clearly and prioritizes across several concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment. Experience with Kanban or Scrum.

  • Automation and Programming: Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Go or similar) to automate operations and build internal tooling (operators, agents, CI/CD workflows).

  • Cloud Services: Deep hands-on knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent hyperscaler (VPC and peering/PSC, IAM, GKE, CloudSQL, GCS), including networking and migrations between projects or organizations.

  • Incident Management and On-call Responsibilities: Proven on-call and incident management experience, with strong problem-solving skills under pressure and a track record of root-cause analysis and blameless postmortems.

  • Kubernetes: Solid production experience with Kubernetes, ideally GKE: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, autoscaling and node pool tuning, and workload identity.

  • Infrastructure as Code and GitOps: Strong Terraform experience (Terraform Cloud a plus), GitOps (ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, self-hosted runners).

  • Observability: Experience with Prometheus-compatible stacks (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana), alerting design and SLI/SLO practices. Understanding of cardinality and scaling issues is a plus.

  • Security: Working knowledge of cloud security practices: secrets management, vulnerability and CVE remediation, hardening and least privilege.

  • Other tools and engines: Streaming platforms (Kafka/Redpanda), or other stateful systems (MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, Aerospike); Cloudflare (CDN, load balancing); compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001); FinOps and capacity planning; hands-on experience building or operating LLM-based agents or automations (e.g. ADK, MCP) and using AI tools in daily engineering work; service maturity / internal developer platform approach.

  • People-Centric Approach: Focus on understanding stakeholders problems and providing the best way to solve team.

  • Agile Methodologies: Experience working with agile development methodologies like Kanban or Scrum, promoting transparency and collaboration within the team.

  • Planning and Execution: Strong skills in roadmap planning, execution, and measuring engineering excellence through key metrics and KPIs.

  • Priority Management: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and concurrent projects effectively.

  • Cloud Services: Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other cloud services, including technologies like Terraform and Ansible, for designing and managing scalable infrastructures.

  • Incident Management and On-call Responsibilities: Previous experience in incident management and on-call responsibilities is needed. The candidate must demonstrate strong problem-solving skills under pressure and quick responsiveness to critical situations.

Why Join Seedtag?

  • A key moment of growth with real ownership and global impact.

  • Flexible work model with 100% remote or hybrid options.
    (Remote contracts available in Spain, Italy, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, France, and Germany.)

  • Continuous learning through a learning platform and optional language classes.

  • A supportive, trust-based culture that values well-being.

  • Team activities, offsites, and opportunities to connect beyond work.

Additional Perks

  • Home office setup budget up to €1,000

  • Paid trips to our HQ in Madrid

  • MacBook Pro M3

Ready to Join the Seedtag Adventure?

At Seedtag, we create an environment where everyone can thrive. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll ensure a positive experience.

Send us your CV and let’s build the future of neuro-contextual advertising together.

raw.description:
SALARY:

$20.37

POSITION TITLE:

Kansas City Regional Recruitment Coordinator

DEPARTMENT:

Admissions Recruitment

JOB DESCRIPTION:

EMPLOYMENT TERMS: Full-time, 12-month


PRIMARY DUTY:

The Kansas City Regional Recruitment Coordinator must have a passion for Northwest Missouri State University, be highly motivated, and goal-oriented to attract, recruit, and retain prospective students to meet the enrollment goals at Northwest. The desired candidate will reside in the KC metro area. Recruitment Coordinators must represent and promote Northwest Missouri State University accurately and persuasively to prospective students, parents, guidance counselors, educators and other publics within the assigned territory. Additionally, the Recruitment Coordinator assists the Admissions-Recruitment team with the administration of all campus recruitment activities.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Responsible for the coordination of recruitment and yield in Kansas City metro area.
  • This remote position will be based within the recruiting territory to attend off-campus recruitment activities (including but not limited to counselor luncheons, high school visits, college fairs, regional conferences, award presentations, and more).
  • Travels to Maryville for on-campus events and training as necessary.
  • Collaborate and work closely with Great Jobs KC-KC Scholars partnership to build and maintain positive relationships with Great Jobs KC Advocates, partner high schools, and high school counselors.
  • Assist with recruitment activities and college fairs at area community colleges to promote Northwest to prospective transfer students.
  • Responsible for the coordination and management of all virtual recruitment activities including but not limited to large group, small group, and personalized sessions with their assigned territory.
  • Create and maintain positive relationships with prospective students, parents, guidance counselors, educators, and other publics within assigned territory by providing information on academics, value, scholarships, housing, student life, and general university activities
  • Analyze student data to select which recruitment strategies and information is most effective for each prospective student.
  • Utilize data management to target select populations for all armchair recruitment activities.
  • Actively conduct armchair recruitment that occurs during all stages of the recruitment funnel. Includes contact via emails, personal notes, phone calls, texting, and social media.
  • Review, update, and utilize computer-based lead tracking systems to aid in prospective student recruitment
  • Utilize value-added and relationship-based techniques when working with prospective students, parents, guidance counselors, educators, and other publics
  • Create and achieve territorial goals and objectives based on trend data, historical reporting, and evaluation of prospect and admitted database information
  • Analyze, read, and report feedback to Admissions-Recruitment leadership with on-going competitive environment.
  • Assist with the coordination of Summer Orientation and Registration, Advantage week, and General Registration
  • Survey residents of assigned territory to assess needs of prospective students, parents, guidance counselors, educators, and other publics
  • Serve as a liaison between various internal departments in resolution of prospective students, parents, guidance counselors, educators, and other publics concerns and issues
  • Performs other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education: Undergraduate Degree


Certification/License: Driver’s license


Experience: 1-2 years of experience in the field or a related area


Skills: Extensive knowledge of colleges and universities; ability to communicate effectively with people from diverse backgrounds as well as cultivate awareness of cultural diversity; strong organizational skills; strong public speaking skills; ability to load, unload, and set up exhibits. Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs and high comfort level with technology and the ability to analyze and present data effectively.


WORKING CONDITIONS:

This position will work in a remote office environment with a work schedule determined based on service needs, which will likely include early morning, night, and/or weekend hours.


TYPICAL PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Ability to lift up to 20 pounds


COMMUNITY:

Northwest Missouri State University located in Maryville, Missouri, a community of 12,000 with a diverse economy and a strong industrial base. Maryville is located 45 miles north of St. Joseph, Missouri, 90 miles north of Kansas City, Missouri, and 110 miles southeast of Omaha, Nebraska. For more information visit the city’s website at .


UNIVERSITY:

With an enrollment of more than 8,500 students, Northwest is a coeducational, primarily residential four-year university that offers a broad range of undergraduate and selected graduate programs on its Maryville campus and through Northwest Online.

Founded in 1905, Northwest boasts a high retention rate and a graduation rate in the 95th percentile among its peers. Additionally, results of the Ruffalo Noel Levitz Student Satisfaction Inventory show Northwest students are more satisfied than students at national peers, and 78 percent of Northwest students report they would repeat their university experience, compared to 75 percent of students surveyed nationally at their respective institutions.

Furthermore, the University is a national model for student success and career placement with 93 percent of bachelor’s degree earners and 98 percent of master’s degree earners securing employment or continuing their education within six months of completing a degree at Northwest, according to the most recent data.

Northwest places a high emphasis on profession-based learning to help graduates get a jumpstart on their careers while maintaining competitive tuition rates and generous financial assistance to help minimize the financial barriers students may face when pursuing a college degree.

Students have opportunities to build their résumés with experiences on campus in nearly every area of study, including the Horace Mann Laboratory School, National Public Radio affiliate KXCV, the R.T. Wright Farm, Mozingo Outdoor Education Recreation Area, a partnership with the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency or Knacktive, a student-driven integrated digital marketing communications agency. In conjunction with its emergency and disaster management program, Northwest organizes and hosts Missouri Hope, an annual mass casualty training exercise that attracts first responders and emergency workers from throughout the nation and provides hands-on training in preparation for a natural disaster.

The University’s vibrant and diverse learning community also offers more than 150 student organizations, and textbooks and a laptop are included in tuition, saving students an estimated $6,900 over four years. Northwest offers 1,200 student employment positions, allowing students to build professional skills through its internationally benchmarked student employment program.

For more information about Northwest and its performance, visit www.nwmissouri.edu/aboutus/facts/.

raw.description:
“In 36 months, agentic AI systems will be an operating reality across major institutions. We intend to be central to it.” — Dr. Jim Rebesco, Cofounder and CEO, Striveworks

The government’s demand for AI is growing far faster than the systems required to support it. Fewer than 15% of federal AI programs have reached sustained production, despite billions of dollars invested. The models perform in testing, but they degrade in the real world. And when performance drops, trust goes with it.

Striveworks was built to solve that problem.

What you’ll build

Since 2018, we have delivered the most trusted AI systems operating in real-world use cases—providing a layer of assurance underneath hundreds of deployed models that monitors performance, manages drift, and sustains systems long after they leave the lab.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer–Maritime Systems, you will be a core contributor to both customer-driven projects and the enduring products of the company. Working directly with customers, data scientists, software engineers, and DevOps engineers, you’ll define requirements and orchestrate complex data engineering pipelines. You’ll also develop machine learning models and custom analytics applied to image, video, text, geospatial, time series, and structured data. Your work will inform the future of Chariot, our proprietary AI operations platform, and it will extend to the field, with mission-critical deployments, direct customer contact, and insights that shape what we build next.

What it’s like here

We lead with trust, treat each other with respect, and use candor consistently, kindly, and constructively. We care deeply about our work, and we find genuine satisfaction in doing it well. Above all, we take ownership—because we feel the weight of collective results personally. We are looking for people who share these values and are eager to put them into practice.

What we’re looking for

  • A BS degree in computer science, machine learning, or a related discipline and 6+ years of relevant experience
  • Demonstrated experience delivering data-centric systems
  • Proficiency in programming languages and libraries common to machine learning; excellence in Python is essential, as is knowledge of TensorFlow, PyTorch, and/or scikit-learn
  • Proficiency in software engineering fundamentals to include algorithms, data structures, design patterns, and at least one systems programming language
  • Proficiency with modern software engineering tools and processes
  • US citizenship with eligibility and willingness to obtain a Secret US security clearance

The following isn’t required, but we’d love to see it:

  • Active Secret (or above) US security clearance, a recently expired clearance, or a past clearance
  • An advanced degree in data science, machine learning, computer science, or a related discipline
  • Experience implementing and deploying software into containerized or cloud environments
  • Experience with a variety of unstructured data types

This includes planning, executing, and measuring the success of high-visibility events and customer engagement activities to build and accelerate the pipeline, ultimately driving pipeline conversion to revenue.

Strong communication skills and the ability to align marketing efforts with business goals are critical, as you'll be closely collaborating with sales, product, and technical teams to ensure seamless execution of field programs.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Ability to work seamlessly in a decentralized, cross-cultural team environment, fostering strong relationships and driving alignment toward common goals.
