raw.description:
Company Description

Candidly was founded in 2016 to flip the script on what it means to plan, borrow, repay, and save for college. Today, we’re the category leader with the market’s most comprehensive AI-driven student debt and savings optimization platform. We partner with hundreds of top employers, financial institutions, and retirement record keepers, positioning Candidly to serve more than 35 million Americans.

We’re already achieving incredible results — to date, we’ve helped our users get on track to eliminate more than $1.8B in student debt and pay off their loans 175,000 years quicker — and we’re seeking movers, shakers, innovators, and problem solvers to help take our mission even further.

Candidly is a high-growth, Series B startup, funded by leading investors including Altos Ventures, Aflac, Salesforce Ventures, UBS, Equal Opportunity Ventures, Impact Engine, Rethink Impact, Unum, and Cercano Management. Our fully remote, international team of 70 (and counting) includes alumni from Google, UBS, Twitter, Plaid, Prudential, LendingTree, Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank, and more.

Job Description

Candidly is looking for a full-time Senior Product Designer to lead design for Cait, our AI-native financial guidance product. Employers offer Cait as a benefit. Employees use it to understand their benefits, debt, savings, and retirement, and to see the dollar effect of each decision. Cait is a conversation, not a set of pages, so you will design in use cases, states, and recovery paths, not only in screens. You will work with product managers and engineers who build with AI tools, and you will deliver specs and coded prototypes that they can build from. You will also help make the Cait brand clear and distinct in a form that partners can theme with their own colors. This role reports to the VP of Product and Design.

What You'll Do

  • Take backlog items from problem to spec: frame the problem, define the states and edge cases, and deliver a spec that engineering can build.
  • Design conversational and agent experiences in flows and states, including memory, interruptions, failure, uncertainty, consent, and recovery.
  • Show how users give tasks to Cait, check its work, correct it, and trust it with financial decisions.
  • Build working prototypes in code with AI tools, and treat AI output as a first draft.
  • Design for desktop and mobile, inside our existing design system, and contribute updates to that system.
  • Help make the Candidly brand clearer in type, color, layout, motion, and voice, and design components that partners can theme from a few inputs.
  • Turn benefits, payroll, and financial data into one clear dollar answer.

Required Skills and Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in product design.
  • At least one shipped conversational or AI agent product, designed in flows and states.
  • Experience building working prototypes in code with AI tools.
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including developer-ready components, variants, and auto layout.
  • Experience working inside an existing design system with engineering, on desktop and mobile.
  • Proven experience including accessibility and inclusive design in your work.
  • Strong written communication: you write specs and rationale that a remote team can act on.
  • A portfolio that shows a shipped AI product, a coded prototype, and design system work.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Work in fintech, health, or insurance, including work with compliance review.
  • Experience with data visualization, especially for financial data.
  • Experience with content strategy or conversation design.
  • Experience building a multi-brand or white-label design system.
  • Experience defining AI behavior with engineering, such as writing evaluation criteria or reviewing model output.

Background and EEOC

Candidly offers for employment are conditioned upon satisfactory completion of our employment screening process (including, but not limited to, a review of past employment and education records, background investigation, and/or credit check & fingerprints).

Candidly strives to foster an environment where every employee can succeed. As an Equal Opportunity Employer we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

About Mojo Mortgages

We're not your average mortgage brokerage. We're a fast-moving, ever-evolving fintech on a mission to disrupt the industry. With a buzzing, high-energy environment, we're constantly pushing boundaries to deliver smarter solutions and better outcomes for our customers. Change is constant here, and so is our drive to work faster, think bigger, and raise the bar.

We’re part of RVU, a group of online brands that include: Confused.com, Uswitch, Tempcover, and money.co.uk.

This is a place for top performers. People who thrive under pressure, embrace challenge, and want to be part of building something exceptional. At the heart of everything we do are our behaviours: Care personally, challenge directly, put people first, keep exploring, love what you do, and always be accountable. If that sounds like you, we want you on the journey with us.

As Head of Data, you’ll lead & coach our data team and be the face of data across the business. You’ll report directly to the VP of Engineering and partner with them to shape and own the data roadmap. You’ll work with leaders across the business to turn their priorities into actionable data projects that deliver insight and drive decisions.
Over the next 12-18 months you’ll lead key initiatives such as a unified customer view, domain-aligned data products and real-time analytics and reporting. This is a hands-on role where you’ll stay close to delivery, guiding technical design, unblocking your team, and leading high-leverage analyses while focusing on developing the team around you.

What you'll be doing

Lead and develop the team
  • Coach and mentor a team of 5 composed of analysts and engineers, building clear career paths and objectives
  • Set the team’s standards and ways of working; how work is prioritised, reviewed, documented and delivered
  • Build a culture of high performance, continuous improvement and innovation within the team
Be the face of data in the business
  • Present data strategy, progress and insight to cross-functional leaders through regular reviews, turning complex data topics into clear recommendations
  • Partner with our senior leaders to translate commercial priorities into a clear, prioritised data backlog
  • Collaborate with teams across the business to understand their priorities, shape requests into well-defined data work and manage trade-offs openly
  • Communicate clearly how data projects contribute to the wider business objectives

Shape and deliver the data roadmap

  • Be hands-on with analysis for key business decisions, from defining metrics to presenting findings

What we're looking for

  • Excellent people management skills with the ability to coach and mentor analysts and data engineers
  • Excellent communication skills and confident in presenting to and working with various stakeholders across the business, both technical and non-technical
  • Experience in a data leadership role, with a background in analytics, analytics engineering or a related data discipline
  • A proven track record of leading data projects in a fast-paced environment ruthlessly prioritising competing business demands and structuring team workflows
  • Hands-on experience in SQL and BigQuery with strong data modelling skills
  • Hands-on experience working with frontier LLMs
  • Ability to balance hands-on execution with longer-term strategic planning

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • A fintech or regulated financial services background

  • Exposure to machine learning

What we offer

  • Critical illness cover and death in service
  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption pay
  • Compassionate leave and long-service awards

Standard Job Description

The CNC Machining Capability Project Engineer is the technical person for evaluating, selecting, and developing external machining suppliers for complex CNC milling and turning operations (3 to 5 axis). In addition to deep technical expertise, this role requires strong business acumen—the ability to translate capability data into strategic sourcing decisions that drive cost savings, revenue protection, and market competitiveness.

This role partners closely with Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Quality, and Operations to evaluate machining capabilities, resolve technical issues, reduce cost and risk, and ensure suppliers can meet quality, delivery, and performance requirements.

This position bridges the gap between engineering intent and supplier execution, providing hands-on machining expertise to support supplier selection, development, and ongoing performance

Focus Areas:

Supplier Technical Evaluation & Selection

  • Lead technical assessments of machining suppliers, including:
    • CNC milling/turning (3–5 axis)
    • Complex tolerances & GD&T
    • Materials (aluminum, titanium, steel, Inconel, composites, etc.)
  • Support RFQ/RFP reviews by:
    • Review drawings for machining types
    • Match suppliers to drawing requirements, quality requirements, volume and program needs
    • Manufacturability concerns
    • Process assumptions
    • Cycle times and cost drivers
    • Support PO Kickoffs and drawing reviews with the supplier
  • Participate in source selection decisions as the machining technical authority

Basic Qualifications

10 + years of engineering experience with at least 4 years leading large, multi‑disciplinary projects (≥ $5 M budget, 10+ team members).

Expert in CAD/CAE, GD&T, BOM management, and PLM/ERP tools; strong command of Earned Value, risk registers, and schedule control.

Proven leadership and communication skills – able to mentor teams, influence senior stakeholders, and produce clear technical and executive reports.

Familiarity with applicable industry standards and regulations (AS9100, ISO 9001, ITAR/EAR, etc.) and capable of driving root‑cause analysis and continuous‑improvement initiatives.

Desired Skills

Bachelor’s (or higher) degree in a relevant engineering discipline or equivalent experience and certifications; PMP/PRINCE2 or advanced degree preferred.

Advanced CNC & CAD/CAM expertise – Proficient with 3‑, 4‑ and 5‑axis machining, tooling selection, cutting‑parameter optimization, and multi‑axis CAM software (e.g., Mastercam, Siemens NX, HyperMILL).

Process planning, fixturing & quality control – Develop detailed setup sheets, design work‑holding, program CMM/laser inspections, apply GD&T, and follow ISO/AS9100 quality procedures.

Project‑management & continuous‑improvement – Use Earned‑Value, risk registers, and schedule tools (MS Project/Primavera); drive root‑cause analysis, Lean/Six‑Sigma projects to cut cycle time, scrap and tool wear.

Cross‑functional communication & documentation – Translate engineering requirements into clear machining documentation, status reports, and presentations for designers, suppliers, customers, and senior leadership.

Integrated systems, safety & adaptability – Work with PLM/ERP (Teamcenter, SAP) for BOM and change control, adhere to machine‑tool safety standards (ISO 12100/ANSI B11), and travel to on‑site facilities for audits and project execution.

    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $116100.00 - $215700.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The Director, Leadership Development is a consulting and client leadership role responsible for designing, delivering, and growing high-impact leadership development solutions that help organizations strengthen leadership capability, accelerate talent, and achieve business outcomes.

Serving as a trusted advisor to senior executives, HR leaders, CHROs, and talent leadership teams, the Director partners with clients to assess leadership needs, architect customized development solutions, facilitate leadership experiences, and expand strategic client relationships. This individual combines expertise in leadership development, coaching, adult learning, facilitation, consulting, and business development to deliver meaningful client impact while contributing to the growth of the Leadership Development Practice.

Key Responsibilities

Client Leadership & Relationship Management

Leadership Development Strategy & Program Design

  • Design and deliver customized leadership development programs, workshops, executive learning experiences, and multi-month leadership journeys that align with leadership and business priorities.

  • Develop and enhance curricula, facilitator guides, participant materials, assessments, simulations, experiential exercises, and intellectual property that support client and practice objectives.

Assessment, Coaching & Leadership Capability Development

  • Assess organizational leadership capabilities and identify gaps through diagnostics, stakeholder interviews, leadership assessments, coaching conversations, and 360-degree feedback processes.
  • Translate assessment findings into actionable development strategies for executives, leaders, and leadership cohorts.
  • Help organizations define leadership competencies, succession priorities, and future leadership requirements that support long-term business success.
  • Integrate executive coaching, leadership assessments, feedback tools, action learning, and development planning into broader leadership development initiatives.

Facilitation & Program Delivery

  • Facilitate leadership development programs and executive learning experiences for leadership audiences ranging from emerging leaders to senior executives.

  • Navigate complex organizational dynamics and executive-level discussions with confidence, credibility, and strong facilitation skills.

Practice Building & Intellectual Property

  • Contribute to the ongoing development and evolution of the Leadership Development Practice's offerings, methodologies, frameworks, and intellectual property.
  • Stay current on leadership development research, assessment methodologies, coaching practices, adult learning principles, and emerging market trends.
  • Develop and enhance reusable content, tools, assessments, and leadership solutions that strengthen the practice's capabilities and market differentiation.

Qualifications

raw.description:
About Acquia

Acquia empowers the world’s most ambitious brands to create digital customer experiences that matter. With open source Drupal at its core, the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) enables marketers, developers, and IT operations teams at thousands of global organizations to rapidly compose and deploy digital products and services that engage customers, enhance conversions, and help businesses stand out.

Headquartered in Boston, MA, Acquia is a Great Place to Work-CertifiedTM company, is listed as one of the world’s top software companies by The Software Report, and is positioned as a market leader by the analyst community. We are Acquia. We are building for the future and we want you to be a part of it!

Career Exploration at Acquia

Our recruitment process is designed to empower you in making the most informed decisions. Acquia is committed to providing an inclusive, transparent, efficient, and educational interview experience that cultivates exploration into career opportunities at Acquia

You will discover the opportunity to grow your career here and learn from a global team that empowers you to exceed boundaries and achieve the extraordinary.

The Mission

Acquia is in the middle of its biggest platform transformation in a decade, and the economics of that transformation need an owner. As Senior Product Manager, that’s you.

This is not an accounting role. Finance closes the books, runs the monthly close, and owns the numbers. What you own is the story on top of them: what platform costs are doing and why, where margin is moving and what it means, what investment cases actually say when the assumptions are pressure-tested. You are the financial voice inside the product organization, the person PMs bring their business cases to before they go up, and the person leadership turns to when they need to understand what’s happening with the platform’s economics.

You also own the platform economics story, the ongoing performance narrative that keeps leadership aligned on how the business is performing and where the opportunities and risks are. That means driving the executive check-ins and reviews, in partnership with the Cloud PM group, that keep platform economics visible and actionable at the right level.

The role is also expanding into new territory. AI is restructuring what cloud platforms cost to build and run, faster than most organizations are ready for. You will build the frameworks, internal and external reporting, chargeback models, CapEx planning, that give Acquia visibility and control over AI-driven costs as they grow. And you will own the strategic vendor relationships where Acquia needs someone who can hold both the financial negotiation and the product judgment at the same time.

The Profile

  • The Margin Owner: You are the ongoing source of truth for how the platform portfolio performs economically. You track actuals, understand what’s driving them, and run the leadership rhythm, executive check-ins and cross-functional reviews with the Cloud PM group, that keeps margin performance visible and actionable at the right altitude. When something moves, you know why, and you know what to do about it.
  • The Platform Economist: You read cost trends, consumption patterns, and margin signals the way other PMs read usage data: as a window into what’s working, what’s at risk, and where the platform needs to change. Platform cost efficiency, customer-level economics, cost trending across the portfolio, these are your inputs. Your output is clarity, in language engineers, PMs, and executives can all act on.
  • The Financial Advocate: Every PM on the team builds business cases. You make those cases better. You review assumptions before they become commitments, model the cost implications of a feature before it goes into the roadmap, and make sure significant investment decisions are economically grounded, not just technically compelling. This is not a gatekeeper role. It’s a force multiplier.
  • The AI Cost Pioneer: AI is changing what it costs to build and run a cloud platform faster than most finance teams are tracking it. You are building the frameworks, internal reporting, external customer visibility, chargeback models, CapEx planning, that let Acquia understand and manage AI-driven costs proactively, not reactively. This is early work with real impact, and you are the person defining what it looks like.
  • The Vendor Strategist: You own the financial and product dimensions of Acquia’s key strategic vendor relationships, cloud infrastructure, cost intelligence tooling, and OEM partnerships. You bring the financial rigor and product judgment that Acquia needs in the room on renewals, negotiations, and procurement decisions, and you manage those relationships as long-term strategic assets, not just contracts to renew.
  • The Context Architect: You thrive in an Agentic PDLC environment. You build and maintain the economic context, margin models, cost benchmarks, vendor frameworks, that lets the team’s agentic workflows scale financial analysis and reporting without requiring your involvement in every step.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Gross Margin Reporting and Executive Engagement. Track and report on gross margin performance for the platform portfolio on an ongoing basis, in partnership with the Cloud PM group. Understand what’s driving the numbers, surface the risks and opportunities that matter, and run the executive check-ins and leadership reviews that keep platform economics visible and actionable at the right level.
  • Own the Platform Cost Narrative. Work from Finance’s data to build the product-side view of what the platform costs to run and why. Track platform cost efficiency, customer-level economics, and cost trends across the portfolio, and turn those signals into product priorities, investment sequencing, and recommendations leadership can act on.
  • Be the Financial Advocate for Every PM on the Team. Review business cases before they go up. Model feature and product costs. Help PMs pressure-test their assumptions so significant investment decisions are economically grounded, not just technically compelling.
  • Build the AI Cost Frameworks. Own AI cost reporting for internal and external audiences. Build the chargeback models that let Acquia track AI cost at the product and customer level. Develop CapEx frameworks that let the organization plan AI infrastructure investment with clarity, and advocate for AI cost best practices across the business.
  • Partner on Strategic Vendor Relationships. Serve as the financial and product voice in Acquia’s key vendor relationships across cloud infrastructure, cost intelligence tooling, and OEM partnerships. Contribute to renewals, negotiations, and procurement approvals with both financial precision and product judgment, and help ensure those relationships are managed as strategic assets, not just recurring line items.
  • Manage Third-Party Tool Economics. Own expense reporting, expense modeling, and contract management across the third-party tool portfolio. Maintain and evolve the platform’s cost intelligence infrastructure, including ongoing tool administration, dashboard development, and design partnership with key vendors.
  • Contribute to Platform Investment Planning. Feed into hosting forecasts and reservation planning, making sure platform infrastructure commitments are sized and sequenced against the product roadmap, not just current-state usage.
  • Agentic Collaboration. Build and maintain the shared economic context structures, margin models, cost frameworks, vendor intelligence, AI cost dashboards, that let the team’s agentic workflows scale financial analysis and reporting without manual overhead.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a role that required both financial modeling and strategic product or business judgment, ideally at the intersection of PM and FP&A in a SaaS or managed cloud platform business — finance-fluent, not just finance-adjacent
  • A track record of building financial models from scratch: cost models, gross margin analysis, business cases, consumption forecasts — not updating someone else’s
  • Demonstrated experience owning executive reporting cadences and driving leadership reviews with your own recommendations, not just contributing the numbers
  • Hands-on cloud economics depth: consumption-based cost modeling, reserved capacity planning, or gross margin analysis in a cloud infrastructure or SaaS business — you’ve done the work, not observed it
  • Hands-on experience with FinOps tooling (CloudZero, Apptio, Cloudability, or equivalent) — not passing familiarity
  • Experience contributing to vendor negotiations and renewals where both financial outcomes and product strategy were on the table, not just one or the other
  • Enough PM craft to work as a peer to PMs, not just a finance partner to them — experience writing requirements, running discovery, or owning a roadmap area
  • Comfortable presenting financial narratives to VP-level or above, with accountability for the recommendations, not just the deck
  • Demonstrated interest in AI-assisted analysis and agentic workflows, and the drive to build those into how this role operates from day one

We are an organization that embraces innovation and the potential of AI to enhance our processes and improve our work. We are always looking for individuals who are open to learning new technologies and collaborating with AI tools to achieve our goals.

Acquia is proud to provide best-in-class benefits to help our employees and their families maintain a healthy body and mind. Core Benefits include: competitive healthcare coverage, wellness programs, take it when you need it time off, parental leave, recognition programs, and much more!

Final compensation will be commensurate with your experience and will be determined by a variety of factors, including city of residence, relevant skillset, and job-related knowledge.

Acquia is an equal opportunity (EEO) employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veterans status or any other protected status or characteristic under federal, state or local law unrelated to the ability to perform the job.

We are seeking an AI-Native candidate who treats AI not as an external tool, but as a fundamental extension of their cognitive workflow. The ideal candidate possesses an orchestration mindset—the ability to skillfully prompt, manage, and direct AI to navigate complexity—and maintains a high degree of AI fluency.

You should be characterized by radical adaptability and a "builder" mentality, showing a restless drive to transform traditional work processes into agentic workflows. Beyond technical proficiency, we value intellectual humility: the willingness to constantly unlearn old methods in favor of more efficient, AI-augmented processes. You don't just use AI to do your job; you use it to redefine what your job can achieve.

Pay Range
$160,000—$170,000 USD

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking Physics Experts specializing in Quantum Optics and Atomic Physics to contribute to an advanced research-driven benchmarking project focused on quantum science and AI development.

You will apply your subject matter expertise to develop, solve, review, and evaluate research-level physics problems. Key areas include quantum sensing and metrology, trapped and levitated particles, ultracold atom platforms, atomic structure, and precision measurement.

  • Deep expertise in quantum optics, atomic physics, or related quantum science disciplines.
  • Hands-on experimental or theoretical experience with quantum sensing, optical lattices, laser physics, or ultracold atom systems.
  • PhD or equivalent research experience in physics or a closely related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with LaTeX proficiency required.
  • Experience contributing to research benchmarks, advanced problem-solving projects, or academic peer review.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate constructively in multidisciplinary projects.
  • Experience with precision measurement or trapped and levitated particle systems is a plus.

Leverage your hands-on experience to build authentic debugging and feature challenges within real game projects, directly impacting how AI agents learn to analyze, play, and develop games.   • A portfolio or verifiable published work (personal site, Steam, GitHub, game jam entries, or shipped title credits).

title: Senior FinOps Engineer
description: At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and enabling our clients to Do Great Things.

raw.title: Senior FinOps Engineer
raw.excerpt: At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and enabling our clients to Do Great Things.
raw.description:
At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and enabling our clients to Do Great Things. As a trusted technology adviser and managed services provider, we help clients navigate continuous change and embrace innovation. We deliver world-class transformational services across hybrid cloud, infrastructure, mainframe, data, IdAM, and cloud-native solutions, simplifying complex business challenges and creating new pathways to success. Headquartered in the USA and backed by private equity, Ensono has a strong track record in the UK and Europe, with growth plans built on trusted partnerships and deep industry expertise.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior FinOps Engineer to join our growing SRE and Cloud Services team and help deliver a consistent, outcome-focused FinOps-as-a-Service capability. This is a foundational role in building and scaling our FinOps-as-a-Service offering across enterprise clients. You will combine hands-on cloud cost engineering, governance, reporting and stakeholder engagement to improve cost visibility, accountability and value from cloud investment. Working within each client’s environment and toolchain, you will partner with engineering, SRE, finance and business stakeholders to prioritise achievable outcomes, deliver recommendations and implementation-as-code, and maintain clear client approval for production changes and commercial commitments.

Key Responsibilities

Optimise

  • Create and maintain an opportunity register that records each optimisation opportunity, estimated value, implementation effort, status and realised benefit;
  • Perform rightsizing analysis of compute, database and storage resources using observed utilisation, performance and service requirements;
  • Model Reserved Instance and Savings Plan coverage and utilisation, presenting evidence-based recommendations while recognising that commitment purchases remain the client’s decision;
  • Participate in architecture and solution reviews, providing cost models, options and trade-offs for proposed cloud services;
  • Identify idle, orphaned and unattached resources and recommend safe, prioritised remediation;
  • Submit optimisation changes, including storage lifecycle and tiering controls, as pull requests to client Infrastructure-as-Code repositories with cost analysis; validate in non-production where available and promote only following client approval.

Govern

  • Define and maintain an Infrastructure-as-Code-aligned tagging taxonomy and supporting policies; monitor tagging compliance and manage remediation exceptions;
  • Develop reusable policy-as-code modules and cost gates for client delivery pipelines;
  • Establish anomaly detection and route alerts into agreed incident workflows; triage anomalies, coordinate investigation and record dispositions;
  • Own budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis, including billing reconciliation and agreed baselines;
  • Apply proportionate financial governance controls that respect client approval, risk and change-management requirements.

Enable

  • Build and maintain cost, allocation and unit-economics dashboards using agreed business measures;
  • Deliver showback and chargeback reporting, with clear attribution of cost and consumption;
  • Participate in sprint and planning ceremonies, jointly prioritising work within available capacity, surfacing trade-offs and agreeing delivery and reporting cadence;
  • Create and maintain a joint FinOps roadmap, tracking priorities, dependencies, outcomes and progress;
  • Provide knowledge transfer and present the current cost position, optimisation activity, realised savings and roadmap progress to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Engage

  • Lead operational onboarding by establishing access to the client environment, billing and cost APIs or exports, and delivery toolchain; assess the current cost position, utilisation, commitment coverage and tagging quality; agree priorities and cadence; and establish initial reporting;
  • Work inside client toolchains and governance processes, collaborating through pull requests and evidence-based cost analysis rather than making unilateral production changes;
  • Own agreed monthly reporting covering cost and usage variance, allocation, unit economics, optimisation activity and realised savings, budget and forecast variance, anomaly dispositions, tagging compliance and billing reconciliation, plus quarterly commitment coverage and utilisation reviews;
  • Act as a trusted adviser and coordinate with Ensono SRE and other services. Deliver recommendations and implementation-as-code within scope, make client approval and prioritisation explicit, and communicate that savings depend on client decisions, implementation and usage.

What You Will Bring to Ensono

Must-Have

  • Demonstrable senior-level experience delivering an operational FinOps or cloud economics service, including onboarding new client environments and establishing repeatable delivery;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure billing and cost management, including cost exports or APIs, Azure Cost Management, Azure Advisor and Azure Monitor;
  • Experience delivering Infrastructure-as-Code changes through client repositories and CI/CD pipelines, including pull requests, cost analysis, peer review and non-production validation;
  • Strong understanding of cloud pricing, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and commitment coverage and utilisation modelling;
  • Experience maintaining opportunity registers, estimating value and effort, and tracking realised benefits without over-stating or guaranteeing savings;
  • Strong capability in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, allocation, showback or chargeback, and billing reconciliation;
  • Experience with tagging compliance, policy-as-code, cost gates, anomaly detection and operational triage;
  • Ability to create clear cost and unit-economics dashboards and present service performance to technical, financial and business stakeholders;
  • Proven client-facing communication and consultancy skills, with the ability to manage prioritised outcomes within proportional capacity and surface delivery trade-offs.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with AWS cost management (Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor, Compute Optimizer);
  • Experience with GCP billing and cost optimisation;
  • FinOps Foundation certification (FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Professional);
  • Experience with FinOps platforms such as CloudHealth, Apptio Cloudability, Kubecost or native cloud cost tools;
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes cost management and container rightsizing;
  • Understanding of unit economics and the ability to report cost against business measures;
  • Experience building dashboards and reporting using tools such as Power BI, Grafana or Looker;
  • Cloud certifications (Azure, AWS or GCP) at associate level or above.

What We Can Offer You

We are a people-first business, which means people are at the heart of everything we do here. We offer our associates a safe environment where learning, knowledge sharing, and open communication is encouraged.

We believe that great work deserves great rewards. In return for your ideas, commitment and ambition, we'll give you a very competitive base salary and a range of benefits as soon as you join. On top of your highly competitive base salary, we offer:

  • Flexible and remote work opportunities
  • Performance bonus
  • Training and development programs
  • Worldwide career opportunities
  • Community outreach and mentoring opportunities
  • Learning platforms
  • My Benefit system
  • Wellness Platform support from Virgin Pulse
  • Associate equity program
  • Life insurance
  • Lunch card
  • Study leave
  • One paid day off for charity events
  • Sabbatical
  • Extended parental leave
  • Rental or co-financing of office equipment
  • Referral bonus program

raw.title: VP, Consulting & Transformation
raw.excerpt: Domaine is a global digital commerce and transformation partner for ambitious and beloved brands.
raw.description:
Domaine is a global digital commerce and transformation partner for ambitious and beloved brands. We are the world’s largest independent Shopify partner. We are also a growing team of strategists, designers, engineers and specialists who help brands decide where to invest, build what comes next, and run it at scale across platforms, channels and AI. As pioneers and not just participants in our industry, we are inspired to write, break, and re-write the rules for a new generation of commerce.

The VP, Consulting leads Domaine’s Consulting practice and holds a seat on the Craft Leadership team. The practice brings together multiple disciplines: Strategy, AI and Transformation Advisory, CRM and Lifecycle, Conversion Rate Optimization, and SEO/GEO/AEO. This role owns consulting as a commercial function as well as an advisory one. It is how Domaine moves from being chosen for a platform build to being chosen for the business outcomes.

This role does not receive a brief and execute it. It takes in a conversation with a prospect or existing client, specific or vague, and discerns the goals, the real needs, the gaps, the path, and the teams and skills required to get there. It then builds the plan and the trust to see it funded. It works in lockstep with Client Partners, Creative, Sales and Engineering, and brings commercial instinct to every recommendation: what should change, why it will grow the client’s business, what it will cost, and what it will return.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Consulting Leadership

  • Lead senior engagements for clients including digital and AI transformation, platform and replatforming decisions, international expansion, B2B, retail and POS, loyalty, marketplace, data, and operating model.
  • Run structured Discovery across business objectives, customer insight, data, technology, organization and operating model. Translate it into goals, needs, gaps, a sequenced path, and the capabilities and skills required.
  • Build the business case that turns a roadmap into funded work and prioritization by business impact, customer impact, level of effort, and dependency.
  • Produce multi-year roadmaps to show the art of the possible and how they get there.
  • Recommend what Domaine should and should not do. Where a client’s best path goes beyond our delivery, build the partner or co-delivery model rather than shrinking the recommendation.

Retention, Account Expansion, and Commercial Growth

  • Own the 1, 3 or 5 year plan for every top-tier retained client, tied to their stated business goals. A launch is the beginning of our relationship with the client, not the end.
  • Chair or co-chair Growth Councils and QBRs with the Client Partner, run as forward-looking conversations with explicit ROI accountability rather than a retrospective of work delivered.
  • Support the orchestration of a unified team for every retained client, synthesizing strategy, AI and transformation, CRM and lifecycle, Conversion Rate Optimization, SEO/GEO/AEO, Design, and Technology perspectives into a single narrative. Help evolve accounts from single-threaded delivery to multi-service relationships.
  • Provide the strategic input and human judgment layer on client health and monthly intelligence reporting, on top of AI-generated analysis.
  • Ensure consulting hours are named, scoped, and priced into retainers and new builds rather than absorbed into the account.
  • Join pursuits for strategic accounts, bringing senior transformational thinking into the room alongside Sales and Client Partners.
  • Help shape scope before pricing on complex or multi-discipline engagements, so the approach differentiates the proposal rather than reading as a deliverable list.
  • Own the strategic spine of Domaine’s pitch narrative, positioning Domaine as a digital services partner and not only a platform implementer, and keep it current as the market moves.

Practice Leadership and Partner Advisory

  • Fluent in every discipline they lead. Knows Strategy, CRO, CRM and Lifecycle, SEO/GEO/AEO and our emerging AI services from the inside: the KPIs that run each one and how each should be applied to project and retained work.Own quality, methodology and playbooks, team structure, performance management, and day-to-day operation.
  • Carry practice margin and utilization targets.
  • Build the documentation, frameworks, and evaluation criteria that let each discipline scale past the people currently doing the work.
  • Turn proven pilots, including managed services and Domaine Labs and AI Commerce capabilities, into standard offerings with defined scope and pricing.
  • Help shape Domaine’s point of view on the digital commerce stack beyond the storefront: search and discovery, personalization, lifecycle and messaging, loyalty, subscription, PIM, ERP, OMS, DAM, data, and the AI tooling layer around them.
  • Advise clients on whether their current stack supports their goals and competitive needs, and where to reinvest. Consulting evaluates whether the investment holds up against the client’s growth plan.

Practice and People Leadership

  • Support the enablement of applied AI so it shows up in client roadmaps as measurable, and bring AI-differentiated capability into sales conversations, including AI discoverability, agentic commerce operations, and partner stack advisory.
  • Redefine consulting and discipline deliverables for an AI-native workflow, with measurable impacts.
  • A leader the practice leads trust. Mentors the discipline leads, earns their confidence, and pushes each practice toward continual improvement and revenue growth.Set performance standards and build a bench that can operate without you in the room.
  • Hold the layer below accountable as leaders owning outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years in consulting, strategy, or senior client leadership, with meaningful time in a client-facing senior role at an agency, digital consultancy, or consulting firm.
  • Track record of leading digital transformation engagements from an ambiguous problem to a funded roadmap to a delivered outcome.
  • Experience running a consulting or strategy function and a multi-discipline group: defining the offering, setting methodology, carrying a commercial number, and building and leading leaders.
  • Demonstrated experience building and defending a business case for a digital transformation initiative, including ROI modeling and prioritization frameworks.
  • Track record of growing retained or recurring revenue relationships, not only winning net-new business.
  • Strong command of the digital commerce growth model: demand generation, conversion, lifecycle and retention, merchandising and AOV, and the data that connects them. Enough depth to make credible recommendations and lead discipline leaders.
  • Fluency in the commerce ecosystem and the surrounding partner, app, and enterprise systems landscape.

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Competitive Healthcare with Dental & Vision
  • Retirement savings plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy with paid time off at end of year
  • Flexible working schedule
  • Remote-first culture
  • Home office stipend
  • Apple gear
  • Continued education and personal development opportunities

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

raw.title: Sr. Director Account Management
raw.excerpt: About Scene Health Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy.
raw.description:
About Scene Health

Scene’s 360° model of care enhances the gold standard of medication adherence, Directly Observed Therapy. Combining personalized video coaching, education, and motivational content, we bring healthcare professionals, patients, and their families together to solve the $500B medication non-adherence problem. Our mobile app allows patients to connect with a care team of pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through daily video check-ins, anytime and anywhere. We make it fun for patients to stay on top of their medications, help them address medication challenges, and empower them to improve their health by addressing barriers to adherence related to social determinants of health.

Position Overview

Scene Health is seeking an experienced Senior Director, Account Management, to lead and develop relationships with our health plan and emerging government-funded programs, including the Rural Health Transformation Program Initiatives, and state-sponsored employee health plans. This individual will serve as the primary relationship owner for assigned accounts,

ensuring customer satisfaction, demonstrating measurable value, and driving revenue retention and account expansion.

The ideal candidate has 10–15 years of experience in account management, including managing health plan relationships on behalf of technology-enabled healthcare services organizations. They understand health plan priorities, build trusted relationships with senior executives, and are skilled at translating clinical and operational performance into compelling

demonstrations of value.

The Senior Director will serve as the strategic and cross-functional lead for assigned accounts, coordinating internal teams to ensure customer commitments are fulfilled accurately and on time. This is a senior leadership role that requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management & Revenue Growth

● Own relationships with assigned customers across health plans, government-funded healthcare programs, and state employer health plans, developing and maintaining strong partnerships with senior executives and key stakeholders.

● Attend conferences which our customers attend, and visit customer accounts regularly in person to build relationships

● Take responsibility for revenue retention, customer satisfaction, and successful contract renewals. Proactively manage customer retention, renewal readiness, and account health; identify churn risks early and coordinate recovery plans.

● Identify and pursue account expansion opportunities in collaboration with Scene Health’s executive leadership. Develop upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts, including expanded populations, additional programs, and new service lines.

● Develop and execute strategic account plans that establish revenue objectives, executive engagement strategies, performance priorities, and growth opportunities.

● Maintain a deep understanding of each customer’s strategic priorities, organizational dynamics, and evolving needs.

● Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities.

Performance Management & Demonstration of Value

● Lead the preparation and execution of Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

● Ensure that business reviews clearly demonstrate Scene Health’s clinical, operational, and financial value.

● Collaborate with analytics and clinical leadership to translate program performance into compelling, data-driven presentations for health plan executives.

● Work with internal leaders to continuously strengthen Scene Health’s value proposition, including its impact on medication adherence, member engagement, healthcare utilization, and medical cost savings.

Customer Reporting & Deliverables

● Ensure that all customer reports and contractual deliverables are accurate, complete, and delivered on schedule.

● Maintain reporting calendars, track commitments, and coordinate with internal teams to meet customer expectations.

● Proactively identify and resolve reporting, operational, or performance issues.

Cross-Functional Leadership

● Serve as the internal cross-functional lead for assigned accounts, coordinating across clinical operations, analytics, product, technology, and executive leadership.

● Ensure that the appropriate internal stakeholders are engaged to fulfill customer commitments and address emerging needs.

● Establish clear ownership, timelines, and accountability for customer deliverables.

● Represent the voice of the customer internally, helping inform operational improvements, product development, and strategic priorities.

● Take a hands-on approach to preparing customer presentations, coordinating deliverables, and resolving issues as needed.

Required Qualifications

● Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.

● 10–15 years of experience in account management or strategic client management, including experience at a technology-enabled healthcare services company.

● Demonstrated experience managing health plan customers, preferably managed care organizations Medicaid and/or Medicare Advantage plans.

● Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with senior health plan executives.

● Experience leading executive-level MBRs and QBRs and demonstrating measurable customer value.

● Strong understanding of health plan priorities, including population health, quality improvement, member engagement, and medical cost management.

● Demonstrated experience managing revenue retention, contract renewals, and account growth.

● Excellent presentation, and communication skills with the ability to build relationships, lead client discussions, and communicate effectively across all levels of an organization.

● Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability.

● Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

● Experience with public-sector contracting or state employee health plans is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

● Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in Public Health, Population Health, Health Economics, or a closely related field.

● Experience with medication adherence, chronic disease management, population health, or technology-enabled clinical services.

● Familiarity with healthcare utilization metrics, quality measures, and financial ROI analyses.

● Experience working in a high-growth healthcare technology company.

Compensation and benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Paid vacation leave
  • Paid sick leave
  • Paid holidays
  • Professional development
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Fully remote work

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas at this time.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Belonging at Samsara

Accommodations

Remote Staff Accountant – Mortgage / Loan Accounting - Eastern Time Zone

Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Staff Accountant to support our mortgage accounting operations and monthly financial close. This role is responsible for maintaining general ledger accuracy, reconciling daily warehouse line and loan-level activity, and ensuring timely investor and escrow accounting. You will partner closely with Accounting, Operations, and Funding teams to resolve discrepancies and maintain strong financial controls.

Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Month-End Close

  • Prepare and post standard and adjusting month-end journal entries, including accruals and prepaid expenses.
  • Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts to ensure all financial transactions are recorded accurately and on time.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet reconciliations, including bank accounts, fixed assets, prepaid expenses, accrued liabilities, and intercompany accounts.
  • Investigate and resolve general ledger discrepancies and budget-to-actual variances.
  • Execute assigned sections of the monthly financial close checklist to meet strict reporting deadlines.

Mortgage & Loan Accounting

  • Reconcile daily warehouse line activity, funding wires, and paydowns between the loan origination system (LOS) and the general ledger.
  • Reconcile Loans Held for Sale (LHFS) sub-ledgers (Encompass and LoanVision) to the general ledger on a daily and monthly basis.
  • Review, reconcile, and record investor purchase advices (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and private investors), ensuring accurate accounting for principal, accrued interest, Service Release Premiums (SRP), and gain/loss on sale.
  • Monitor and clear aged items across escrow, loan funding, payoff, and investor suspense/clearing accounts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.
  • 2 to 4 years of progressive accounting experience; mortgage banking or financial services experience preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with General Ledger systems required; LoanVision experience strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with mortgage loan origination systems, specifically Encompass 360, preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the Microsoft Office suite.
  • High attention to detail with strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • Ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment and communicate professionally with operations and field personnel.

Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:


Job Description

Senior Field Clinical Specialist - Structural Interventions


Working at Abbott


At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Free medical coverage for employees* via the Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity


In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.


We have an exciting opportunity for the right candidate to join our rapidly growing clinical team within the Abbott Electrophysiology (EP) division. This position will support our Field Clinical Team focusing on Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion (LAAO). We are seeking an experienced Field Clinical Specialist (FCS).


Primary responsibilities will include outstanding management of Pre and Post market Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion (LAAO) clinical trial execution in an assigned territory. In this role, the FCS supports internal and external customers and cross-functional teams. This FCS position works closely with Global Clinical Affairs (GCA) including the Medical Director and Program Management, Global Clinical Organization (GCO) field personnel, and Abbott’s Commercial LAAO team. This position has significant interaction with Study Investigators, Research Coordinators, Physician Assistants, and Nurses. This position is required to execute their job responsibilities within established corporate policies and standard operating procedures

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life through the design and provision of device and management solutions for the treatment of structural heart disease. We aim to lead the markets we serve by requiring the solutions we offer to customers provide an improved benefit/risk profile as compared to existing standards of care; a performance threshold that by definition, guides and ensures the productive output of our engineering, business development, and clinical research efforts result in outcomes that advance the standard of care.


What You'll Work On:

  • Effectively manage territory by developing long-standing research partnerships with clinical sites, establishing regular touch points with site investigators and research teams to elevate trial visibility. Supporting site research teams by streamlining screening activities, developing tools and best practices to qualify trial candidates, and identifying barriers to enrollment.
  • Acquire critical knowledge of sites’ clinical research capabilities to support Abbott’s clinical evidence generation strategies.
  • Responsible for ensuring timely clinical trial site nominations, qualification assessments, and activations for the Structural Heart Division.
  • Be a LAAO Subject Matter Expert (SME) providing expertise in subject eligibility, training, and case support delivering strong enrollment, outstanding clinical outcomes, and data quality.
  • Train physicians, support staff, and research personnel on investigational devices, clinical trial Procedural techniques and protocols.
  • Provide procedural guidance to physicians when implanting investigational LAAO devices or acting as back-up to commercial clinical support as needed.
  • May act as a mentor to less experienced FCSs within their region or in other parts of the world.
  • Coordinate communication with internal and external customers to facilitate efficient and compliant clinical trial execution.
  • Develop presentation materials to support Investigator Meetings, National Conferences, as well as LAAO product technical training and best practices.
  • Convey franchise clinical evidence and strategy with confidence to physicians and research partners.
  • Function as a “pipeline” between Abbott and the Medical Community, constantly communicating valuable information to internal and external customers (product planning, engineering, marketing, and education).
  • Support engineering efforts on next generation LAAO platform development by contributing clinical knowledge to early product design iterations
  • Develop clinical best practices on next generation LAAO platforms and provide procedural case support for all phases of product development, from First in Man through Early Feasibility, and IDE Studies.
  • Engage with clinical sites to raise subject diversity awareness in neighboring communities and identify barriers to enrolling a diverse trial population.
  • Identify opportunities to establish best practices within the organization.
  • Complete and maintain certifications that are relevant to their specific product area.
  • Complies with U.S (United States). Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, Company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments. Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors.
  • Performs other related duties and responsibilities, on occasion, as assigned. These duties may include taking calls in the evenings and/or weekends for time-sensitive patient case reviews and customer needs.
  • Role will evolve as we scale for professional growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Biological Sciences, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent. An advanced credential is preferred.
  • An advanced credential in a relevant discipline/concentration such as Biological Sciences. Professional Health Science certification or designation.
  • At least four years of clinical research experience (preferably field clinical affairs) is preferred.
  • At least one year of experience working in the Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion (LAAO) space, or closely related area.
  • Significant experience in a field-based role in the medical device industry, particularly experience with Cath Lab/Hybrid OR procedures and protocol.
  • Ability to work in a geographically diverse business environment.
  • Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.
  • Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization.
  • Multitasks, prioritizes, and meets deadlines in a timely manner.
  • Independent worker with strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail.
  • Ability to travel approximately 50% - 80%.

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Jinyu-English Phone Interpreter


Job Title: JinyuInterpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.75 - $0.90 per minute


We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:


The Jinyu Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Jinyuand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**


Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inJinyu and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for one hundred eighty (180) days from the posting date of November 16, 2026.
