raw.description:
The MA in Clinical Counseling Program (Online) Alliant’s MACC is CACREP-accredited, one of the most respected credentials in the field and the recognized training standard by the Institute of Medicine and the Veterans Administration. As the required educational training for counseling licensure in most states, it can provide more flexibility to practice wherever a student’s career takes them. Students prepared to work across a wide range of community and healthcare settings equipped with the skills to assess, diagnose, and treat mental health conditions and to meet clients with both clinical precision and genuine compassion.

Application Description:
Applicants to this position will be considered for a candidate pool encompassing one or more of the subject areas outlined in the job description. This pool will be used to identify qualified candidates for potential appointments during the 2026–2027 academic year.

Salary Range: $40 - $46 hourly (based on course requirements & level of education). This is a temporary, non-benefits eligible role.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Education: Doctoral degree in Counselor Education from an accredited college or university.
  • Experience: Appropriate experience in the areas(s) of specialization and expertise

Specific Courses: Spring 2027

COU67320-Sexuality and Sex Therapy:

This course is designed for counseling and human service professionals whose work will bring them into contact with clients experiencing problems and concerns with their sexuality. The course is designed to develop: (a) students’ knowledge base related to human sexuality; (b) an understanding of the varied sexuality issues which may be encountered in professional counseling practice; (c) students’ skills in assessment and intervention skills with sexuality issues; (d) awareness of dynamics of sexuality that intersect with larger societal systems of privilege and oppression based on gender, sexual orientation, race, class, abilities, national origin, and religion; (e) understanding of the social justice advocacy competencies as they intersect with sexuality issues; and (f) increased awareness of one’s personal perceptions, attitudes and affect related to sexuality issues. Course participants will become more effective in identifying, assessing and intervening with human sexuality related counseling issues.

COU67370: Couple and Family Counseling:

This course explores theories, interventions and research related to couple and family relationship issues. Couple and family systems theory therapies and practices are considered relative to assessment, diagnosis, and treatment issues. There is an emphasis on developing familiarity with couple and family therapy theories and critical thinking. Students will also be encouraged to consider the role that contextual factors play, such as ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, privilege, and oppression. The course challenges students to examine and better understand their beliefs, values and assumptions about couples, marriage, as well as biases for working with diverse, couples, families and relationships.

COU66380 Grief and Loss in Counseling (Elective):

This course addresses theories and counseling techniques related to death and dying, grief and loss including: multicultural and international issues in death, grief and loss. Didactic, discussion, and experiential learning. The Master of Arts in Clinical Counseling (MACC) program is organized to enable students to build sequentially on knowledge and skills. This is an elective course in the Clinical Counseling curriculum and serves as an introduction to death and dying and grief and loss theories and techniques. This course recognizes the 2016 competencies determined by the Council for Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs (CACREP) for Clinical Mental Health Counseling and will introduce the Social Justice Advocacy Competencies of the American Counseling Association.

COU67350 Psychopathology Diagnosis and Treatment Planning:

Introduction to the assessment, diagnosis, etiology, prevention and treatment of mental disorders and differential diagnosis using the DSM-5-TR and related information. Provides a framework for understanding the range of personality and behavioral disorders, systematic treatment planning, interviewing, incorporation of resilience and cultural competence, and short-and long-term interventions.

COU67390 Counseling Research Methods and Program Evaluation:

The applied research methods evaluation course is intended to provide basic understanding of quantitative and qualitative research methods; use of research to inform evidence-based practice; statistical analysis; ethical/legal considerations; needs assessment, program evaluation; presenting research pertinent to professional counseling.

COU67550 Play Therapy and Expressive Arts in Clinical Counseling (Elective):

This course addresses theories and counseling techniques related to the therapeutic role of play and expressive arts in clinical counseling. The course includes didactic, discussion, and experiential learning. The Master of Arts in Clinical Counseling (MACC) program is organized to enable students to build sequentially on knowledge and skills. This is an elective course in the Clinical Counseling curriculum and serves as an introduction to play therapy and creative art theories and techniques. This course recognizes the 2016 competencies determined by the Council for Accreditation of Counseling and Related Educational Programs (CACREP) for Clinical Mental Health Counseling and will introduce the Social Justice Advocacy Competencies of the American Counseling Association.

COU67240 Multicultural Counseling and Techniques:

Multicultural counseling theories and techniques, including counselor’s roles in developing racial, ethnic, socioeconomic status, gender, sexual orientation, ability, religious/spiritual and international awareness and identity development. Experientially examines intentional and unintentional oppression and privilege, promotes social justice advocacy, and develops competencies in addressing biases.

NOTE: THIS COURSE NCLUDES A THREE-DAY RESIDENCY.

COU67130: Counseling Skills and Techniques (with Lab):

This course will aid students in the acquisition of` knowledge, skills, and professional dispositions, associated with counseling micro skills via role play and mock sessions. Students will learn about suicide prevention, crisis intervention, trauma-informed, and community-based care. Ethical and diversity issues are considered, as well as counselor self-care. NOTE: THIS COURSE INCLUDES A THREE-DAY RESIDENCY

COU67380 Assessment in Clinical Counseling:

This course provides students with an introduction to psychological testing; from its theoretical foundation, to applications in understanding human performance, including an understanding of the relevance and potential biases inherent to assessment with multicultural populations. Beginning with traditional psychometric theories of reliability and validity, students will be introduced to several major psychological tests.

About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.
Are you interested in joining our Design/Research or Content Strategy team at Nava but there are no open roles? Drop your resume and portfolio here for our team to review for future opportunities!

What to Expect Next:

Complete the Application

To proceed with your application, please ensure that you complete the application fully by clicking the "Apply For This Job" button below. This includes submitting your updated resume and any additional required information.

Application Review

Once your application is complete, our Talent Acquisition team will review it against role qualifications and requirements. We will evaluate your experience and fit based on our standard hiring criteria.

Interview Process

If your profile matches a current opportunity, you will be invited to participate in our interview process. This process includes an initial conversation with a Talent Acquisition Partner, followed by interviews with hiring managers and other team members.

Final Decision & Offer

After you complete the interviews, we will assess your fit for the position and make a final decision. If selected, you will receive an offer detailing compensation, benefits, and the next steps to joining the Nava team.

Onboarding

Once you accept our offer, we will guide you through our onboarding process to ensure a smooth transition into your new role at Nava.
We appreciate your interest in Nava and are committed to making this process as clear and seamless as possible. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact our Talent Acquisition team.

Important Note:

Please note that this is not a job opening, and submitting your resume does not guarantee employment or an interview. We will review your information based on our standard hiring criteria, and if you are a potential fit for a current or future opportunity, we may contact you. We appreciate your interest and look forward to learning more about your experience!

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States
Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future
May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs
Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost
Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge
Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO
Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus
Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home
Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools
Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)
Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest
401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan
Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities
Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs
Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses
Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills
Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs
Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team
Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable
Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states:
Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin
  • If you are not living in one of the states listed above, unfortunately, you will not be considered for a position at this time.

Stay in touch

Sign up for our newsletter to find out about career opportunities, new partnerships, and news from the broader civic tech community.
Please contact the recruiting team at if you would like to request any form of reasonable accommodation during the application or interviewing process.
We participate in E-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. This role requires you to work from the contiguous United States.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Nava is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, gender and/or gender identity or expression, color, creed, religion, religious creed, age, national origin, ethnicity, disability, veteran or military status, sex, sexual orientation, reproductive health autonomy, pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth, genetic information, domestic violence victim status, marital status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law. About

Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.

Our Culture

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.

Role Description

At , Sales is pivotal to our company’s success. As an Account Executive, you will use proactive and inbound selling strategies to engage with mid to large-size businesses to close new business. You will use your B2B sales experience to identify opportunities with current leads and prospective key clients.

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales team and focus on our Mid-Market customers across North America — the US, Canada and Mexico — including the large, fast-growing base of Spanish-speaking businesses in the US. North America is one of our biggest growth markets, and we want someone who is eager to do the best work of their life while supporting others in doing the same.

You will be responsible for driving the sales process with prospective customers as well as expansion within existing accounts. You will work closely with customers to understand their business goals and act as their trusted guide to how fits their organization — whether that’s a discovery call in English or a negotiation in Spanish. You'll also work with cross-functional teams to help align our product roadmap and marketing materials with customer feedback from the North American market. If you enjoy working with customers from a variety of industries in a rapidly changing environment, then come and join us!

Responsibilities

  • Be the driving force behind our revenue growth across North America by proactively seeking new opportunities with Mid-Market businesses
  • Own and manage the sales cycle from discovery to close, including qualification, solution presentation, negotiation, and closing
  • Run sales conversations in both English and Spanish, adapting your approach for US, Canadian and Mexican buyers as well as bilingual and Hispanic-owned or Hispanic-serving businesses
  • Educate potential customers on the immense value that offers
  • Provide tailored solution recommendations based on customers' unique business needs and usage patterns
  • Manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously, guiding them through various stages of the sales process
  • Handle inbound customer inquiries with finesse, effectively addressing billing, legal, security, and technical concerns, including the procurement and compliance questions common with North American buyers
  • Act as the advocate for our customers, collecting valuable feedback to fuel ongoing improvements, including product enhancements
  • Stay informed about North American industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies to effectively position the company’s products in the market
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Customer Success team and other teams to ensure smooth handover of clients and alignment on client feedback and product improvements
  • Develop strategic plans for targeted key accounts to expand usage and identify opportunities for upsell and cross-sell, ensuring long-term success and client satisfaction

raw.excerpt: Build the Linux platform beneath the product — from BSP and bootloader to kernel, hardware integration, and long-term maintainability.
raw.description:
Build the Linux platform beneath the product — from BSP and bootloader to kernel, hardware integration, and long-term maintainability.

Before You Apply

This is a full-time employment opportunity. We are not considering B2B, freelance, consulting, or independent-contractor arrangements for this position.

This is a low-level Embedded Linux platform-engineering role. We are looking for engineers with hands-on experience in Yocto, BSP integration, Linux kernel, Device Tree, bootloaders, board bring-up, and hardware/software integration.

This is not primarily a Linux application-development or userspace C/C++ role.

About L4B Software

L4B Software is an embedded software and platform-engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany, with an engineering presence in Pune, India.

We design, customize, integrate, secure, and maintain operating-system platforms based on Embedded Linux and Android/AOSP, tailored to the hardware, product architecture, security requirements, and lifecycle needs of our customers.

Our engineering capabilities span:

Customized Embedded Linux | Android/AOSP | BSP & Platform Integration | Product Cybersecurity | DevOps | System Validation

We support long-lifecycle and technically demanding products across medical technology, automotive, industrial systems, and other embedded environments.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux / Yocto BSP Engineer to develop and maintain customized Linux operating-system platforms for embedded products.

You will work across Yocto, BSP integration, Linux kernel, Device Tree, bootloaders, hardware enablement, and low-level system debugging.

This role goes beyond board bring-up. You will help turn vendor BSPs and low-level Linux components into reliable, reproducible, secure, and maintainable operating-system platforms designed for long product lifecycles.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain Yocto-based Embedded Linux distributions.
  • Create and maintain Yocto recipes, layers, machine configurations, and platform customizations.
  • Integrate and maintain vendor BSPs and SoC platform components.
  • Perform board bring-up and hardware enablement.
  • Configure, integrate, debug, and maintain Linux kernels.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Device Tree configurations.
  • Work with bootloaders such as U-Boot.
  • Integrate and debug device drivers and hardware/software interfaces.
  • Investigate complex boot, kernel, BSP, and hardware-integration issues.
  • Support Secure Boot, platform hardening, OTA/update, and other platform-security activities.
  • Improve build reproducibility, maintain patches, and support platform releases across long product lifecycles.
  • Integrate platform builds with CI/CD infrastructure and collaborate with Product Cybersecurity, DevOps, and Validation teams.

What You Bring

  • Strong professional experience in Embedded Linux platform/BSP development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Yocto Project and BitBake.
  • Experience creating and maintaining Yocto recipes and layers.
  • Strong BSP integration experience.
  • Linux kernel configuration, integration, and debugging experience.
  • Hands-on Device Tree experience.
  • Experience with bootloaders such as U-Boot.
  • Board bring-up and hardware-enablement experience.
  • Strong C/C++ knowledge for low-level embedded development and debugging.
  • Experience debugging problems across bootloader, kernel, BSP, drivers, and hardware boundaries.
  • Strong Linux command-line and system-debugging skills.
  • Experience with Git and software configuration management.

Technical Experience We Value

Relevant experience across several of the following would be particularly valuable:

ARM64 | Yocto / OpenEmbedded / BitBake | U-Boot | Linux Kernel | Device Tree | BSP Bring-Up | Device Drivers | Qualcomm / NXP / TI / Renesas | Secure Boot | TPM / TEE | OTA & Update Systems | PREEMPT_RT | Linux Security Hardening | Python / Shell Scripting | CI/CD

Experience building platforms for regulated, safety-critical, security-sensitive, or long-lifecycle products is an advantage.

What This Role Is Not

This is not primarily:

  • Linux application or userspace development
  • General C/C++ application development
  • Cloud/backend engineering
  • DevOps engineering
  • Android application development

You should be comfortable working close to the hardware and operating system, where debugging may require moving between the bootloader, BSP, kernel, Device Tree, drivers, and physical target.

Why Join L4B?

At L4B, you'll work on the operating-system platform itself, not simply applications running on top of it.

You'll work alongside engineers across Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, Product Cybersecurity, DevOps, and Validation to build customized platforms that must remain reliable and maintainable throughout demanding product lifecycles.

We hire for technical depth, relevant hands-on experience, problem-solving ability, and engineering ownership. You don't need to match every technology listed above, but you should have strong Embedded Linux/Yocto foundations and be comfortable solving problems across system boundaries.

Bucharest, Romania | Remote | Full-Time Employment
No B2B, freelance, consulting, or independent-contractor arrangements.

If you enjoy turning BSPs, kernels, bootloaders, and hardware into a reliable Linux platform, we'd like to talk.

raw.description:
Principal Embedded Product Security Architect

About L4B Software

L4B Software specializes in embedded software engineering, platform development and product cybersecurity. We work with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, board support packages (BSPs) and real-time embedded systems to develop reliable, secure and maintainable software platforms.

Our engineering work supports industries including medical devices, consumer electronics and other connected embedded products where security must be integrated throughout the product lifecycle.

About the Role

We are looking for a Principal Embedded Product Security Architect with strong hands-on experience securing embedded devices and connected products, particularly in consumer electronics or medical-device environments.

This is a hands-on engineering position, not a general IT cybersecurity, SOC, network security or compliance-only role.

You will work directly with embedded software, platform and product-engineering teams to design, implement, test and maintain security mechanisms across device hardware, bootloaders, operating systems, firmware and software-update infrastructure.

We seek principal-level engineers who have personally owned end-to-end security architecture and delivered substantial hands-on security implementation into production embedded products, from threat identification and security decisions through release, monitoring, and lifecycle maintenance.

Cross-Platform Security Ownership — Android/AOSP and Regulated Embedded Linux

  • Serve as the accountable technical security architect for an Android/AOSP-based mobile device platform, and a managed embedded Linux platform for regulated medical devices; own security decisions, risk acceptance recommendations, architectural reviews, implementation direction and release security readiness across both programs.
  • For the AOSP-based mobile platform, establish and review an end-to-end Android platform security architecture covering verified/secure boot, hardware-backed key protection and attestation, Android KeyMint/StrongBox where supported, SELinux policy, system-service and HAL trust boundaries, device identity, production provisioning, secure OTA/rollback protection and vulnerability response.
  • For the regulated embedded Linux platform, own platform-level security architecture and secure Linux baselines; lead threat and risk analysis, security hardening, boot integrity, secure communication and updates, SBOM/CVE monitoring, remediation, long-term security maintenance, and security verification. Deliver platform-level cybersecurity evidence supporting IEC 62304 and ISO 14971 activities and applicable FDA cybersecurity expectations, working within L4B's ISO 13485 quality management system. The medical device manufacturer retains responsibility for device-level risk acceptance and regulatory approval.
  • Select threat modeling and risk assessment approaches based on the product and applicable requirements (e.g., STRIDE, TARA or other suitable methods); translate identified threats into prioritized architectural controls and documented engineering decisions.
  • Remain hands-on: demonstrate prior personal implementation of meaningful embedded security controls and be capable of reviewing and debugging code, boot/security flows, platform configuration and verification evidence, while guiding AOSP, Linux, firmware and QA engineers.
  • Own product security from early architecture through integration, release, production maintenance and security incident/vulnerability response. Do not treat penetration testing, governance or compliance work alone as a substitute for security architecture and implementation ownership.

Key Responsibilities

1. Embedded Product Security Architecture

  • Design and implement security architectures for Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP and other embedded platforms.
  • Perform device-level threat modeling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments.
  • Identify threats involving physical device access, debug interfaces, firmware extraction, communication interfaces and software vulnerabilities.
  • Translate security requirements into practical technical controls and engineering tasks.
  • Collaborate with hardware, BSP, platform and application engineers to implement security by design.

2. Secure Boot, Device Identity and Cryptography

  • Implement and validate Secure Boot, Verified Boot and chain-of-trust mechanisms.
  • Work with hardware-backed security technologies such as TPM, HSM, secure elements, ARM TrustZone and OP-TEE, as applicable.
  • Design secure device identity, key provisioning, key storage and key lifecycle mechanisms.
  • Implement cryptographic signing, integrity verification and secure firmware authentication.
  • Support secure manufacturing provisioning and device lifecycle security.

3. Embedded Linux and Android Platform Hardening

  • Implement security controls within Embedded Linux and, where applicable, Android/AOSP platforms.
  • Harden bootloaders, Linux kernels, operating-system configurations and device services.
  • Work with Linux security mechanisms such as SELinux, AppArmor, dm-verity, dm-crypt and filesystem protection.
  • Reduce attack surfaces by securing services, ports, permissions, interfaces and debug capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Yocto/BSP engineers to integrate security controls into production firmware images.

4. Secure Firmware Updates and Product Lifecycle Security

  • Design and implement secure firmware and OTA update mechanisms.
  • Ensure firmware authenticity, integrity, rollback protection and secure recovery.
  • Support secure update architectures for connected and field-deployed products.
  • Investigate product vulnerabilities and contribute to remediation across supported software versions.
  • Help establish security maintenance practices for products throughout their operational lifecycle.

5. Vulnerability Management and Security Verification

  • Perform vulnerability analysis across embedded firmware, operating systems, libraries and third-party components.
  • Work with CVE databases, software composition analysis and SBOM generation.
  • Assess vulnerability exploitability and product-specific security impact.
  • Support static analysis, dynamic analysis, firmware analysis and penetration-testing activities.
  • Develop or integrate security verification into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Document security findings, remediation actions and verification evidence.

6. Product Security and Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, BSP, hardware, DevSecOps, QA and product-engineering teams.
  • Participate in security design reviews and technical risk assessments.
  • Support security requirements, verification and traceability for regulated or security-sensitive products.
  • Contribute to product-security documentation and technical security decisions.
  • Independently investigate and resolve complex embedded security issues.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of professional embedded or platform software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on work in Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, firmware, bootloaders or similar low-level systems.
  • At least 5 years of direct, hands-on embedded product cybersecurity experience designing, implementing and validating security controls in connected devices or other shipped embedded products.
  • At least 3 years of demonstrable technical leadership or ownership of product-security architecture, including threat modeling/risk assessment, security requirements, design decisions, implementation oversight and verification through release.
  • Mandatory evidence: explain at least one real embedded product where the candidate was accountable for end-to-end cybersecurity decisions and personally implemented meaningful security controls. General IT security, compliance-only, penetration testing or advisory work alone does not satisfy this requirement.
  • Strong professional experience in embedded software engineering, with substantial hands-on responsibility for embedded product cybersecurity.
  • Professional experience securing consumer electronics, medical devices or comparable connected embedded products.
  • Strong understanding of embedded hardware, firmware, bootloaders, operating systems and device security boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience implementing security controls in Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP or comparable embedded platforms.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in several of the following:
    • Secure Boot, Verified Boot or hardware root of trust.
    • Secure key storage, provisioning and cryptographic integration.
    • Embedded Linux security hardening.
    • Secure firmware updates and rollback protection.
    • Device-level threat modeling and attack-surface reduction.
    • Embedded vulnerability analysis and remediation.
  • Strong Linux debugging and embedded systems troubleshooting skills.
  • Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting with Python or Bash.
  • Ability to independently own technical security tasks from design through implementation and verification.
  • Experience working with cross-functional product-development teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ideal background: 12–15+ years in embedded/platform engineering, with broad experience securing Android/AOSP and/or other embedded Linux devices and guiding product-security delivery across multiple programs.
  • Direct experience with consumer electronics, connected devices, smart home products, multimedia devices, wearables or other commercially deployed embedded products.
  • Experience developing or securing medical-device software, connected medical equipment or regulated healthcare products.
  • Practical experience with ARM TrustZone, OP-TEE, TPM, secure elements or hardware security modules.
  • Experience with Yocto/OpenEmbedded, U-Boot, Linux kernel configuration and BSP security integration.
  • Android Verified Boot (AVB), Android security architecture or SELinux policy development.
  • Secure OTA frameworks and firmware-signing infrastructure.
  • Experience with SBOM tooling, CVE assessment and software composition analysis.
  • Familiarity with applicable product-security standards and guidance, such as IEC 62443, ETSI EN 303 645, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 or relevant EU Cyber Resilience Act requirements.
  • Experience supporting security verification, technical documentation and product-security audits.
  • Experience working on products requiring long-term security maintenance and vulnerability response.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate:

  • Security mechanisms they have personally designed, implemented, integrated or validated.
  • Experience working with actual embedded products rather than security concepts alone.
  • Understanding of how hardware, firmware, operating systems and connectivity affect device security.
  • Ability to investigate vulnerabilities and implement practical remediation.
  • Ownership of technical decisions and security deliverables.
  • Clear communication with embedded engineering and product teams.

Important: This position requires practical embedded product-security engineering experience. General IT security, SOC operations, infrastructure security, penetration testing without embedded-product engineering, or compliance-only experience will not independently meet the role requirements.

Why Join L4B Software?

  • Work on embedded platform and product-security engineering challenges.
  • Contribute to secure software platforms used in complex connected products.
  • Collaborate with international engineering teams.
  • Take ownership of meaningful security design and implementation responsibilities.
  • Work in an environment where technical depth, independent problem-solving and engineering quality matter.

Application

Please share your resume highlighting the embedded products and platforms you have worked on, the security mechanisms you personally implemented, and your experience with production or commercially deployed devices.

L4B Software is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. Candidates will be assessed on demonstrated technical capabilities and alignment with the requirements of the role.

Desafío Élite: Desarrollador Web Senior (.NET) para Escalar Sistemas de Misión Crítica

Ubicación/Modalidad: Remoto (Con opción de movilización a Costa Rica según necesidades del proyecto).

Tu rol/misión en la Empresa: Actuar como ingeniero experto sobre la plataforma Microsoft (.NET) para el análisis, diseño, mantenimiento evolutivo y desarrollo de nuevos módulos y aplicaciones distribuidas de alta disponibilidad, integradas en ecosistemas de gran escala.

¿Quiénes somos en Initium Software?

En Initium Software no somos una consultora tradicional; somos socios estratégicos que creemos en el impacto real a través de la tecnología. Conectamos al mejor talento técnico con los proyectos de ingeniería más desafiantes e innovadores del mercado. No buscamos programadores pasivos; buscamos profesionales de alto desempeño que deseen integrarse a una línea de servicio de vanguardia especializada en Tecnologías Microsoft, bajo un modelo de staff augmentation por demanda para un gran concurso estipulado a 4 años de ejecución.

Tu Misión (Tus desafíos y responsabilidades)

Como referente técnico del equipo, tu día a día estará impulsado por el propósito y el impacto sistémico a través de las siguientes actividades:

  • Diseñar y Construir: Ejecutar el ciclo completo de desarrollo (análisis, diseño, código, mantenimiento e implementación) de requerimientos complejos tanto en aplicaciones web maduras como en arquitecturas totalmente nuevas.
  • Garantizar la Continuidad: Atender con excelencia técnica y agilidad incidentes y requerimientos del cliente final bajo ventanas de servicio críticas (atención 7x24x365 según el rol asignado).
  • Orquestar con Agilidad: Gestionar tareas, estados y evidencias de ingeniería de software utilizando la herramienta institucional líder del cliente (Azure DevOps Services).
  • Cultura de Ingeniería: Documentar con rigurosidad técnica cada entregable y proveer código robusto que asegure una garantía técnica de 6 meses por paquete recibido conforme.
  • Sincronía Estratégica: Alinear tus entregables para el cumplimiento mensual de los objetivos de eficiencia de los proyectos, asegurando que la arquitectura web responda directamente a los planes estratégicos de Initium.

Tu Arsenal (¿Qué buscamos en ti?)

Este rol requiere un perfil de ingeniería senior integral, respaldado por títulos formales, certificaciones internacionales vigentes y verificables en línea, y un dominio técnico intachable.

1. Requisitos Académicos y Legales (Imprescindibles)

  • Titulación: Bachillerato universitario mínimo en una carrera de Ciencias de la Computación (deberá aportarse copia certificada o copia simple para personal extranjero en primera etapa).
  • Idioma: Español nativo o nivel alto (lectura, escritura y conversación fluida), ya que el 100% de la documentación y el servicio se ejecutan en este idioma.
  • Historial Limpio: Capacidad absoluta para aportar hoja de certificación de no poseer antecedentes ni causas penales abiertas (apostillada/consularizada si resides fuera de Costa Rica).(máximo 2 meses de emitida)

2. Certificaciones Obligatorias (Vigentes y Verificables en Línea)

Deberás adjuntar el enlace o código de validación de los siguientes fabricantes:

  • Scrum: Certificaciones aceptadas: Scrum Foundations Professional Certificate, SFC, Scrum Foundations, Scrum Open Assessment, ICP, SMC o superiores equivalentes.
  • DevOps:DevOps Foundation, DASA DevOps Fundamentals, DEPC o superior equivalente.
  • Microsoft Azure:AZ-900 o AZ-204, o superiores equivalentes verificables directamente con Microsoft.

3. Experiencia Comprobada en Producción

  • Mínimo 3 años comprobados en desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones web dentro de los últimos 3 años anteriores. (Es indispensable que las fechas no tengan vacíos y se puedan detallar de forma exacta los meses de uso por herramienta).
  • Mínimo 1 proyecto en producción activa ejecutado y liberado con éxito dentro de los últimos 3 años previos, con datos completamente verificables del cliente.
  • Referencias: Mínimo 2 referencias laborales con contacto telefónico y correo electrónico activos y confirmados (esenciales para el proceso de validación en 2 días hábiles).

4. Stack Tecnológico Requerido (Tu Caja de Herramientas)

Deberás demostrar experiencia práctica acumulada en los siguientes entornos (indicando meses de uso por tecnología):

  • Backend & Frameworks: C# avanzado con Visual Studio (versiones 2008 a 2026 o superior); .NET Framework, .NET Core y .NET versiones 5, 6, 7, 8 o superiores.
  • Frontend & Web: HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, TypeScript, React, AngularJS / Angular 8 o superior, Web Responsive y JSON.
  • APIs & Arquitectura: Web API / REST API, WCF, Web Services, Workflow Foundation. Prácticas de diseño bajo TDD (Test-Driven Development) y principios SOLID. Arquitecturas Web, MVC y Aplicaciones Distribuidas.
  • Bases de Datos: SQL Server (2008 a 2022 o superior), T-SQL avanzado, SSMS, optimización de queries y procedimientos, así como la suite de BI clásica: SSIS, SSRS y SSAS.
  • DevOps & Servidores: IIS (8.5/10 o superior), Git/GitHub y entornos de automatización con Azure DevOps Services.
  • Ecosistema Cloud & Identidad: Servicios nativos de Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Active Directory (AD), AD FS y Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Opcionales (Deseables según asignación de proyecto): Java 8 o superior, Kotlin.

¿Cómo mediremos tu impacto?

En Initium valoramos la meritocracia y los objetivos claros. Tu éxito será evaluado mediante:

  • Cumplimiento mensual estricto de los objetivos de eficiencia en los proyectos asignados.
  • Alineación y ejecución efectiva de la arquitectura de software respecto al plan estratégico del cliente final.
  • Resolución óptima de incidentes dentro de los niveles de servicio (SLA) acordados en las ventanas de atención.

¿Qué te ofrecemos? (Beneficios que marcan la diferencia)

  • Estabilidad a Largo Plazo: Proyecto de gran envergadura con una duración estimada de 4 años.
  • Compensación Profesional: Salario fijo negociable, estructurado de forma competitiva según el cumplimiento directo de tu perfil y tu desempeño en la entrevista técnica.
  • Flexibilidad Global: Modalidad 100% remota con una cultura corporativa fundamentada en la autonomía, la colaboración activa y el dinamismo.
  • Entorno de Alto Rendimiento: Un espacio donde se celebra tu iniciativa, se documenta el éxito, se reconoce tu impacto en sistemas de misión crítica y se te desafía a evolucionar continuamente junto a otros ingenieros de élite.

"En Initium no solo desarrollamos tecnología: creamos un entorno donde las personas pueden evolucionar, aportar valor y dejar huella."

Alertas del Proceso de Selección (Lectura Obligatoria para Postulantes)

  1. Evaluación en 2 Etapas: Al postularte, afrontarás primero una rigurosa revisión documental y validación técnica por parte del equipo interno de Initium (Verificación de la Matriz de Cumplimiento contra tu CV). Los perfiles aprobados pasarán directamente a la entrevista de defensa técnica con el cliente final. Debe existir disponibilidad inmediata para ambas fases.
  2. Trazabilidad Absoluta: Tu nombre, número de identificación, fechas de proyectos (mes/año) y tecnologías declaradas deben coincidir de forma exacta y matemática entre tu CV, títulos, certificaciones y referencias laborales, sin ningún tipo de vacío cronológico.
  3. Fe de Juramento: La experiencia técnica declarada se formaliza mediante una declaración jurada individual. Exigimos transparencia radical: declare únicamente experiencia real y verificable.

¡Llegó el momento de dejar huella!

Si buscas un escenario donde tu código dicte el comportamiento de plataformas críticas, donde tu arsenal de tecnologías Microsoft se potencie al máximo y tu rigurosidad técnica sea valorada, este es tu lugar.

Aplica ahora y hablemos del futuro que puedes construir. Envíanos tu expediente digital completo (Hoja de vida detallada con meses/tecnologías por proyecto, copias de certificaciones vigentes con enlace de validación, copia de título y matriz técnica) a nuestro canal oficial de reclutamiento o postula mediante este enlace.

¡Hablemos de tu próximo gran hito en Initium Software!

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

Who We Are

We curate journeys that turn travel dreams into reality. We believe travel and adventure should create transformative, lifelong memories — that's why we partner with advisors who share that passion.

Apply today—we look forward to welcoming you aboard.

raw.description:
Who We Are

At Blanchard®, we believe the heart of leadership is the human connection. For over 45 years, we’ve partnered with organizations around the world to transform people into impactful leaders—equipping more than 150,000 individuals each year with the mindsets, skills, and confidence to lead effectively. We’re proud to be the home of SLII®, the world’s most widely taught leadership model, and offer a comprehensive suite of training experiences—including Management Essentials, Essential Motivators, Building Trust, and more—designed for leaders at every level. Our award-winning, research-backed work is trusted by Fortune 500 companies, small and midsize businesses, government agencies, educational institutions, and nonprofits alike. What sets us apart is not just our expertise—it’s how we deliver it. Whether in person, virtually, or blended, we tailor each solution to meet our clients where they are and where they aspire to grow.

How We Work

Blanchard is headquartered in sunny Southern California, but our reach and our team extend across the US, UK, and beyond. We embrace a flexible, remote-first approach, with colleagues working from home offices, coffee shops, coworking spaces, and yes, occasionally in the company of kids, partners, or pets. Our people-first culture is built around empathy, belonging, and well-being. We understand that life happens, and we’re here for it. Whether it’s caring for a loved one, taking time for mental health, or volunteering in your community, we support the full spectrum of what it means to be human at work.

Role Purpose

We’re seeking a Temporary Contracts Specialist on Blanchard's Sales Contracts team. This role partners with the Sales Team, Project Managers, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to create, process, and execute Blanchard-generated sales contracts that are accurate, consistent with established company guidelines, and professionally administered. This role is designed to support core contracting activities using approved templates and established processes, while working in close partnership with the Sales Contracts Manager on non-standard matters.

This is a temporary opportunitywith the assignment estimated to last approximately 6 months. While the assignment is time-bound, Blanchard values strong performance, collaboration, and adaptability, and future opportunities may be considered based on business needs and performance.

Duties Include:

Contract Preparation and Processing

  • Prepares, reviews, and processes Blanchard-generated sales agreements using approved templates, including Program Access and Services Agreements (PASAs) and Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Reviews summaries of deliverables provided by Sales and Project Managers to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with approved offerings prior to sending agreements to clients.
  • Reviews and incorporates client-proposed changes that are consistent with established company guidelines, escalating non-standard or policy-impacting changes as appropriate.
  • Processes contract documents through Blanchard’s contract lifecycle management system (Gateway), Salesforce, and DocuSign.

Coordination and Communication

  • Serves as a point of contact for Sales and Project Managers regarding assigned contracts, timelines, and required information.
  • Communicates professionally with clients as needed to facilitate contract execution and resolve routine questions.
  • Tracks assigned agreements through execution and ensures contract records are updated accurately in Gateway.
  • Escalation and Collaboration
  • Work in close partnership with the Sales Contracts Manager on non-standard contractual terms, including legal, privacy, and information security-related matters.
  • Coordinates with Sales to obtain approval for changes to pricing, payment terms, or other key business terms.
  • Escalates contractual issues as needed to ensure alignment with company policy and risk tolerance.

Systems and Process Support

  • Uses Salesforce and DocuSign independently from Day 1.
  • Learns and follows internal processes for contract intake, tracking, and record management in Gateway.
  • Maintains organized contract records and document communications as appropriate.
  • Utilization of company-approved AI tools to support contract-related work.

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, legal studies, paralegal studies, or a related field.
  • Prior experience in contract administration, sales contracts, or a similar role preferred.
  • Experience working with Salesforce and electronic signature platforms strongly preferred.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools in the workplace.
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management systems is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to understand, review, and apply contract terms within established guidelines.
  • Comfort working with templates, standardized processes, and defined escalation paths.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting expected turnaround times.
  • Professional, approachable communication style with both internal stakeholders and clients.
  • Willingness to ask questions, seek clarification, and learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Ability to work independently while staying closely aligned with the Sales Contracts Manager.

Work Environment: This is a remote role that requires the ability to work independently, manage multiple requests, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment. The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and comfort navigating evolving priorities.

*Statistically, women and people of color are less likely to apply if they do not meet all the requirements. Even if you feel you do not meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply!

Blanchard is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We celebrate the unique differences of our employees because that is what drives curiosity, innovation, and the success of our business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities.

Location Designation: Fully Remote

Business Unit Overview

Group Benefit Solutions delivers comprehensive insurance and absence management solutions for mid-size and large companies. Our work fosters a healthier, happier and more secure workforce, contributing to New York Life’s legacy of being there when we’re needed most. Here, you’ll design, implement and support these solutions directly impacting customers’ lives. At our core, we provide financial security and peace of mind to people through our absence, accident, disability, voluntary benefits and life insurance solutions.

Role Overview

The Enrollment Consultant serves as a strategic enrollment subject matter expert, partnering with Sales, Client Management, brokers, clients, and internal partners to develop enrollment strategies that support employee engagement, participation, and growth.

The role combines enrollment expertise, market insight, client needs, and data to recommend the right enrollment approach for each case. Enrollment Consultants help shape enrollment strategy from initial planning through post-enrollment evaluation, identifying opportunities to improve outcomes and maximize the value of available enrollment capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Develop enrollment strategies based on client objectives, employee demographics, product mix, enrollment environment, available capabilities, and desired outcomes.

  • Serve as a strategic enrollment consultant to Sales and Client Management, providing recommendations on enrollment approaches, solutions, communications, and support.

  • Participate in client and broker conversations as the enrollment subject matter expert, helping articulate enrollment capabilities and recommend strategies aligned with the client’s needs.

  • Use enrollment data and results to drive recommendations by identifying trends, opportunities, and changes that could improve future enrollment performance.

  • Partner with internal teams from enrollment strategy development through post-enrollment evaluation to ensure the strategy is understood, supported, and executed effectively.

  • Evaluate enrollment outcomes to understand what worked, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend adjustments for future enrollment strategies.

  • Identify client and market needs through engagement with Sales, Client Management, brokers, clients, and other partners, bringing insights back to the organization to inform future enrollment capabilities.

  • Evaluate existing and emerging enrollment solutions to identify where tools, technologies, communication approaches, and resources can create the greatest value.

  • Support pilots and new enrollment approaches by identifying appropriate cases, contributing enrollment expertise, and evaluating results to help determine value and broader applicability.

  • Partner with Marketing and other internal teams to help ensure enrollment communications and solutions remain relevant to evolving client and market needs.

  • Build strong relationships across Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Marketing, and other partners, becoming a trusted resource for strategic enrollment consultation.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience in enrollment and/or group insurance.

  • Strong knowledge of enrollment practices, strategies, marketing approaches, and enrollment solutions.

  • Deep knowledge of group employee benefits, including voluntary and contributory products.

  • Experience with sales, implementation, and enrollment processes.

  • Ability to translate client needs, market insights, and enrollment data into actionable strategies and recommendations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate enrollment results and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Strong consultative skills and the ability to influence decisions through expertise, insights, and recommendations.

  • Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external partners.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate enrollment strategy and recommendations to clients, brokers, Sales, and internal partners.

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple strategic enrollment engagements.

  • Ability to travel within an assigned territory, including periodic overnight travel.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $90,000-$110,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Company Overview

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.

As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

Our Benefits

We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. We have a longstanding commitment to creating an environment where individuals can contribute their best and succeed together. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. By embracing a broad range of perspectives and experiences, we achieve greater success and fulfill our promise of providing financial security and peace of mind to families across all communities. Click here to learn more about New York Life’s leadership in this space.​

Recognized as one of Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies, New York Life is committed to improving local communities through a culture of employee giving and volunteerism, supported by the Foundation. We're proud that due to our mutuality, we operate in the best interests of our policy owners. To learn more about career opportunities at New York Life, please visit the Careerspage of .

Senior Network Configuration & Integration Engineer

Program: Army Global Unified Network (AGUN)

Location: Remote | Up to 10% Travel, *Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes, if an offer letter is extended to you.

Clearance Required: Active Secret
Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship Required


Help Build the Future of the U.S. Army's Global Network!

Leidos is seeking an experienced Senior Network Configuration & Integration Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

This is an exciting opportunity to help modernize the Army's global network infrastructure by designing, configuring, integrating, and validating secure enterprise network solutions.

In this role, you'll work with engineering, cybersecurity, operations, and deployment teams to turn approved network designs into standardized, repeatable network configurations and deployment packages supporting APEX, EDGE, and other Army network nodes.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Network Engineer with strong routing and switching experience, network integration expertise, and the ability to develop reliable, scalable solutions for complex enterprise environments.


What You'll Do

  • Design and develop standardized network configurations, templates, and deployment packages for Army network modernization.
  • Translate approved network architectures into practical hardware, software, and configuration solutions.
  • Configure, integrate, and troubleshoot enterprise routing, switching, SD-WAN, and network security technologies.
  • Define technical requirements for network hardware, software, licensing, connectivity, capacity, and resiliency.
  • Support network integration testing, interoperability validation, and lab testing before deployment.
  • Develop network configuration templates, technical procedures, installation guides, and acceptance test plans.
  • Validate BGP, VRF, network segmentation, security policies, and management connectivity.
  • Evaluate equipment changes, software upgrades, and configuration updates for compatibility and operational impact.
  • Troubleshoot complex network integration, performance, routing, and connectivity issues.
  • Work with Cybersecurity and Configuration Management teams to ensure compliance with DoD security standards and change-control processes.
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to network installation and deployment teams.
  • Support deployment readiness reviews, technical acceptance testing, and operational handoffs.
  • Identify opportunities to automate network configurations, improve consistency, and streamline deployments.
  • Collaborate with AGUN Operations to ensure new network capabilities transition successfully into ongoing support.

What We're Looking For

  • Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field with 8–12 years of relevant network engineering experience. Additional relevant experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II qualification, as applicable to the assigned work role.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required Computing Environment (CE) certification.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, configuring, integrating, and troubleshooting enterprise networks.
  • Advanced knowledge of routing and switching, BGP, VRF, SD-WAN, network segmentation, high availability, and resiliency.
  • Experience with enterprise networking technologies such as Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto Networks, or comparable vendors.
  • Experience developing standardized network configurations, deployment templates, and technical integration procedures.
  • Experience integrating network hardware, software, security appliances, and management platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with network integration testing, interoperability validation, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of network security controls, configuration management, and change-control procedures.
  • Experience creating network diagrams, implementation guides, technical specifications, and acceptance test documentation.
  • Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with engineering, cybersecurity, and deployment teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, or equivalent advanced networking certification.
  • Experience supporting U.S. Army, DoD, or federal enterprise network modernization programs.
  • Experience with Ansible, Terraform, Git, Python, or other network automation tools.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust Architecture, IPv6, and Software-Defined Networking (SDN).
  • Experience integrating networks across geographically dispersed or tactical environments.
  • Experience developing standardized network deployment packages and reusable configuration templates.
  • Experience with lab integration, technical acceptance testing, and operational readiness validation.
  • Experience supporting large-scale network migrations, modernization, and deployment initiatives.
  • Knowledge of DoD STIGs, cybersecurity requirements, and configuration compliance.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex enterprise networking technologies while supporting a mission that directly impacts the U.S. Army's global communications.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, help standardize critical network infrastructure, and play an important role in delivering secure, reliable network solutions worldwide.

If you're a Senior Network Engineer who enjoys hands-on configuration, complex network integration, and solving technical challenges, we'd like to hear from you!

Join Leidos and help build the next generation of Army network infrastructure. Apply today!

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

CrowdStrike Intelligence is seeking a motivated cloud security specialist with excellent technical skills to research the activities of cloud-conscious adversaries. Our Technical Analysis Cell (TAC) is at the forefront of CrowdStrike’s mission against cloud-conscious threat actors. We often are the first to catch adversaries leverage never-before observed techniques in the cloud. We combine intelligence analysis with deep-dive cloud service provider log analysis (AWS CloudTrail, Azure Activity Logs), and reverse engineering of malicious code, in addition to building and using automation systems to deliver actionable indicators and operational insights. CrowdStrike is uniquely positioned to leverage data from a multitude of sources, including incident response, managed threat hunting, proprietary telemetry, our large internal malware corpus, and our custom-built analysis pipeline. We foster a diverse environment of respectful, passionate camaraderie and collaboration between researchers who enjoy the fast-paced nature of our work. This highly technical position serves an important role in conducting research, increasing our coverage of the global cloud threat landscape, contributing to the continuous tracking of cloud adversaries, and ultimately developing finished intelligence products that provide a decision advantage to customers. These skills will be used to successfully carry out the following duties:


Technical Analysis:

  • Reconstruct, investigate, and track cloud intrusions leveraging cloud service provider activity logs (AWS CloudTrail, Azure Activity Logs) and document findings.
  • Enhance understanding of observed cloud activity by reproducing the activity in a test cloud environment.
  • Create tools to automate analysis tasks and tracking of threat actors.
  • Write cloud-activity-based SIEM rules (in Logscale), host-based (Yara) and network-based (Snort/Suricata) signatures suited for large-scale hunting, detection, and tracking of threats.
  • Perform a technical analysis and reverse engineering of tools related to threat activity within the cloud environment or as part of cloud-conscious intrusions Intelligence Reporting:
  • Produce high-quality, actionable intelligence reporting.
  • Collaborate with our interdisciplinary team to coordinate adversary and campaign tracking, and to provide support to teams developing mitigation strategies and responding to incidents.

What You'll Need:


  • Understanding of cloud security concepts in particular identity and access management (IAM).
  • Ability to reconstruct incidents based on cloud activity logs from at least one major cloud service provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Ability to express complex technical and non-technical concepts in written, verbal and graphical products for all levels of readership, including actionable mitigation and detection guidance.
  • Knowledge of programming and scripting languages, in particular Python.
  • Be a team player
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Proven track record of relevant experience in the cloud security field
  • Experience developing SIEM rules with LogScale
  • Knowledge of reverse engineering tools (disassemblers, decompilers, debuggers) and processes (unpacking malware, reconstructing code logic, etc).
  • Ability to identify and classify malicious tooling through development of signatures that can be used for tracking and hunting purposes.
  • Ability to interpret raw network data and to develop network signatures, as well as custom protocol decoders and decryption tools.
  • A background in intelligence is a plus.
  • Relevant cloud certifications are a plus.


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

Job Description:

Job Title
Corporate Materials Management Excellence Leader

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.


The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

This role is critical to transforming maintenance from just a cost center to a disciplined, planned, productive and value‑generating function. By strengthening materials management execution and discipline, this expert enables safer operations, improved reliability, and sustainable financial performance across the enterprise.

The Corporate Materials Management Excellence Leader will develop and deploy standardized materials management strategies, procedures, and performance expectations across all manufacturing facilities. This role will own enterprise standards for storeroom management, 5S, kitting, inventory control, spare parts optimization, material master data, inventory analytics, and maintenance materials support. This role drives material availability as a key component to maintenance & production execution efficiency, supporting improved asset reliability, reduced unplanned downtime, and sustainable cost performance.

Reporting into the Global Maintenance Director, this leader will partner closely with Plant Engineering and Maintenance, Reliability, Operations, Finance, Procurement, and manage strategy and performance of related third-party providers.

The successful Corporate Materials Management Excellence Leader will be a hands-on, enterprise-minded leader who can translate strategy into standard work and measurable performance improvement. This person will be comfortable operating across manufacturing sites, influencing stakeholders, analyzing complex inventory and materials data, and building sustainable processes that improve reliability, execution efficiency, and cost performance both through internal site teams and related 3rd party contractors.

As a Corporate Materials Management Excellence Leader, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact:


  • Partner with cross-functional teams to reduce downtime caused by unavailable parts or poor material planning.
  • Develop and deploy a standardized materials management playbook across all manufacturing facilities in support of the corporate Maintenance Execution Framework.
  • Improve inventory accuracy, transaction discipline, and storeroom controls.
  • Create visibility, leverage and optimize inventories across the manufacturing network.
  • Reduce downtime caused by unavailable parts or poor material planning.
  • Reduce excess and obsolete inventory through structured analysis and disposition processes.
  • Improve maintenance work order readiness through standardized kitting and staging.
  • Establish consistent min/max, critical spare, and spare parts review processes.
  • Improve storeroom organization and 5S performance across all sites, including an audit process.
  • Standardize material master data governance and reduce duplicate part records.

Detailed accountabilities:

Enterprise Materials Management Strategy

  • Develop, maintain, and deploy a standardized materials management playbook across manufacturing facilities aligned with the corporate Maintenance Execution Framework.
  • Establish enterprise standards for storeroom operations, inventory control, spare parts management, kitting, staging, and maintenance materials support.
  • Define standard processes, roles, responsibilities, and governance expectations for materials management across sites.
  • Partner with global and site leadership teams to align materials management priorities with maintenance, reliability, production, finance, and procurement objectives.
  • Lead enterprise-wide change management efforts to drive adoption of standardized materials practices.

Storeroom Management, Inventory Accuracy and Operational Excellence

  • Align storeroom operating practices with maintenance planning and scheduling requirements.
  • Establish and sustain standard work for storeroom operations, including receiving, stocking, issuing, cycle counting, returns, and material handling.
  • Improve storeroom organization, visual management, and 5S performance across all sites.
  • Strengthen storeroom controls to improve transaction discipline, accountability, and inventory integrity.
  • Develop and deploy storeroom audit processes, maturity assessments, and corrective action plans.

Spare Parts Optimization

  • Develop and deploy standardized processes for critical spare reviews, min/max setting, reorder points, obsolescence and stocking strategies.
  • Partner with Reliability, Maintenance, Engineering, and Procurement to optimize spare parts strategies based on asset criticality, failure modes, lead times, usage history, and risk.
  • Improve spare parts visibility and availability for critical assets while minimizing unnecessary working capital across the full manufacturing network- optimize sharing opportunities.

Kitting, Staging, and Maintenance Work Readiness

  • Improve maintenance work order readiness by ensuring required materials are available before scheduled execution, including kitting and staging.
  • Partner with maintenance planners and schedulers to reduce delays caused by unavailable parts, incomplete kits, or poor material planning.

Material Master Data Governance

  • Standardize governance for material master data creation and lifecycle management.
  • Reduce duplicate, obsolete, inaccurate, or incomplete part records.
  • Define data standards for descriptions, units of measure, manufacturers, part numbers, lead times, criticality, and stocking parameters.
  • Partner with Procurement, Maintenance, Finance, IT, and site teams to improve material master data quality.

Analytics, KPIs, and Performance Management

  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools to improve visibility to inventory health, material availability, storeroom performance, and process compliance.
  • Define and track enterprise materials management KPIs
  • Use data analytics to identify improvement opportunities, prioritize actions, and monitor progress.

Third-Party and Cross-Functional Partner Management

  • Provide enterprise oversight and performance expectations for related third parties.
  • Collaborate with Reliability, Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement, and site leadership to ensure materials management processes support business needs.

Training, Coaching, and Change Management

  • Create and deliver training materials for materials management processes and tools.
  • Build organizational capability through workshops, assessments, playbooks, standard operating procedures, and performance reviews.
  • Support change management plans that drive adoption, accountability, and sustainability of new processes.
