raw.excerpt: Who We AreEvergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.

We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

As a Patient Engagement Specialist, you are responsible for supporting both patients and clinical care team members with engagement efforts. Patient Engagement Specialists will play a critical role in ensuring that patients achieve initial activation and ongoing engagement with Evergreen Nephrology and their local care teams. The Patient Engagement Teamwill partner with our market operations teams across the US to ensure patients are actively engaging in their care, working with their interdisciplinary care team, and achieving their kidney care and overall care goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work closely with Senior Leadership at Evergreen to build the foundation of our contact center.

While this position is fully remote, you will support patients in all time zones Monday-Friday 8:30a-5p (CST/MST preferred).

Role Responsibilities

Some responsibilities may vary, but this role's primary duties include the following:

  • Manage a high volume of outbound and inbound new patient onboarding calls
  • Build trust with patients and clinical care team members through exceptional omnichannel customer service
  • Actively listen during patient conversations to activate personalized support for new patients and provide appropriate next steps including visit scheduling
  • Work in collaboration with interdisciplinary care team members (nephrologist, practice staff, nurse care managers, advanced practice providers, social workers, and dieticians)
  • Assist with patient and practice administrative requests such as new patient onboarding outreach, connection to their local care team, scheduling assistance, intake of patient complaints, and other needs
  • Assist with building new workflows, processes, and documentation related to contact center operations
  • Execute engagement initiatives to help achieve strategic goals related to Clinical Excellence, Clinical Quality, and Patient Engagement
  • Other duties consistent with this role, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High School diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred
  • 3+ years of patient support engagement or customer service experience in a healthcare environment working directly with patients; startup experience is a plus
  • Demonstrated sales aptitude and are energized by the opportunity to successfully navigate conversations with new patients who are learning about Evergreen’s care model for the first time
  • Experience managing workload to achieve defined metrics or targets, and are bold enough to speak up when assistance is needed
  • Experience in a team-based service environment
  • Demonstrate genuine curiosity when engaging with patients and excel at conversational intelligence
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with Medicare and/or kidney care population is a plus
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) fluency is a plus
  • Intermediate skills with MS Office Suite of products including Outlook and Teams
  • Able to work effectively in a primarily remote environment:
    • Home internet must support a minimum download speed of 25 Mbps and upload speed of 10 Mbps. Cable, Fiber, or DSL connections hardwired to the internet device are recommended
    • Evergreen will provide remote employees with telephony applications and equipment to meet the business requirements for their role
    • Employees must work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $19.00 to $25.000 hourly. Exact pay is determined based on experience, education, demand for the role, and other role-specific factors. This role is also eligible for a quarterly bonus.

Benefits

Evergreen Nephrology’s total rewards program is designed to support you in and outside of work. You can expect:

  • Paid time off starting at 4 weeks for full-time employees
  • 12 paid holidays per year
  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including an HSA with employer match
  • Reimbursement for continuing medical education for eligible roles
  • A 401(k) program where Evergreen matches up to 4% of contributions after six months of tenure
  • Paid parental leave
  • A robust training and development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career with Evergreen Nephrology

Evergreen Nephrology is an equal opportunity employer. raw.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Product Owner (Contractor) for two AI Pods that build the foundations of Numa, Enumerate’s AI product line, including Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist. This role is focused on execution, not product strategy or roadmap direction. The Product Owner will own and detail the AI Pod backlog, lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for every release, document test findings clearly, and analyze customer usage and metrics to inform what gets built next. The role reports to the Director of Product Management and works closely with Product Managers and Engineering. This is a strong fit for someone with a QA background who has recently moved into a product role and wants to grow in product management working on live, customer-facing AI products.

This is a remote contractor opportunity for candidates located in LATAM who are comfortable working in an English-speaking professional environment.

Key Responsibilities

Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution

  • Own, detail, and manage the delivery backlog for the two AI Pod teams
  • Translate defined product priorities into detailed user stories, functional requirements, and testable acceptance criteria
  • Break down initiatives into well-scoped epics, stories, and tasks with clear definitions of ready and done
  • Keep backlog items refined, prioritized, and ready for development ahead of each sprint
  • Work with other Product Managers and Product Owners whose features depend on the AI Pods to validate requirements and sign-off
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives
  • Partner with Engineering to clarify scope, remove blockers, and escalate dependencies and risks

User Acceptance Testing & Quality Validation

  • Plan and conduct UAT for AI Pod deliverables and provide release sign-off
  • Create and maintain UAT plans, test scenarios, and test cases tied to acceptance criteria
  • Perform functional, regression, and edge-case testing on completed stories and features before release
  • Validate AI output quality for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including accuracy, relevance, consistency, and exception handling, using repeatable test prompts and evaluation sets
  • Log, document, and prioritize defects, and verify fixes before closing

Documentation of Findings

  • Document UAT results, defects, and AI output evaluation findings in a clear, structured, repeatable format
  • Produce release-level test summaries covering what was tested, results, known issues, and recommended follow-ups
  • Maintain up-to-date user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, and supporting documentation
  • Provide Product Marketing with feature details and release information needed for go-to-market materials

Customer Usage & Metrics Analysis

  • Own product analytics for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including adoption, usage, and engagement metrics
  • Analyze usage patterns, customer questions, and feedback to identify friction points, gaps in AI responses, and improvement opportunities
  • Build and maintain recurring usage and metrics reporting for product leadership
  • Turn findings into backlog items and use data to inform prioritization

AI & Automation Workflow Enablement

  • Analyze and document end-to-end workflows suitable for AI-driven automation
  • Turn tasks users currently perform manually into clear requirements Engineering can build from
  • Define business rules, inputs, outputs, dependencies, and exception handling
  • Ensure workflows are well-documented and testable

Required Qualifications

  • Background in QA or software testing (manual and/or automated), with recent hands-on experience (roughly 1–3 years) as a Product Owner, Associate Product Manager, or Business Analyst on a software product
  • Strong UAT experience: writing test plans and test cases from acceptance criteria, executing functional, regression, and edge-case testing, and giving release sign-off
  • Experience writing detailed user stories and testable acceptance criteria and managing a backlog in Jira or a similar tool within an Agile/Scrum team
  • At least some hands-on experience with AI products, such as working on, testing, or supporting an LLM-powered assistant, chatbot, or AI feature
  • Working understanding of LLMs, including why outputs vary, common failure modes such as hallucination and inconsistency, and how to test and evaluate AI output quality
  • Analytical by nature: comfortable pulling and interpreting product usage data and turning findings into clear recommendations
  • Clear, structured written documentation that others can act on without a walkthrough
  • Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken

Nice to Have

  • B2B SaaS experience, ideally vertical SaaS, proptech, or FinTech/Payments
  • Experience evaluating conversational AI output in a structured way (prompt test sets, evaluation rubrics, regression testing for AI)
  • Experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Mixpanel, Amplitude) and basic SQL
  • Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones
  • Familiarity with property management, HOA/community association, or accounting workflows

About Us

Enumerate is a leader in the property management space offering a robust ERP system called Central that delivers Community Accounting, Management, Communications, Engagement, and Reporting all on one easy-to-use platform. It is the most comprehensive solution for property management, powerful enough to support large scale Property Managers, yet easy enough for Self-Management Associations.

At Enumerate, we put the Customer First in everything we do, delivering customer-centric solutions and finding ways to say YES. We have an incredible team atmosphere where egos don’t exist, and we credit others for contributions, accomplishments, and success.

$2,700—$3,300 USD

About The Role

As a Staff Partner Solutions Engineer, you will be the senior technical owner for some of Affirm’s most strategic card platform partnerships. You will work across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, and external partner teams to design, launch, and scale integrations that bring Affirm’s flexible financing products into new distribution channels.

This role requires someone who can go deep technically, lead through ambiguity, and translate complex internal architecture into clear partner-facing implementation strategies. You will help define the technical go-to-market model, launch readiness framework, support paths, and long-term operating model for an expanding area of Affirm integrations.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the technical lead and trusted advisor for strategic partners across Affirm’s card and digital banking ecosystems.
  • Build strong external technical relationships and communication channels with partner product, engineering, implementation, and support teams.
  • Own solution discovery, integration design, partner testing, launch readiness, and ongoing technical support across our partner portfolio.
  • Translate internal product and engineering architecture into partner documentation, implementation playbooks, test plans, support runbooks, and escalation paths.
  • Partner with Engineering and Product to identify integration gaps, data quality issues, operational risks, and partner-specific requirements before they become launch blockers.
  • Socialize solution designs, tradeoffs, and launch plans across internal and external stakeholders, building consensus across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Legal, Operations, and partner teams.
  • Lead technical triage for partner issues, including API behavior, latency, error rates, data mismatches, incident management, RCA follow-up, and partner communications.
  • Help establish technical operating rhythms for new partner categories, including external architecture reviews, readiness reviews, incident response, and technical health checks.

  • Experience supporting complex external integrations across card, payments, or banking platform environments.
  • Deep knowledge of card and payments systems, including how transaction state, money movement, reconciliation, and partner data flows operate across multi-party financial systems.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, SDKs, authentication, observability, and secure integration design.
  • Ability to read code, inspect logs, debug API behavior, write scripts, and collaborate credibly with software engineers.
  • Experience leading cross-functional technical programs by managing dependencies, assessing program health, communicating risks to leadership, and holding internal and external teams accountable to launch milestones.

Capital Engineering Coordinator(Solventum)

High School Diploma/GED And up to (7) seven years of combined experience in job- related experience in a private, public, government or military environment

in a private, public, government or military environment

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Fast Track Onboarding Specialist 2.

About the job

Twilio is seeking a Fast Track Operations Specialist to join the team that runs Twilio’s personalized onboarding team globally. This role will work directly with customers to help them onboard their A2P numbers with 1:1 customer engagement. Fast Track Onboarding Specialists are the personalized onboarding experts under the A2P onboarding org. The Fast Track onboarding team is a key part of Twilio’s Super Network, whose mission is to provide strategic customers with solutions to assist them with SLA driven go to market times solutions.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Provide personalized onboarding support for customers who sign up for our Fast Track Packages.
  • Help Fast Track customers solve existing onboarding issues through engagement that meets their onboarding demands.
  • Able to provide compliance guidance for all A2P products.
  • Manage Onboarding SLAs and credit utilization for each product
  • Partner with operations teams to scale onboarding volumes per assigned customer
  • Join weekly calls with customers to report metrics and review any open items or additional onboarding needs
  • Wear the Customer Shoes: Provide onboarding support for common customer inquiries through slack in addition to Service now; to ensure customers have an excellent experience with Twilio.
  • Draw the Owl: Assess the nature of product or service issues and resolve basic level problems
  • Ruthlessly Prioritize: Log customer interactions and tag/categorize issues accordingly.
  • Be Bold: Diagnose trends and report findings to our product team to ensure product related issues are resolved
  • Be an Owner: Partner with the account team to proactively address issues and advise on any industry changes that could impact customer onboarding experience.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Ability to work in NAMER shifts 6:30PM to 3:30AM IST.
  • Able to manage daily caseload and respond within SLAs
  • A2P compliance experience
  • Experience Required: 2 plus Years specializing in at least one a2p products
  • Previous experience working directly with clients
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and effectively project manage
  • Ready to take own up to 12 customer accounts
  • You’re empathetic and customer centric to the core.
  • You’re a clear verbal and written communicator.
  • You’re introspective and committed to continuous self-improvement.
  • You’re capable of working independently but also energized from working within a team and cross-functionally to achieve the company's goals.
  • You’re able to complete tasks in core areas within SLAs.

Desired:

  • Familiarity with Google workspace(Google docs, Google sheets, Gemini)
  • Familiarity with reporting tools
  • Prior experience implementing a2p phone number types
  • Understand general CTIA guidelines and some international regulatory requirements
  • Able to effectively prioritize tasks and multi-task
  • Comfortable owning and leading calls
  • Experience handling tasks within a desired SLA

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi).

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Key Responsibilities

  • Follow established document control procedures and processes under general supervision.
  • Prepare, organize, review, and upload engineering and construction documents into an electronic document management system.
  • Verify document naming conventions, formatting, and metadata to ensure compliance with established standards.
  • Compare document indexes against uploaded files to identify missing, incomplete, or incorrectly filed documentation.
  • Review, audit, and update document metadata to maintain accurate and complete facility records.
  • Respond to routine document management inquiries and coordinate system access requests, questions, and technical issues with the appropriate support teams.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Information Systems, Records Management, Construction Management, or a related field; or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Windchill or similar electronic document management systems.
  • Previous experience in document control, data entry, data management, or data migration.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency working with spreadsheets and managing large volumes of information.
  • Experience supporting construction closeout, engineering documentation, or facility records management.

CWI Works is recruiting for a Science Communications Specialist position through the Forest Service Experienced Services (FS-ACES) Program. This grant-administered program provides experienced professionals with an opportunity to support the mission and operations of the U.S. Department of Agriculture, U.S. Forest Service.

Role and Responsibilities

The Science Communications Specialist will work within the Adaptive Management sector of the Planning Service Organization, supporting nationwide planning efforts by analyzing and interpreting data and translating technical and scientific findings into clear, accessible information. The position will communicate data analysis results, resource assessments, and monitor outcomes through publicly available reports and other communication materials. These materials will help land managers and the public better understand a range of information, including spatial prioritization of active management activities and resource monitoring results.

Duties include:

  • Support mission-critical and priority land management plan revisions, amendments, and other planning efforts.
  • Serve as a senior planner or resource specialist, applying an understanding of U.S. Forest Service history, policies, and practices to advise on and support specific plan revisions, amendments, and other planning activities.
  • Provide implementation support and technical guidance to the Forest Service on planning communications, procedures, processes, and resource-specific topics.
  • Share expertise and provide knowledge transfer on effective approaches for communicating complex planning information, scientific findings, data analysis results, and resource assessments.
  • Advise and consult with staff involved in planning activities and develop, communicate, and share information on planning tools, resources, processes, and related authorities.
  • Review and analyze information to identify trends, patterns, and conditions, and translate findings into clear, accurate, and accessible language for public-facing materials and reports.
  • Develop and communicate technical and scientific information in formats that effectively convey complex findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must be 55 years of age or older and authorized to work in the United States; must have a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 20 years of relevant experience in a related field; have a thorough understanding of U.S. Forest Service history, policies, practices, and land management planning processes, demonstrated experience analyzing and interpreting scientific or resource-related data, identifying trends, and communicating technical findings; possess strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, understandable language for diverse audiences.

Hours & Compensation

Part-time position, up to 29 hours per week, at an hourly rate of $85.00.

raw.excerpt: About MISUMI AmericasMISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions.
raw.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

About Compass

Compass is a new venture incubated within MISUMI Americas. We’re building it with the deep manufacturing expertise of Fictiv, MISUMI’s digital manufacturing platform.

Every physical product starts as a CAD model, and most of what it will cost is decided right there. Yet cost and manufacturability are still checked after the drawings are released, by hand and in spreadsheets, when every change is slow and expensive. The result is redesigns, missed schedules, and money left on the factory floor. Compass fixes that at the source. An engineer uploads an assembly, and Compass reads every part the way an expert manufacturing engineer would. It checks each feature against the processes that could make it, prices the part at the volume that matters, reads tolerances and GD&T straight off the drawing, and ranks exactly what to change. It does this across the entire bill of materials, reruns on every revision, and learns from every correction engineers make.

The problems underneath are genuinely hard: making sense of real-world geometry, modeling cost across machining, casting, molding, sheet metal, and additive, interpreting engineering drawings, and building AI that gets measurably better from expert feedback. The stakes are real, too. Our customers are enterprise engineering teams, including aerospace and defense programs, where the platform has to be as secure and trustworthy as it is smart. Compass is a small team that moves fast and gives engineers real ownership. You won’t inherit a finished system. You’ll help define the architecture, the security foundation, and the product that the most demanding customers in manufacturing will rely on.

About the Role

We’re looking for a cross-functional software engineer who thrives at the intersection of application development and cloud infrastructure. We’re scaling the product, fast-tracking SOC 2 Type I and Type II, and building an ITAR-ready environment for aerospace and defense customers. You’ll be one of the engineers who makes all three happen.

We don’t need a pure DevOps specialist managing servers all day. We need an engineer who treats infrastructure as code, automates our cloud environment to satisfy security audits, and writes clean application code to ship features customers use.

You’ll own our AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. In your first months, much of your time will go to building our compliance foundation. Over time, the role settles into roughly 30% platform automation and 70% full-stack feature development.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Accelerate SOC 2 compliance. Work with leadership to implement, automate, and maintain the AWS security controls SOC 2 requires: encryption at rest and in transit, least-privilege IAM, logging, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Build our ITAR environment. Help design and run an isolated AWS GovCloud environment for customers with export-controlled data, with access restricted to US persons.
  • Own the platform. Manage, monitor, and scale our AWS environment using infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or Pulumi), with no manual configuration drift.
  • Build across the stack. Design, write, and deploy maintainable backend APIs and frontend features for our core product.
  • Automate everything. Maintain CI/CD pipelines (such as GitHub Actions) with automated testing, dependency scanning, and secure deployments built in.
  • Keep the architecture lean. Favor managed AWS services so the infrastructure needs minimal babysitting and you can focus on product.

Experience

  • A hybrid mindset. You’re a product-minded developer who moved toward DevOps because you wanted your code to ship faster, safer, and more securely.
  • AWS expertise. Deep hands-on experience with managed and serverless AWS services, such as Elastic Beanstalk, Lambda, RDS, SQS, Cognito, IAM, and CloudTrail.
  • Infrastructure as code. Proven experience managing cloud environments entirely through code (such as Terraform or AWS CDK) rather than the console.
  • Security and compliance experience. You’ve configured cloud environments to pass frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA. Experience with Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe is a big plus.
  • Full-stack proficiency. Strong production experience with Node.js and TypeScript, React, and PostgreSQL.
  • Startup agility. You’ve been an early engineer or on a lean team where you owned your deployments and wore multiple hats.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with queue-based background processing (SQS), PDF and CAD file processing, or LLM-backed features in production.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, FedRAMP, NIST 800-171, or CMMC.
  • Experience supporting customers with ITAR or other export-controlled data.
  • A passion for CAD, hardware, or manufacturing.

Please Note: This role requires access to export-controlled technical data (ITAR/EAR) and controlled unclassified information. Applicants must be a U.S. person as defined under ITAR (22 CFR 120.62), or otherwise eligible for the export authorization required to access this information under applicable law. MISUMI Americas will not discriminate based on citizenship status or national origin except as required to comply with export control law.

Physical Demands

Standard office/remote work environment with extended periods of computer use, video calls, and phone work.The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K plan
  • Parental leave programs
  • Paid volunteer days
  • And much, much more!

Salary Range: $160,000 to $185,000 per year, based upon experience

Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

  • Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
  • Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
  • Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
  • Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
  • Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

Localpayment is a fintech company specializing in local and cross-border payment solutions for emerging markets. Our platform enables global companies to accept payments in local currencies through native methods in each country, facilitating their international expansion.

In 2024, Localpayment entered into a strategic partnership with Aleph Group, a global technology and digital media company. This collaboration enhances our capabilities and reach, combining robust payment infrastructure with a broader digital ecosystem.

We are looking for a VP of Cybersecurity to lead Localpayment's information security function, owning the strategy, team, and control environment that protects our cross-border payments platform, our merchants, and our people across the markets where we operate.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the cybersecurity and information security strategy, roadmap, and operating model in alignment with the CTO and with Engineering, Product, Risk, Legal, and Compliance.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow the Information Security team, setting clear goals, career plans, and a strong security culture across the company.
  • Own the company's security governance and control framework, keeping PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 certifications current and audit-ready.
  • Oversee cloud security posture (AWS and/or GCP), identity and access management, and secure development practices together with Engineering and Infrastructure.
  • Partner with Risk and other business teams on fraud and risk, so that security controls support payment-risk and fraud-prevention use cases.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable LATAM and other regulatory and data-protection requirements in the markets where Localpayment operates.
  • Own incident response, vulnerability management, and security aspects of business continuity, including clear communication to senior stakeholders during major incidents.
  • Assess and manage third-party and vendor security risk for platforms and partners we contract or integrate with, and coordinate security initiatives with Aleph Group where relevant [a confirmar].Build the Security Operations (SecOps) function from the ground up: define its mission, scope, operating model, and team structure, and hire the analysts, engineers, and leads needed to run it.
  • Stand up and run a 24/7 detection and response capability, in-house, through an MSSP/MDR partner, or a hybrid model, with clear on-call rotations and escalation paths.
  • Own the SIEM/SOAR platform and the detection engineering program: log sources, use cases, alert tuning, and automated response playbooks.
  • Lead threat intelligence and threat hunting, focused on payments, fraud, and the attack patterns most relevant to fintech in LATAM.
  • Define and maintain incident runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post-incident reviews so the team keeps improving after every event.
  • Oversee endpoint, network, email, and cloud security monitoring (EDR, WAF, IDS/IPS, CSPM), making sure there's full visibility across production and corporate environments.
  • Define and report SecOps metrics and KPIs, such as mean time to detect and respond, alert volume and fidelity, coverage, and SLA compliance.
  • Select, implement, and manage the SecOps toolchain, balancing build-vs-buy decisions, cost, and operational maturity.
  • Develop the team's skills through training, certifications, and clear career paths, and build a strong blue-team culture that works closely with Engineering and Infrastructure.

Requirements

  • 15+ years of experience in information security or cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role as CISO, VP of Security, or Head of Security.
  • At least 5 years of experience within fintech environment.
  • Proven background in payments, fintech, or a highly regulated financial environment, ideally in LATAM.
  • Hands-on familiarity with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and SOC 2, and a track record of leading or sustaining these certifications.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security (AWS and/or GCP), and of fraud and risk, identity, and secure development practices in a production environment.
  • Experience with LATAM regulatory and data-protection requirements, and with engaging auditors, regulators, and senior business stakeholders.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to turn technical risk into clear decisions for the business.

Para ello, este rol desarrolla contenidos que reflejan la identidad y la narrativa de la empresa, y que también atraen tráfico, generan leads y acompañan a los prospectos hasta que están listos para hablar con Ventas.

Contenido de posicionamiento y marca

Contenido para conversión

Mining Technology Lead – Plant (Lead Metallurgist, Industrial AI)

Saudi Arabia · Remote-first with regular site travel

Are you the metallurgist everyone calls when the plant is not performing, and ready to lead how AI runs it?

About IntelliSense.io

We are pioneers in Objective AI (ODAI), combining fundamental physics with AI to characterise the physical world and deliver high-value decision recommendations: the brains of the operation. Our technology gives role-specific co-pilots to the people who run mines and plants, or sends recommendations directly to the control systems, moving operations towards autonomy.

We are a global, remote-first company headquartered in Cambridge, UK, with regional hubs in Chile, Australia and Ireland and a growing presence in Saudi Arabia, a global leader in mining development under Vision 2030.

What you will do

  • Own implementation, commissioning and value delivery across all our Plant customer sites.

  • Be the metallurgical authority for crushing, grinding, flotation, leaching, thickening and other circuits, so that our AI reflects how each plant really behaves.

  • Prove the value we deliver with sound, data-driven baselines that customers trust, and use them to secure renewals.

  • Lead, coach and grow a team of Mining Technology Engineers across several sites.

  • Work with our agentic AI engineers to automate site rollout and service work.

  • Bring site feedback into our product roadmap.

  • Support our account teams in winning more sites and more products with existing customers.

What you will bring

Must-haves

  • Substantial hands-on experience as a metallurgist or process engineer at an operating mineral processing plant, with ownership of circuit performance.

  • Improvements you have delivered and can measure: recovery, throughput, reagent use or stability, backed by mass balancing and metallurgical accounting.

  • Experience taking a technology, process-control or optimisation solution through to commissioning and everyday use.

  • Experience leading or developing engineers, and running work across more than one site or project.

  • The credibility to work with plant managers and general managers on value and renewals.

  • Fluent English and willingness to travel regularly to customer sites up to 50% of the time.

Nice-to-haves

  • Fluent Arabic (a strong advantage for a Saudi Arabia-based hire);

  • Mining experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC.

  • Data skills (e.g. Python, plant historians, LIMS) and exposure to advanced process control, digital twins or AI.

  • Commercial experience in renewals, expansions or pre-sales.

  • Professional registration (e.g. CEng, IOM3, AusIMM or the Saudi Council of Engineers).

What we offer

  • A competitive salary and benefits package benchmarked to your location.

  • Remote-first, flexible working.

  • Real ownership of a market in a fast-growing industrial AI company, and the chance to shape our presence in Saudi Arabia.

Location and right to work

This role is based in Saudi Arabia. You must have, or be able to obtain, the right to work in your location. Saudi nationals and expatriates are welcome to apply. Onboarding may include time at our UK headquarters.

Our hiring process

A 30-minute call with our People team; a technical interview; a short test project that you present to the panel; a conversation with our Chief Customer Officer and Chief Growth Officer; and references. We aim to complete the process in about 8 weeks and will keep you updated at every step.

Inclusion

IntelliSense.io is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in our teams. If you need any adjustments during the process, tell us and we will help.

raw.description:
Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque

nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous

Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.

Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe.

Rapide, simple et entièrement numérique, nesto a été nommé Prêteur hypothécaire de l'année par la CLA pendant trois années consécutives. Voilà le côté brillant de l'hypothèque.

Groupe Nesto

Le Groupe Nesto est le principal fournisseur de technologies hypothécaires et de solutions de financement au Canada, avec plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration. Fort de la confiance de plusieurs des principales institutions financières du pays, le Groupe Nesto combine plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives pour transformer l'avenir du financement.

Grâce à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le financement résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers hypothécaires et le financement commercial multirésidentiel. Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

Grâce à sa famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, le Groupe Nesto a pour mission de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien de demain et de devenir un véritable chef de file canadien en technologies de financement et en services financiers.

Pour en savoir plus :

La vie chez nesto

Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.

Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

Technologie et structure d'équipe

Dès le début, nous avons créé une plateforme technologique moderne et native du cloud respectant les normes les plus élevées de l'industrie en termes de processus de développement et d'exploitation. Notre interface utilisateur est écrite en TypeScript avec React et notre back-end en Go, sous forme de microservices conteneurisés docker bien découplés via des API RESTful et des files d'attente pub-sub, et isolés derrière différents portails API. Ces conteneurs sont orchestrés à l'aide de Kubernetes et instrumentés avec Datadog. Nos pipelines CI/CD sont automatisés à l'aide de Google Cloud Build et Codefresh et notre infrastructure est gérée à l'aide de Pulumi.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Collaborer et diriger des projets techniques complexes, en assurant une livraison de haute qualité et dans les délais impartis, tout en maintenant l'excellence technique.
  • Mener des initiatives visant à améliorer la qualité du code et les flux de travail, en contribuant activement aux discussions et aux présentations lors des réunions front-end.
  • Rédiger des tests automatisés et collaborer avec l'équipe QA pour garantir un code robuste et solide.
  • Tirer parti des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour améliorer les flux de travail, l'efficacité et la qualité du code.
  • Effectuer des revues de code, offrir des commentaires constructifs et fournir des conseils sur les meilleures pratiques.
  • Favoriser une culture d'excellence en ingénierie, d'inclusivité et de curiosité technique, où les ingénieurs peuvent s'épanouir et développer leurs compétences.
  • Agir en tant que mentor technique auprès des ingénieurs juniors, les aidant à développer leur expertise technique et leur parcours professionnel.

Qui nous recherchons

  • Plus de 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle en développement Front-End.
  • Vaste expérience avec TypeScript, l'écosystème React (Next.js est un plus) et les bibliothèques de gestion d'état modernes.
  • Solide expertise en CSS/SASS, les frameworks CSS modernes et les principes de conception adaptative (responsive design).
  • Expérience en optimisation et en surveillance des performances front-end.
  • Compréhension de l'architecture microservices et des modèles d'intégration d'API.
  • Capacité à anticiper l'impact sur l'entreprise et les risques techniques.
  • Capacité avérée à influencer les décisions techniques et à mener le changement, avec une expérience dans un rôle de leadership ou d'influence.
  • Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, facilitant une collaboration efficace avec les ingénieurs de tous niveaux.
  • Engagement à écrire du code de haute qualité et à améliorer continuellement les projets.
  • Solide compréhension des meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle, y compris les patrons de conception (design patterns), les méthodologies de test et les processus de développement Agile.
  • Passion pour le développement logiciel avec un historique d'apprentissage et de croissance continus.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Programme hypothécaire pour les employés : taux préférentiels exclusifs.
  • Couverture santé complète : couverture étendue de premier ordre (santé, dentaire, vision) avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.
  • Accès à un régime d'épargne-retraite collectif REER/RPDB avec des contributions de contrepartie compétitives de l'entreprise.
  • Télémédecine et soutien familial (programmes de complément pour les congés de maternité/parentaux).
  • Lieu de travail flexible : entièrement à distance ou dans l'un de nos bureaux (Montréal, Québec, Toronto, etc.).

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Contribuez à moderniser l'industrie hypothécaire canadienne.
  • Entreprise certifiée B Corp, soulignant notre engagement social et environnemental.
  • Nous avons remporté le prix CLA du prêteur hypothécaire de l’année 2023, 2024 et 2025, qui reconnaît notre excellence en matière de services de prêt.

Diversité et inclusion

Overview

Join Our Team at Wheels Up

At Wheels Up, we're proud to be a global leader in on-demand private aviation. As one of the largest companies in the industry and a strategic partner of Delta Air Lines – we are committed to making private air travel safe, reliable, and enjoyable. With a diverse fleet of owned aircraft plus a global network of trusted charter operators, we offer our customers access to the right aircraft for their needs and the ability to fly on their terms.

And it doesn’t stop at private flights. Wheels Up also provides freight services, safety and security solutions, and managed services to individuals, businesses, government agencies, and more. Regardless of how, when or where you want to fly, our mission is simple; deliver a premium, personalized aviation experience for every customer.

Role Overview: What You’ll Be Doing

Wheels Up is hiring a Senior Manager, Digital Marketing who can both set the plan and carry it out. You will own the digital marketing plan and roadmap, shaping it with sales and marketing leadership, then roll up your sleeves to launch, optimize, and report on campaigns across owned and paid digital channels. You'll turn marketing priorities into coordinated programs that build brand awareness, generate qualified demand, and engage prospects, members, and customers, and you'll establish reporting that ties this work to awareness, demand, acquisition, and retention. This role suits someone equally comfortable presenting a quarterly plan to leadership and building the campaign that delivers it. You will work closely with Sales, Brand, Creative, and Analytics.

Responsibilities

Your Key Responsibilities (Essential Functions)

Strategy and planning

  • Own the digital marketing plan and roadmap, setting priorities, channel mix, budget allocation, and timelines.
  • Partner with sales and marketing leadership, and with Brand Creative, CRM, and Analytics teams, to align on goals, audiences, and pipeline targets and connect campaign performance to business outcomes.
  • Develop campaign briefs, timelines, audience segments, digital channel recommendations, and performance targets aligned with marketing objectives.
  • Share tailored reporting with clear insights and recommendations with stakeholders and leadership on a consistent cadence, and adjust the roadmap as priorities shift.

Execution

  • Execute, deploy, and optimize campaigns across owned and paid digital channels, including paid search, paid social, display, email, and the website, coordinating messaging, creative assets, landing pages, and customer journeys with creative and agency partners.
  • Manage campaign setup, tracking, quality assurance, and approvals to ensure accurate, timely launches and consistent brand presentation.
  • Monitor budgets and campaign pacing, adjusting targeting, creative, bids, and placements to improve efficiency and results.
  • Run A/B tests across audiences, messaging, creative, and offers, and apply findings to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Build dashboards and reports covering audience reach, penetration, and engagement, channel performance, lead quality, purchase intent, conversions, and cost efficiency.

Qualifications

What You Bring to the Table: Education & Certification Requirements

We’re looking for someone who has a unique mix of experience, skills, and passion for what we do:

  • 8+ years of digital marketing experience, including 3+ years leading integrated campaigns, agency relationships, or digital marketing teams.
  • Hands-on experience building, launching, and optimizing campaigns yourself, not only through teams or agencies.
  • Proven ability to build digital strategies, manage budgets, and improve measurable marketing and business results.
  • Broad expertise across digital marketing and advertising, including paid search, paid social, programmatic display & video advertising, website content, email marketing, mobile push notifications audience segmentation, and conversion optimization.
  • Strong command of analytics, attribution, forecasting, CRM, and marketing automation, with the ability to translate data into executable actions and investment decisions.
  • Strong leadership, commercial judgment, and executive communication skills, with experience aligning teams around shared goals.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

The Extras We Value (Preferred Requirements)

While not mandatory, here are some additional things that would make you stand out:

  • Experience in evaluating marketing technology and improving integrations between campaign platforms, CRM, and reporting tools.
  • Relevant certifications in digital marketing, analytics, CRM systems, or marketing automation platforms.

Physical Requirements

We want to make sure you’re fully equipped for success. Here’s a look at any physical requirements needed for this role:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, writing, and operating office equipment
  • Ability to speak and hear clearly in person and via phone or video
  • Ability to occasionally stand, walk, bend, or reach
  • Close vision and ability to adjust focus for computer screens and documents

What We Offer

Salary Range & Benefits

At Wheels Up, we believe in fair compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications. The yearly compensation for this role ranges from $118,000 to $138,000, depending on a variety of factors. We don’t typically start individuals at the top of the salary range; your place within the range is based on what you bring to the table. Additionally, you may be eligible for a discretionary annual incentive program, which rewards individual and organizational performance.

We also offer a range of benefits designed to support your well-being and personal life, including:

  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Competitive 401(k)
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Complimentary access to mental health and wellness counseling through Spring Health
  • Financial planning assistance
  • A variety of additional programs and services in support of your total well-being

Everyone is welcome here

Each of us is unique, and that’s what makes us amazing. We believe there’s power in bringing people with different backgrounds, points of view and life experiences together. So, bring yourself and your best ideas.

Wheels Up is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity for applicants and employees. It is our policy to apply recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation and professional development practices and make all other employment decisions without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

Because when we feel safe and comfortable being ourselves, there’s no limit to what we can achieve.

Need Accommodations?

If you have a disability or are a disabled veteran and need assistance with applying, please reach out to us at . Simply include “Accommodation Request” in the subject line so we can quickly address your needs.

We look forward to learning more about you and how you can contribute to the Wheels Up journey!

Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Group Travel Planner (Sales-Focused), you'll help groups turn we should all go somewhere together into a confirmed trip that everyone is excited about. You'll combine destination knowledge, group logistics, and a consultative sales approach to match teams, companies, families, and friend groups with the right destination, accommodations, activities, and travel experience—whether it's a sports team tournament, corporate retreat, incentive trip, family reunion, milestone celebration, or friends' getaway.

What You'll Do

  • Connect with group leaders to understand trip goals, group size, budget, preferred dates, destination ideas, and must-have experiences.
  • Recommend destinations, hotels or resorts, room blocks, transportation options, meeting spaces, team-building activities, and group excursions that fit the group's purpose and budget.
  • Turn group inquiries into confirmed trips through email, chat, and phone with energy, accuracy, and a client-first approach.
  • Explain group travel details clearly, including deposit structures, payment schedules, cancellation policies, rooming lists, name changes, and travel requirements.
  • Coordinate group logistics: room allocations, special requests, group rates, contracts, deposits, final payments, and pre-trip communication.

  • Share valuable insights on destinations, group-friendly resorts, team activities, corporate meeting facilities, family experiences, and seasonal opportunities.
  • Build post-booking relationships that encourage repeat group trips, referrals, testimonials, and long-term partnerships.

Nice to Have

  • Interest in group travel, sports travel, corporate meetings and incentives, family reunions, or destination celebrations.
  • Travel-industry, sales, hospitality, event planning, customer-service, or booking experience is preferred—but not required. Zero experience is welcome.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to guide group leaders toward decisions.
  • Strong organization skills and comfort managing multiple group quotes, rooming lists, contracts, follow-ups, and client details.
  • Comfort with technology, online booking platforms, CRM systems, and AI tools—we will train you on the rest.
  • A genuine passion for bringing people together through travel and creating memorable shared experiences.

What You Get

  • Fully remote work with the flexibility to build your schedule around your life.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and training on group travel, supplier platforms, negotiation and sales conversations, and travel planning.
  • A collaborative, supportive team atmosphere with colleagues who want to see you succeed.
  • The opportunity to grow into specialties such as sports team travel, corporate meetings and incentives, family reunions, milestone celebrations, or luxury group getaways.
  • Clear paths toward leadership and higher earning potential.

Group travel has many moving parts—but if you enjoy coordinating room blocks, planning team activities, designing corporate retreats, and bringing families and friends together in amazing destinations, you will thrive here. Your work will transform group ideas into confirmed itineraries and shared travel memories that last long after the trip ends.

Apply today—we look forward to welcoming you to the team.

Are you ready to make a lasting impact on literacy?

At Really Great Reading, we are building a bright, diverse, and passionate team dedicated to leading the industry in improving literacy scores nationwide. With nearly two decades of leadership bringing the Science of Reading to thousands of schools, we design innovative products, training, and materials that transform how educators teach and how students learn. Here, we empower our team with the tools, support, and professional growth opportunities they need to thrive in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment—where your work truly makes a difference.

Why This Role Matters

Literacy is foundational to student success. At Really Great Reading, Regional Partners connect school districts with instructional solutions that help educators strengthen literacy outcomes. By building relationships, understanding district needs, and expanding our reach, this role helps bring effective reading instruction to more classrooms.

The Regional Partner – Mountain West drives growth across a dedicated territory, developing new district partnerships and expanding existing relationships. This role connects district priorities, instructional needs, and funding opportunities with solutions that support educators and students.

Success in this role means exceeding sales goals, building a sustainable pipeline, earning the trust of district leaders, and turning opportunities into lasting partnerships that advance literacy outcomes.

The Role

We are seeking a proactive, relationship-driven Regional Partner to own sales growth across Washington, Oregon, Utah, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, Arizona, Montana, Wyoming, and Idaho.

This quota-carrying sales role owns the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and relationship development to presentations, proposals, procurement, and close. You will develop a territory strategy, generate new opportunities, expand existing accounts, and maintain reliable forecasts.

The ideal candidate brings demonstrated success selling into K–12 school districts, understands how district purchasing decisions are made, and can connect instructional priorities with a compelling business case. You are comfortable managing a geographically broad territory and traveling up to 75% to meet with district partners and attend events. Candidates based in Utah or Colorado are strongly preferred.

What You’ll Do

Revenue and Territory Ownership

  • Own new and expansion bookings across the Mountain West territory, with accountability for exceeding annual quota and driving quarter-over-quarter growth.
  • Develop and execute a territory plan that prioritizes district opportunities, account expansion, and consistent relationship development.
  • Maintain pipeline coverage of two to three times your sales target.
  • Pursue multi-year contract opportunities that increase average contract value and support lasting district partnerships.

Demand Generation and Pipeline Development

  • Generate 70% of your pipeline through proactive, self-directed outbound activity.
  • Execute structured prospecting cadences to generate approximately 25 qualified meetings per month.
  • Build 600,000–1 million in additional qualified pipeline per quarter.
  • Develop and maintain relationships across approximately 50 strategic districts at any given time.

District Relationships and Product Positioning

  • Build trusted relationships with district leaders and other stakeholders involved in curriculum, instruction, purchasing, and implementation.
  • Understand district literacy priorities, decision-making processes, funding pathways, and procurement requirements.
  • Deliver engaging presentations virtually, at district locations, and at industry events.
  • Connect RGR solutions to district literacy goals, Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS) priorities, and measurable instructional outcomes.

Sales Execution and Forecasting

  • Manage the full sales cycle, including qualification, pricing, proposals, procurement navigation, negotiation, and contracting.
  • Advance opportunities through defined sales stages, targeting a 35% close rate across your overall pipeline.
  • Maintain greater than 95% CRM data accuracy in HubSpot.
  • Provide accurate weekly forecasts and use conversion data to identify risks and improve sales execution.

Collaboration and Territory Travel

  • Partner with instructional, marketing, and implementation teams to advance complex opportunities and support coordinated customer handoffs.
  • Share district feedback and territory insights to inform messaging, sales strategy, and customer support.
  • Travel up to 75% within the assigned territory for district meetings, presentations, conferences, and other business needs.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Three or more years of quota-carrying sales experience in the K–12 education market, with a documented record of meeting or exceeding annual sales goals.
  • Experience managing district sales opportunities from prospecting through procurement and close.
  • Ability to generate pipeline independently and manage a geographically broad sales territory.
  • Working knowledge of district purchasing processes, funding pathways, and the stakeholders involved in instructional decisions.
  • Ability to connect product value with literacy priorities, instructional impact, and return on investment.
  • Strong presentation, relationship-building, negotiation, and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency with HubSpot or a comparable CRM, forecasting tools, structured opportunity management, and Google Workspace.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts, opportunities, and deadlines independently.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 75% within the assigned territory.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling literacy, curriculum, or other instructional solutions to K–12 school districts.
  • Experience navigating complex instructional sales involving multiple stakeholders and district compliance requirements.
  • Experience developing multi-year district agreements.
  • Established district relationships within the Mountain West territory.
  • Reside in Utah or Colorado.

What We Offer

We take care of the whole person because we believe that when our team thrives, so do the students and educators we serve. Our benefits include:

  • Competitive 401(k) program with company matching
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance with employer cost-sharing
  • Paid Time Off to support rest, renewal, and life outside of work
  • Employee Discount Program and partner savings
  • Ongoing professional development and learning investment
  • Wellness and work-life balance initiatives designed to support physical, mental, and emotional well-being
  • Evolving benefits and rewards shaped by team member voice and values

Physical Requirements

This is a remote role with travel of up to 75% within the assigned territory. Work includes computer-based activities, virtual and in-person meetings, presentations, district visits, and participation in conferences and industry events.

Team members regularly review digital information, use standard input devices or accessible alternatives, and communicate with colleagues and district partners. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Really Great Reading is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performing workplace that reflects the diverse students, educators, and communities we serve. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation, improve learning outcomes, and advance educational equity nationwide.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

raw.description:
CYP (Children and Young Person) ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber – Contractor

United Kingdom (Remote)

Contract Type: Independent Contractor / Contract for Services
Engagement: Temporary
Location:Home-based, UK

About Us

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

Psychiatry UK engages independent contractors on a temporary basis to provide flexible additional capacity during periods of significant growth, increased patient demand. The requirement for contractor support is temporary and dependent on service demand and capacity. The scope and volume of services will be agreed for the relevant engagement.

This opportunity is for experienced independent clinicians able to provide specialist ADHD prescribing services on a contract-for-services basis. Contractors retain responsibility for their own professional practice and may provide services to other organisations.

Scope of Services

The CYP (Children and Young Person) ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber will provide specialist ADHD prescribing and medication management services for children and young people within their professional scope of practice and the agreed contracted services. This may include:

  • Provide safe, effective and evidence-based prescribing for children and young people with ADHD, in accordance with relevant NICE guidance, professional standards and age-appropriate prescribing considerations.

  • Undertake ADHD medication initiation, titration, review and ongoing management, taking account of individual clinical needs, developmental stage and relevant physical and mental health considerations.

  • Review treatment effectiveness, medication tolerability, side effects, adherence, physical health monitoring and other relevant clinical information to support safe prescribing decisions.

  • Respond to medication-related queries from children, young people, parents and carers through agreed secure digital systems, ensuring communication is clear, sensitive and developmentally appropriate.

  • Complete End of Titration Reviews (EOTRs) and ongoing medication reviews, including annual reviews where agreed as part of the contracted services.

  • Exercise independent or supplementary prescribing rights within their professional scope of practice and prescribing competence.

  • Liaise with Consultant Psychiatrists, paediatricians, GPs and other relevant clinical professionals where required to support safe and coordinated patient care.

  • Undertake appropriate clinical risk assessments, recognising and responding to safeguarding concerns, mental health risks and vulnerabilities specific to children and young people.

  • Apply relevant principles of consent, Gillick competence, parental responsibility, confidentiality and information sharing when making clinical and prescribing decisions.

  • Maintain accurate, timely and confidential clinical records, including prescribing decisions, medication adjustments, clinical monitoring and relevant communications, in accordance with professional and legal requirements.

  • Participate in agreed clinical governance, prescribing audit or quality improvement activity where required as part of the contracted services.

  • Maintain current knowledge of relevant legislation, NICE guidance, prescribing standards and developments in CYP ADHD medication management.

The contractor will retain responsibility for their professional and clinical decision-making within their scope of practice.

Working Arrangements

The services will be provided remotely within the UK.

The scope and delivery of services will be agreed between Psychiatry UK and the contractor. Where specific sessions, meetings or other activities are required, these will be agreed as part of the contracted services.

There is no expectation that the contractor will work exclusively for Psychiatry UK, subject to professional, confidentiality and conflict-of-interest requirements.

To Provide These Services, You Will Have

Sound clinical experience in the initiation, titration and management of ADHD medication in children and young people. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the developmental, clinical and safeguarding considerations associated with prescribing for this patient population, alongside a compassionate, patient-centred and family-inclusive approach.

You will be able to work autonomously, exercise sound clinical judgement and communicate effectively with children, young people, parents, carers and other healthcare professionals. You will recognise the importance of adapting your communication to the age, developmental stage and individual needs of each patient, particularly when discussing medication, treatment expectations and potential adverse effects.

You will have experience using ADHD rating scales, validated clinical monitoring tools and appropriate physical health assessments, alongside a sound understanding of safeguarding procedures and risk management within remote or digital healthcare environments.

You will have a comprehensive understanding of relevant legislation, consent and confidentiality requirements, professional prescribing standards and current developments in ADHD treatment for children and young people.

Essential Qualifications and Experience

Registered Nurses:

  • First-level registered Mental Health Nurse (RMN) or Registered Children's Nurse (RNC); or

  • First-level registered Adult or Learning Disabilities Nurse with at least one year's post-qualification experience in child and adolescent mental health, paediatrics, specialist ADHD or neurodevelopmental services, or a further relevant CYP mental health qualification.

  • Independent and Supplementary Non-Medical Prescribing (V300) qualification.

  • Minimum of one year's post-prescribing qualification experience.

  • Minimum of one year's specialist ADHD prescribing experience involving children and young people, within private and/or NHS specialist mental health, paediatric or neurodevelopmental services, or equivalent.

  • Demonstrable experience of prescribing ADHD medication for children and young people, including medication initiation, titration, review and longer-term management.

  • Knowledge and experience of age-appropriate ADHD prescribing, including stimulant and non-stimulant medications, physical health monitoring, treatment response and adverse-effect management.

  • Experience of safeguarding children and young people, including identifying clinical risks, recognising vulnerabilities and appropriately escalating concerns.

  • Understanding of consent, Gillick competence, parental responsibility and confidentiality when providing treatment to children and young people.

  • Current professional registration and prescribing authority appropriate to the services provided.

  • Appropriate professional indemnity insurance covering the contracted services, including CYP ADHD prescribing.

Desirable Qualifications and Experience

  • Further relevant training or qualifications in child and adolescent mental health, paediatrics, ADHD or neurodevelopmental conditions.

  • Previous experience within specialist CYP ADHD services, CAMHS or community paediatric services.

  • Experience managing complex ADHD presentations, including co-occurring neurodevelopmental conditions and mental health needs.

  • Experience of remote clinical service provision or digital healthcare, particularly where patient communication and prescribing decisions are managed predominantly through written correspondence.

  • Experience of working with families and multidisciplinary professionals to support medication management and continuity of care.

Desirable Knowledge and Skills

  • Experience with the titration and longer-term management of stimulant and non-stimulant ADHD medications in children and young people.

  • Understanding of clinical governance, prescribing audit and quality improvement relevant to CYP medication management.

  • Knowledge of safeguarding frameworks, clinical risk assessment and information-sharing requirements in child and adolescent healthcare.

  • Understanding of relevant NICE guidance and professional standards relating to ADHD prescribing in children and young people.

  • Experience of working autonomously across different clinical settings or organisations.

  • Familiarity with multidisciplinary working involving specialist mental health services, paediatrics, primary care, education and other relevant agencies.

  • Ability to deliver clear, developmentally appropriate written clinical communication through secure digital healthcare platforms.

Independent Contractor Status

This engagement is offered on a contract-for-services basis and is not an offer of employment with Psychiatry UK.

The engagement will be assessed under the applicable off-payroll working rules (IR35), based on the contractual terms and actual working arrangements.

Recruitment Process

﻿At Psychiatry UK, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Our process includes:

  • Application

  • Profile review

  • Screening conversation

  • Competency based interview(s)

If at any point you require any reasonable adjustments —such as additional time, assistive technology, or an alternative format for materials—please let us know. We are happy to accommodate your needs to ensure you have a fair and comfortable experience.

Job brief

Join Elite Escapes and turn your passion for travel into your next career.

As a Remote Destination Wedding Travel Planner, you'll help couples turn their we do into an unforgettable travel experience. By combining travel planning expertise with a warm, consultative sales approach, you'll guide couples and their guests from the first wedding vision to confirmed bookings — whether it's a beachfront ceremony, an intimate European celebration, a luxury resort wedding, or a group getaway with family and friends.

What You'll Do

  • Design customized destination-wedding travel plans, including flights, resort stays, room blocks, transfers, cruises, excursions, and honeymoon extensions.
  • Connect with couples to understand their wedding vision, guest needs, budget, preferred destination, and non-negotiables—then present tailored options and confidently guide them through booking.
  • Coordinate travel details for wedding groups, helping ensure guests have clear booking options, payment timelines, and support before departure.
  • Respond to questions and changes with professionalism and care, including payments, room upgrades, guest additions, date changes, transfer needs, and special requests.
  • Elevate each celebration with meaningful details: romantic excursions, welcome experiences, local activities, honeymoon ideas, and unforgettable wow moments for the couple and their guests.
  • Support clients from the initial consultation through travel, including pre-departure communication, on-trip assistance, and post-wedding follow-up.

What You Bring

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills; comfortable guiding couples through decisions, answering concerns, and helping them confidently move forward.
  • The ability to organize multiple moving pieces, from guest lists and room options to payment schedules, travel documents, and group logistics.
  • A willingness to learn new tools, including CRMs, supplier portals, booking platforms, and group-travel systems.
  • A background in weddings, sales, customer service, hospitality, events, or travel is a plus—but it is not required. Full training is provided.
  • A genuine love for romance, celebrations, travel, and helping people create meaningful memories.

What You Get

  • A fully remote opportunity with part-time or full-time flexibility.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and continued coaching on destination weddings, preferred suppliers, resorts, group coordination, and sales-focused travel planning.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Room to grow and specialize in areas such as Caribbean weddings, luxury celebrations, honeymoons, cruises, all-inclusive resorts, or group travel.

Destination weddings involve many details—but if you are the person who enjoys bringing calm, clarity, and excitement to a couple's biggest celebration, you'll thrive in this role. You'll help turn wedding ideas into smooth travel plans, happy guests, and memories that last far beyond the ceremony.

Ready to join us and see where this path could take you?
Apply now — we'd love to meet you.
